articleTitle: An Improved Unet Algorithm for the Processing of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: A machine learning algorithm has been proposed to address the issues of low image resolution, long sampling times, and high costs in MRI. It processes under-sampled MRI K-space data, enabling the reconstruction of high-quality images while significantly reducing sampling time and costs. This paper utilizes a Unet fully convolutional neural network for feature extraction and fusion of K-space data, incorporating an attention module to highlight important image features and suppress irrelevant information. The total variation minimization algorithm is used for the preliminary reconstruction of under-sampled data. High-quality images are then input into a Unet network with a gated attention module for training, achieving high-quality reconstruction of under-sampled data. Experimental results prove that the proposed image reconstruction algorithm outperforms the conventional convolutional neural network Unet, significantly enhancing image reconstruction performance. It improves the PSNR metric by over 4dB and the SSIM metric by approximately 5% compared to the conventional convolutional neural network Unet.

articleTitle: Using Larger Wheel to Accelerate the Trial Division Algorithm in Integer Factorization Method ToolBox
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: As is well known that the security of RSA depends on the hardness of integer factorization. The integer factorization method ToolBox includes many algorithms: trial division algorithm, Pollard algorithm, quadratic sieve algorithm, general number field sieve algorithm, Lenstra elliptic curve factorization algorithm et al. Trial division algorithm deals well with small inputs, and is usually used as a basic subroutine in other integer factorization methods. In this paper, following the footsteps of Pomerance et al., we further improve the running time of trial division algorithm by using larger wheel.

articleTitle: SCMotion: Predicting Human Motion Through Spatial Dependence and Center Anchoring
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Human motion prediction aims to predict future human motion based on past observations, playing important roles in several fields. However, previous works have often focused on the temporal sequential nature of human motion while neglecting the coordinated linkage of multiple components of the human body in space. Therefore, we introduce SCMotion, focused on predicting human motion using spatial dependencies. We divide the human body joints into four joint groups and predict each module individually. Additionally, SCMotion uses the more stable center of gravity of the human body as an anchor point for prediction, greatly enhancing accuracy. Our experiments on the H3.6M dataset demonstrate the excellent prediction capabilities of SCMotion.

articleTitle: Aircraft Target Detection in Remote Sensing Image based on Improved YOLOv8 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To address the problem of the low accuracy of aircraft target detection by the YOLOv8 algorithm in a large-scale airfield remote sensing image, a remote sensing image aircraft target detection method based on the improved YOLOv8 algorithm is proposed. First, the application of the current target detection algorithm in the field of remote sensing of aircraft targets was studied. Second, the attention mechanism was introduced to the YOLOv8s algorithm to enhance the detection ability of small targets. Finally, an aircraft target dataset and large-scale remote sensing image scene were constructed, and an experimental verification was conducted. The experimental results show improved detection accuracy in large-scale airfields and provide a more efficient method for detection in large-scale remote sensing images.

articleTitle: A keyboard control system of B-mode ultrasonic diagnostic instrument
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper uses uCOS-II embedded Real-time operating system to design the software system of B-mode ultrasonic diagnostic instrument. According to the idea of hierarchical design, the software system of B-mode ultrasonic diagnostic instrument is re-planned and designed, in this paper. The software system of B-mode ultrasonic diagnostic instrument is defined as the equipment layer, the driver layer, the hardware description layer and the application layer in the order of low to high. The software design method of keyboard control system based on uCOS-II is given in detail. The experimental verification shows that the design method in this paper is efficient, reliable, practical and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: End-to-End Inventory Replenishment Model with Bi-LSTM Peak Prediction for Demand
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Inventory management faces challenges with diverse products and varying demand patterns, requiring advanced models for replenishment strategies. Deep learning addresses this by learning demand patterns and making smart decisions. End-to-end (E2E) approaches integrate parameter estimation and replenishment prediction, outperforming traditional methods. Current models often ignore demand peaks, leading to higher inventory costs. Inspired by machine learning methods from other fields, this paper proposes an E2E model with peak prediction using Bi -LSTM and a peak-sensitive loss function. Experimental results confirm that the peak prediction module is effective and our proposed method achieves the State-Of-The-Art performance.

articleTitle: Unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method based on football team training algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the optimal solution problem of unmanned aerial vehicle path planning, the current novel metaheuristic algorithm (football team training algorithm) was applied to solve the problem of unmanned aerial vehicle path planning. First of all, it is to transform algorithm fitness function to unmanned aerial vehicle path cost. Then, the three stages of collective training, group training and individual extra training of the algorithm were adjusted. Finally, the flight path obtained by the solution is smoothed and the final flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle is obtained. Simulation results show the algorithm can be applied to solve the problem of unmanned aerial vehicle path planning, and the algorithm has good convergence.

articleTitle: Improved Safety Helmet Detection Model Based on RTDETR: RTDETR-IHD
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes a method primarily based on the latest deep learning technologies to enhance the performance of the RTDETR model for specific detection tasks by improving its key components. Firstly, we improve the model’s backbone structure using the inverted Residual Block (iRMB) technique, which effectively enhances feature extraction efficiency and accuracy by altering the connection mode of the residual blocks. Secondly, we introduce an efficient attention mechanism, replacing the multi-head self-attention module in the model, to increase the model’s ability to focus on critical features, thereby improving detection accuracy. Finally, we employ a dynamic upsampling method to optimize the feature map restoration process, dynamically adjusting the upsampling strategy to effectively enhance the model’s capability in detecting small objects. Experimental results on the safety helmet detection dataset demonstrate that the improved model significantly boosts detection accuracy and efficiency while maintaining real-time performance. Compared to the original RTDETR model, the enhanced model achieves substantial improvements in mAP, Precision, and Recall values, while reducing the total computational cost from the original 57.3 GFLOPs to 49.6 GFLOPs.

articleTitle: Research on Educational Knowledge Base Question Answering System Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In recent years, methods based on pre-trained large models have received extensive attention in the field of natural language processing. The large language model has the potential to reduce the development cost of question answering systems in the education field and improve the accuracy of question answering system. In this paper, based on the curriculum standards of compulsory education, an educational knowledge base is constructed by using the method of label alignment optimization, and a professional large language model question answering system is constructed based on the large language model to meet the requirements of the new curriculum standards, so as to generate a high-availability teaching scheme. Secondly, a prompt word method based on educational keyword template is proposed, aiming at improving the quality of question answering generation of large language model in educational question answering system. The experimental results show that this system is superior to the universal large language model in both objective and subjective evaluation, and has higher usability in the field of education and more accuracy in generating answers.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Industrial Drone Production Line Information System Based on 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This article centers on the production lines for branch-line vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) and tail-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), starting with an analysis of their process flows. Utilizing 5G communication technology, we employ 5G slicing and shared UPF deployment, with N6 dedicated lines ensuring seamless ground connectivity to the enterprise network application system. Additionally, guided by a plan-driven approach, we design an information system that integrates with the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and QMS (Quality Management System), facilitating data flow across all stages including logistics, production, and quality, while providing real-time insights into node dynamics. The ultimate objective is to digitalize and automate the unmanned aerial vehicle manufacturing process, thereby enhancing production efficiency and intelligence levels.

articleTitle: Research on the Error Correction Method of Strap-down Inertial Navigation System for Pedestrian Positioning and Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) experience drift and inability to provide accurate positioning services when obstructed and subjected to electromagnetic interference. Hence, Inertial Navigation Systems (INS) are widely utilized in indoor and heavily obstructed outdoor scenarios, such as fire rescue and railway personnel location, due to their advantages of lightweight, low power consumption, low cost, and interference resistance. However, the low frequency inertial measurement unit (IMU) suffers from the problem of low sampling data frequency and error dispersion over time, which will affect the final positioning accuracy of INS. To address these issues, this paper proposed an error correction method of strap-down Inertial Navigation System for pedestrian positioning and navigation, combining Piecewise Cubic Hermite Interpolation Polynomial (PCHIP), multi-threshold zero velocity detection and Cubature Kalman Filter (CKF). The experimental results demonstrate that this method can effectively correct the cumulative error of Inertial Navigation System. During the test with a pedestrian walking time of 85 seconds, the cumulative error was reduced to 0.1703 meters, limiting the cumulative error to 0.28% of the entire walking distance.

articleTitle: A Personality Detection Method Based on Semantic and Psycholinguistic of Social Texts
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: At the intersection of personality psychology, computer science, and linguistics, more and more researchers are paying attention to personality detection based on content analysis of texts on social media. However, existing social text-based personality detection methods rely heavily on pre-trained language models, overlook multi-dimensional sentiment in social texts, and lack of effective feature selection of psycholinguistic features. To address these limitations, we propose a method for Myers-Briggs type indicator (MBTI) personality detection. Our approach extracts and selects high-dimensional psycholinguistic feature, utilizes an optimal intermediate layer output from pre-trained language models for semantic representation, and fuses these features to enhance detection accuracy. The experiment results indicate that our proposed method improves the state-of-art results for MBTI personality traits by 1.65% on average on Kaggle MBTI dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Regional Collaborative Prediction of Air Quality Based on LSTM-FC
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: At present, the air quality problem has attracted the attention of all walks of life. Exploring the changing trends of air pollution and building a reasonable prediction model for predicting changes in air pollutants are of great significance for atmospheric environment governance. On the basis of Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM) and Full Connected Neural Network (FC), this paper uses the method of multi-information fusion prediction to explore the data correlation law between multi-regional data sources. By introducing the distance weight matrix, the prediction accuracy of our model is improved by an average of $\mathbf{7 . 7 \%}$ compared with LSTM-FC. Our model can predict a variety of air pollutants in multiple regions with high precision, realize the effective prediction of air quality, and effectively meet the needs of meteorological observation and atmospheric governance.

articleTitle: Drop Guidance System for Aviation Fire Fighting
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Low-altitude aerial firefighting can be rather challenging and dangerous. This paper proposes a drop guidance system framework and corresponding man-machine interaction pattern, which can support the drop of fire extinguishing agent and fire extinguishing bag at the height of 50 to 300 meters from the ground. Combined with the operation characteristics of plains and mountains and considering terrain and wind speed change, different release guidance modes are developed, which is suitable for direct fire extinguishing and flame retardant belt pulling in various environments. When performing fire extinguishing tasks, the firefighting crew inputs target location’s latitude, longitude, height and direction. The drop guidance system would then calculate the accurate launching deviation and launching timing for the crew, according to the current relative position difference between the target and the aircraft.The result would be presented in an intuitive way on the central column display for the crew. The drop guidance system can ease the crew’s mind from the firefighting task to better focus on safe flight, as well as reduce the work load of the crew, significantly improve the drop accuracy and reduce the potential loss of personnel and property.

articleTitle: Chinese Short Text Classification Method Based on Enhanced Prompt Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In the current era of rapid development of information technology, the exponential growth of text data poses unprecedented challenges to text classification technology. As the core research content of natural language processing, text classification technology is crucial for its application in various fields such as public opinion monitoring and sentiment analysis. This paper proposes an innovative classification method that combines keyword extraction and prompt learning strategies to address the challenges of Chinese short text classification. This method relies on the rich prior knowledge of pre trained language models and significantly improves the performance of text classification through a carefully designed input data template reconstruction strategy. The experimental results show that the keyword extraction enhanced hint learning method proposed in this paper improves accuracy to varying degrees under both discrete and continuous hint templates. This article optimizes the performance of short text classification and provides effective strategies and practical references for the practical application of pre trained language models in text classification tasks.

articleTitle: An Improved Lightweight Human Normative Pose Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Human pose estimation algorithms have high accuracy and speed, but there are still issues of missed and false detections. This article proposed a lightweight human normative posture estimation algorithm for precise target positioning and action norm evaluation in human normative posture recognition. First, the YOLOv4 object detection algorithm and the lightweight OpenPose algorithm were combined to obtain target bone node data. Second, by calculating action angles as features for extraction, an action matching method was constructed to evaluate and correct the training actions. Finally, the extracted training action skeleton image was trained and classified using a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) model. Relieved the uncertainty and irregularity of human normative movements. Training and validation were conducted on the collected datasets of professional coaches, and the experimental results shown that, our model achieved better performance than other models.

articleTitle: Advanced Human-Guided Prompts for Enhancing Text-to-Image Synthesis via Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In this work, we propose a novel method for text-to-image generation, combining the techniques of stable diffusion and large language model. Our approach improves prompt representation using large language model, with key tokens based on defects in the observed images. These key tokens draws inspiration from prompt learning. We improve synthesized images by using better prompts with key tokens from a large language model. Experiments show that ourapproach achieves better performance compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOX for Defect Detection Algorithm of Transmission Towers in Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: UAV technology has been widely used in transmission tower inspection. However, due to the large size image collected by UAVs, the traditional networks fail to accurately detect the small target in the feature map using the method of down-sampling, leading to the problem of missing detection. This paper studies UAV defect detection technology in power inspection and proposes an improved YOLOX detection method for large-size small targets. First, the ECA (Efficient Channel Attention) channel attention mechanism is introduced into the three output feature layers, and the feature information is fused into the PANet network to correct and retain valuable features. Secondly, Focal Loss is employed as a loss function for confidence predict-ion to address the serious imbalance in the ratio of positive and negative samples of small targets. Finally, the SIoU positioning loss function is used to enhance the localization prediction of small targets and improve detection accuracy by optimizing target location and size prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to the original YOLOX method, our model achieves an accuracy improvement from 88.2% to 90% with an IoU threshold of 0.5. In identifying tower damage, the accuracy increased from 54.3% to 60.4%; At mAP@0.5:0.95, it increased from 35.7% to 40%. These results fully validate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Research on PM2.5 Concentration Prediction in the Air Based on the TCN-BiGRU-AT Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In recent years, the frequent occurrence of urban haze weather has posed a serious threat to people’s health. Accurately and efficiently predicting the concentration of PM2.5 in the air for a certain period in the future and taking corresponding measures based on the concentration is of great significance for reducing the occurrence of haze weather. Traditional CNN have limited capabilities in extracting temporal features, while TCN have better capabilities in this regard. Traditional RNN and their variants, LSTM, are prone to problems such as gradient vanishing, gradient explosion, and overfitting, while BiGRU can effectively alleviate these issues and improve the training efficiency of the model. Therefore, this paper proposes a combined model TCN-BiGRU-AT integrating TCN, BiGRU, and attention mechanisms, taking Shenyang City in Liaoning Province as the research object to predict the concentration of PM2.5 in the air. The experimental results show that the model’s predictive performance indicators, MAE and RMSE, are both lower than those of the comparative models, and the fitting ability indicator $R^{2}$ is closer to 1 compared to the comparative models.

articleTitle: Research on OAM Mode Classification based on Large-dimensional Random Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The orbital angular momentum mode classification is the key factor to improve laser communication quality. Considering the problem that estimation bias of classical asymptotic systems, the statistical characteristic of OAM mode is taken into consideration. According to calculate the statistical distribution using large-dimensional random matrix theory, the fitting effect determines the classification between single mode and multiplex mode. The Ring Law and M-P Law of large-dimensional random matrices breaks through the assumptive restriction of infinite sample thus building a significant model for unlabeled datasets. The simulation experiments validate that the big data theory is an effective application to OAM mode classification.

articleTitle: Research on SiC MOSFET Model Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Based on the Simulink tool within the Matlab platform and taking SiC MOSFET power devices as a reference, an equivalent circuit model of nonlinear capacitors $\mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{ds}}$ and $\mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{gd}}$ was established, and a SiC MOSFET model was constructed. In addition, its dynamic and static characteristics were analyzed according to the model. The simulation results show that the output characteristics at different temperatures match the original curve well; The rise and fall times of dynamic characteristics are consistent with the comparison errors in the data manual, which verifies the correctness of the model and has certain feasibility.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Path planning Method for UAVs Based on Multi-agent Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes a path planning method based on multi-agent theory aimed at solving the path planning problem of various mission types and complex mission coordination of UAVs. The planning process is designed with three steps: task preprocessing, task assignment and task execution. To ensure the orderly progress of the planning process, a four-layer planning structure is used to determine the coordinated interaction between the agents. The proposed method can achieve real-time and orderly task assignment, reduce the time cost and improve efficiency, making it have engineering practicality.

articleTitle: A Multi-scale Attention Network Based on Dilated Convolution for Image Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Deep learning methods have shown excellent performance in many applications, including the field of image super-resolution. To address the issues of fixed receptive fields, potential neglect of high-frequency image features, and insufficient multi-scale feature extraction in the image super-resolution reconstruction process, we propose a multi-scale attention image super-resolution method based on dilated convolution in this paper. Specifically, we proposea multi-scale feature extraction module (MSFEM) to maximize the utilization of the extracted feature maps and further extract image feature information. Additionally, we introduce a multi-feature integration attention module (MIAM),composed of a dilated pyramid module (DPM) and a residual channel module. This module expands the network’s receptive field through convolution operations with different dilation rates, capturing high-frequency features of multi-scale contextual information in images. Finally, extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed DMAN method in both quantitative analysis and visual effects compared to other state-of-the-art SR models.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Graphic and Image Processing Technologies Within the Context of Visual Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, graphics and image processing technology has become a key component of visual communication system. Graphics and image processing technology as a common means of computer technology, through the application of this technology to the visual communication system, can bring a new experience for people’s vision. The paper discusses the principles of image enhancement, image segmentation, image recognition and other core technologies and their specific applications in visual communication. Image enhancement aims to improve the quality of images and make them more suitable for specific applications. Image segmentation aims to divide an image into multiple parts or regions, so that these regions have similar properties internally, while there are significant differences between different regions. The purpose of image recognition is to enable computers to understand and recognize the content in images. Through empirical analysis, this study demonstrates the significant benefits of graphics and image processing technology in improving work efficiency, enhancing customer satisfaction and reducing design costs. Image processing technology not only optimizes the design process, but also enhances the effect of visual communication, which has a positive impact on the development of related industries.

articleTitle: DDoS attack frequency prediction model based on chaotic mapping echo state network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack is a relatively simple operation of the attack mode, the existing DDoS attack prediction methods lagging behind, resulting in the prediction of untimely, inaccurate, making the prevention more difficult. Therefore, an improved chaotic mappings Logistic-tent harmony search Algorithm (CLHS) is proposed, which greatly improves the search efficiency by introducing Logistic-Tent chaotic mapping so that the initial values can be distributed more uniformly in the search space. Then the CLHS algorithm is introduced into echo state networks(ESN) for improvement, and DDoS attack posture warning model for echo state networks (CLHS-ESN) based on chaotic mapping is proposed. The experimental results show that the CLHS-ESN model can be utilized to warn the DDoS attack posture in real-time and effectively.

articleTitle: A customized convolutional neural network structure design based on Field-Programmable Gate Array
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In this paper, different hardware deployment schemes are designed to accelerate the overall reasoning process of convolutional neural network according to the characteristics of large amount of calculation in convolution layer and large amount of parameters in linear layer. For convolutional neural networks with fewer layers, the LUT multiplication circuit is used instead of the DSP multiplication and the parameters are fixed in the circuit to reduce the dependence on DSP and ROM resources. This makes it possible to achieve higher parallelism reasoning on FPGAs with fewer resources. In this paper, a reduced-order convolutional neural network is trained based on the MNIST training set. After 8bit quantization, it is deployed to the FPGA and the inference speed reaches $\mathbf{7. 3 5 6}$ us, which is 339 times faster than that of the CPU.

articleTitle: An Emotion Text Classification Model Based on Llama3-8b Using Lora Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This study introduces a method utilizing the Llama3-8b model for emotion text classification. The training process is accelerated by incorporating Lora and FlashAttention techniques. On an emotion text dataset containing six categories, our improved Llama3-8b model demonstrates superior performance in emotion classification, surpassing other transformer models including Bert-Base, Bert-Large, Roberta-Base, and Roberta-Large. The Llama3-8b model, fine-tuned with supervised learning, achieved an accuracy of 0.9262, outperforming all other models and highlighting the advantages of large language models in classification tasks. This study illustrates the potential of specialized fine-tuning techniques in enhancing the performance of language models in domain-specific tasks, particularly in emotion text classification.

articleTitle: Design of automatic sand replenishment trolley and its health condition assessment for dynamic train sets with increased friction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Sand addition is a very important link in EMU preparation. In order to solve the problems of pollution, low efficiency and safety in the sand addition operation, the design and health status evaluation of the automatic sand supplement car for EMU are carried out on the basis of in-depth study of the existing sand addition technology and electric driving car technology. First of all, combined with the pneumatic conveying technology, the design of automatic sand compensating car is carried out. A deep learning-based health state assessment model of automatic sand dolly is established to realize safe, environmentally friendly and efficient continuous sand loading operation of EMU, which can reduce labor intensity and improve work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Algorithms for Large-scale Graph Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In the field of data science, large-scale graph neural networks (GNN) are effective for modeling complex dataset relations. However, its heavy computational load is a significant challenge. This study focuses on creating efficient algorithms to optimize GNN training and inference without performance loss. It cleverly uses techniques such as sparse matrix operations, node sampling, and parallel processing to handle the scalability issues of large graphs. Empirical evaluations on multiple benchmark datasets show that the algorithms significantly reduce the computational time and resource use while maintaining or improving model accuracy. This study makes a novel algorithmic contribution. It offers new ways to deal with GNN computational complexity and enables GNN applications in scenarios with limited computational resources. This is highly significant for using GNNs in real-world settings that were previously restricted by resources.

articleTitle: Jadeite Jewelry Product Design Management with Information Analysis and Prediction Method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The jade ware industry in China faces a myriad of challenges in adapting to information of modern product development, such as demands and evolving consumer preferences As the industry strives to navigate these complexities, there arises an imperative to explore innovative methodologies that can revolutionize product design and management strategies. In this research article, the algorithms of grey relation analysis (GRA) and the GM (1,1) grey prediction model are applied to the domain of jadeite jewelry product design and management. The results of the prediction suggested nine advantageous product alternatives, with overall error means ranging from 19.10% to 5.71%, indicating good accuracy of the prediction model. The customer survey on the new product package also shows increases of 6%, 2%, and 8% in satisfaction regarding aspects of technical quality, material quality, and aesthetics.

articleTitle: Adaptive RSRP/RSRQ judgment switching algorithm based on improved gray prediction models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the communication system of high-speed railroad will be affected by multipath fading, Doppler frequency shift, and same-frequency interference when the train is running at high speed, which makes the triggering rate of switching and the success rate of switching unsatisfactory during the switching process in the trans-area, this paper puts forward a kind of self-adaptive RSRP/RSRQ judgment switching algorithm based on the improved gray prediction model. It adopts an improved gray prediction model to improve the accuracy of signal data prediction, dynamically adjusts the hysteresis tolerance value according to the speed, as well as adopts the RSRP/RSRQ judgment switching to ensure a high switching trigger rate and good communication quality. The results show that this algorithm can effectively reduce the triggered ping-pong switching rate and improve the triggered switching rate and switching success rate compared with the traditional A3 algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement of Random Forest Algorithm Based on Oversampling and Feature Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The traditional random forest algorithm is prone to the decline of classification accuracy in processing unbalanced data, and the classification results are more biased to most classes, resulting in high false classification accuracy. When dealing with high dimensional data, too many features will disturb the training ability of the model and reduce the prediction accuracy of the model. To solve the above problems, this paper puts forward an improved random forest algorithm based on oversampling and feature reduction. First, improve the blindness and class boundary ambiguity of the original SMOTE algorithm in handling the unbalanced data oversampling. Then the ReliefF algorithm is used to calculate the weights of each feature on the balanced data, remove the features that have little impact on the classification results, and then extract feature subsets by layers according to the weight of the features. Finally, random forest algorithm is used to construct decision tree for prediction. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has higher evaluation indexes in the classification model when facing high-dimensional unbalanced data, which proves that the classification model has better classification effect and is superior to the traditional random forest algorithm in classification accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Study on dynamic compensation of marine conductivity sensor based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient response speed of the marine conductivity sensor, a method of designing a dynamic compensation filter model for dynamic compensation is proposed to improve the response speed of the sensor. The dynamic response curve of the sensor was measured by the marine sensor time constant measurement device, and the dynamic compensation filter model of the conductivity sensor was established by the system inverse modelling method, and the dynamic compensation filter model was optimized by the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The experimental results show that the time constant of the measured sensor is 234.5 ms at a speed of $1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$. After compensation, the sensor time constant is reduced to 27.5 ms, which is about 90%, and the response speed of the sensor is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Optimization of joint dispatch of emergency materials at multiple supply points
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the problem of joint emergency material dispatch involving multiple supply points and multiple disaster points, so as to provide a solution for complex natural disaster scenarios. Through the introduction of intelligent optimization algorithm, combined with advanced scheduling strategies, it aims to achieve reasonable allocation and efficient transportation of materials, so as to cope with the challenges of emergency materials scheduling brought by natural disasters. At the same time, through the research of disaster response, this paper also aims to provide useful reference for improving China’s emergency management and disaster prevention capabilities.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of deterministic network based on redundancy technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The development of traditional industrial Internet technology is mainly based on the optimization of Ethernet technology in industrial application scenarios. In industrial network applications, data acquisition delay is particularly important as an important indicator. Although QoS exists in industrial networks, standard Ethernet can only guarantee delay to a certain point. When the network utilization rate is very high, the network data delay is very serious. This is mainly caused by the storage and forwarding strategy commonly used in multi-port switches and insufficient bandwidth reservation capacity. At the same time, the dual network path generally used by industrial networks to solve the reliability of data transmission has the problem of resource waste. This paper proposes a design of a redundant mechanism and verifies and analyzes it in a typical redundant control system based on a deterministic network, realizing the industrial Internet’s requirements for low latency, high bandwidth, and high reliability, integrating multiple industrial protocols, and realizing the coupling of data forwarding equipment.

Author Keywords: frame replication and elimination for reliability

articleTitle: CRULoc: A protein subcellular localization prediction model based on BiGRU and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The prediction of subcellular localization of eukaryotic proteins is a pivotal area in bioinformatics research, crucial for elucidating protein functions and mechanisms. This study proposes a novel CRULoc model, which integrates Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Units (BiGRU), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and three pooling strategies (soft pooling, max pooling, and average pooling). The model uses embedding features generated by the protein language model ProtT5-XL-U50 as input. Within the CRULoc model, the BiGRU and CNN modules are responsible for capturing global and local relationships among amino acids, and the combined application of the three pooling methods enhances the model’s ability to capture critical information. Experimental validation shows that the CRULoc model outperforms several current advanced prediction models across various tasks. These results clearly demonstrate the superior performance of the CRULoc model in predicting the subcellular localization of eukaryotic proteins, providing robust support for the in-depth exploration of protein functions and mechanisms.

articleTitle: Lightweight PCB defect detection algorithm and deployment based on ASF-YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the advancement in the precision of printed circuit boards (PCBs), their impact on electronic products has become increasingly significant. PCBs often exhibit various surface defects such as short circuits, open circuits, and burrs, which can have devastating effects on electronic products. To address these defects, this study proposes a lightweight detection model, ASC-YOLO. The dataset used was sourced from a public dataset on Roboflow, comprising 9,669 images. The Adown module enhances the model’s ability to recognize defects of different sizes and types while effectively reducing computation and parameter volume. SENetV2 improves the network’s learning capacity through multi-branch fully connected layers. Finally, PConv is introduced to reduce redundant computation and memory access, efficiently extracting spatial features. Compared to the original model, the parameters were reduced by 28%, and the accuracy reached 94.8%. Moreover, the model was deployed on mobile terminals, achieving high detection accuracy and efficiency. This advancement makes fully automated, high-precision AI-based detection possible.

articleTitle: Student classroom behavior detection based on YOLOv8 multi-modal fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the continuous development and improvement of intelligent education system, how to better apply artificial intelligence technology to classroom teaching scenes has practical significance. Based on the existing target recognition and detection network, the accuracy is low, the speed is slow, can not reflect the students’ classroom behavior in time. Therefore, a multi-mode fusion detection network based on YOLOv8n is proposed. First, several behaviors that are common in multi-group classrooms were identified, and the training data were obtained using online public data sets. Then, the depth features are extracted by convolutional layer, and the convolutional attention module (CBAM) is adopted. The detection mechanism can reduce the weight of background information in the recognition process, and the bidirectional feature pyramid network (BiFPN) module can extract the feature classification of different sizes. Finally, the results of multiple network experiments were merged with YOLOv8n to obtain the experimental data of students’ classroom behavior detection. Compared with different recognition networks, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified. Under the same training times as YOLOv8n, the mAP performance and recall rate of the multi-modal fusion student classroom behavior detection network are improved by 21% and 27%.

articleTitle: Research on Plant Leaf Disease Identification Based on a Long-Distance Feature Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Plant diseases cause significant global crop losses, making early detection crucial. Traditional deep learning models often neglect global context, reducing accuracy. To address this, we propose a ResNet50-based model with a long-distance feature enhancement module to capture global dependencies and focus on disease texture features. We also use disease patch augmentation to expand the dataset and address sample diversity issues. Transfer learning with pre-trained models boosts early stage performance. Our model achieves $\mathbf{99.58\%}$ accuracy on the PlantVillage dataset, outperforming DenseNet, ResNet50, MobileNet, and Inception V3 by $0.58\%-\mathbf{4.56\%}$, significantly enhancing plant disease identification accuracy.

articleTitle: A Power Forecasting Method in Multiple Time Scales Based on Attention Mechanism and Spatiotemporal Correlation Graph Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In power energy storage systems, accurate wind power forecasting is crucial for the efficient storage of energy and the optimization of power grid operations. Particularly for regions where wind energy serves as a primary energy source, its volatility and randomness pose challenges to the management of wind power energy storage. Traditional wind power forecasting methods generally regard the Multi-Step Power Forecasting (MPF) as a multi-variate time series prediction task and utilize conventional time series models to extract temporal correlations. Subsequently, scholars have employed Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to capture the spatial dependencies among wind turbines. However, these methods only model the spatial dependencies and temporal correlations of wind turbines separately, neglecting the wake effect of wind farms, the complex coupling spatiotemporal characteristics between different turbines at different time steps, and the distribution of wind turbine positions. In response to this issue, this paper proposes a wind power forecasting method based on attention mechanism and spatiotemporal correlation graph convolutional neural network (ASTCGCN) to capture spatiotemporal correlations. Firstly, the Euclidean distance between turbines within the area is calculated to construct a geographically aware graph. Secondly, by using a sliding window, spatial graphs at multiple time steps are merged to form a local spatiotemporal graph, where GCN is employed to simultaneously capture spatial dependencies, temporal correlations, and spatiotemporal associations. The self-attention mechanism is then utilized to integrate different local spatiotemporal graphs into a global feature representation. Finally, the superiority of the proposed method is validated based on real-world data.

articleTitle: Improved Hybrid A* algorithm for Autonomous Driving Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large search space and low computational efficiency of traditional $A *$ algorithm in the process of path search, this paper proposes an improved Hybrid A * algorithm fused with DL-IAPS algorithm for self-driving local path planning. By fusing the DL-IAPS algorithm with the Hybrid A * algorithm and modifying the weights of the distance approach algorithm to follow the warm start path, the optimal path planning for the self-driving car to avoid obstacles in the static obstacle scenarios is improved. The fastest path passing time in Scene 1 and Scene 2 are 31.24 s and 36.32 s, respectively, which is $29.50 \%$ higher than the path passing time before the improvement approximately. In addition, the optimized global path planning of the self-driving car has a smoother and more fluid route, and the speed of the driving process is more uniform than before, which improves the safety performance of the car driving.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Ship Supervision System Based on Lambda Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the increasing prosperity of the shipping industry, the vessel monitoring system has become increasingly important for improving the safety and operational efficiency of vessels. AIS (Automatic Identification System) provides real-time and accurate information for vessel monitoring by exchanging information such as vessel position, sailing speed, and heading. To achieve real-time vessel monitoring and deep mining of navigation data, an intelligent vessel monitoring system based on AIS data is designed and implemented. The system implements data processing based on the Lambda architecture, realizes offline analysis of navigation data through Spark + Hive, and realizes real-time processing of navigation data through Flink, which simultaneously satisfies the needs of offline and real-time data processing. The system builds a multi-level storage architecture based on technologies such as Redis, MySQL, HBase, and Hive, achieving different data storage and query requirements. The system realizes data visualization based on the front-end and backend separation technology, builds back-end interfaces through Spring Boot, and builds a visualization interface through technologies such as Vue, Echarts, and Mapbox. The intelligent vessel monitoring system can provide accurate vessel locations and navigation statuses in a timely manner, which helps prevent potential risks of vessels, promotes the advancement of vessel monitoring technology, and facilitates the sustainable development of the shipping industry.

articleTitle: Efficient privacy aggregation method based on zero-knowledge proofs in federated learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables distributed clients to privately train machine learning models using their own local data, thus avoiding the security risk of directly exchanging private data between clients and servers. However, there is a risk in federated learning: a malicious party may launch a reverse attack based on the parameters uploaded by the client to analyze the attributes of the client’s local private data. Some studies use the Shamir secret sharing method and zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP) to ensure the privacy and integrity of the inputs in FL. However, the Shamir secret sharing scheme often requires an optimistic guarantee on the number of malicious clients, which cannot obtain a sufficient number of secret slices through collusion, and the general ZKP scheme requires the clients to compute the proof belongs to others during the proof and verification stages, and its efficiency needs to be improved. In this paper, we propose VSSPFL method to achieve efficient and secure data collaboration, which improves the Shamir secret sharing scheme to prevent reverse attacks by an unknown number of malicious clients and reduces the cost of ZKP by using a probabilistic integrity check method.

articleTitle: Research on SMSP jamming Suppression Based on Matched Filtering in FrFT Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Smeared Spectrum (SMSP) jamming is an effective jamming type against Linear Frequency Modulation (LFM) radar. In this paper, aiming at the suppression of SMSP jamming, a method of SMSP jamming suppression based on fractional Fourier transform is proposed. The research on fractional filtering anti-SMSP jamming in this paper can provide some reference for the research on adaptive anti-jamming of LFM pulse compression radar.

Author Keywords: Fractional Fourier transform spectrum, Smeared Spectrum jamming, Matched filtering

articleTitle: Evaluation of ambient air quality grade based on cloud model and combination weighting method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of air quality grade evaluation, an evaluation method based on cloud model and combination weighting method is proposed. The evaluation indexes and the pollutant concentration limits for each quality grade are determined according to the Ambient Air Quality Standards in this method. In addition, the construction method of grade standard cloud based on the the pollutant concentration limits for each quality grade and the modeling method of pollution state cloud based on monitoring data are proposed. Secondly, the problem of determining the index weight is studied, and the best and worst method combined with the linear combination weighting method is used to determine the index weight. Finally, with the help of the weighted average model, the grade membership vectors of each index evaluation were synthesized, and the comprehensive quality grade was determined. The results of the case analysis of air quality evaluation in Tianjin verify the effectiveness and advancement of the method.

articleTitle: An Undersampling Method based on the Distance to Hyperplane for Highly Imbalanced Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Imbalanced classification is an important topic in the fields of data mining and machine learning because the models produced by most general learning algorithms are useless at identification of the minority samples. To solve this problem, Three categories of methods are proposed: oversampling, undersampling, and cost-sensitive learning. In this paper, a novel undersampling method based on the distance of the majority samples to the original classification hyperplane is presented. Specifically, An algorithm which belongs the method is presented. The algorithm can balance the datasets thoroughly and lead to deterministic undersampling results. To verify the effectiveness of our method, the comprehensive experiments are performed on 20 imbalanced datasets. Results show that our method is comparable to the classical undersampling methods and the latest PSU (Particle Stacking Undersampling).

articleTitle: Research on distributed power terminal access authentication technology based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed power technology, the safety and reliability of its access to the power grid have become increasingly prominent. This paper proposes a distributed power terminal access authentication technology based on blockchain technology, designs the authentication model, access authentication process and authentication algorithm in detail, and verifies the feasibility of the technology through the experimental process. By applying blockchain technology to the grid connection of distributed power sources, decentralized, safe and trustworthy authentication is achieved.

articleTitle: High-precision optical fiber sensor network operation state monitoring method based on LFM-OTDR
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that high-precision optical fiber sensor network operation state monitoring usually involves a variety of attack means and strategies, it is difficult to monitor, and a high-precision optical fiber sensor network operation state monitoring method based on LFM-OTDR is proposed. The problem of feature subset selection of high-precision optical fiber sensor network operation data is transformed into an optimization problem, and the operation state data is collected; The structure of LFM-OTDR sensor is constructed, and the validity of data transmission is calculated by using the slope of the fitted line on the LFM-OTDR image. The monitoring signal is received based on LFM-OTDR, and a brand-new differentiation coefficient is obtained according to this signal, so as to realize high-precision monitoring of the running state of optical fiber sensing network. The experimental results show that the false alarm rate of this method is small, the ROC curve is closer to the upper left corner of the coordinate axis, and the AUC value is larger, which has good monitoring effect.

articleTitle: Research on Software Defects Prediction and Peformance Analysis based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the rapid increase in the number of various types of software, the importance of software quality has become increasingly prominent, and software testing has become an indispensable part of the software development process. With the increasing demand for software testing, various emerging technologies have been introduced into the testing field, among which machine learning has gradually become the mainstream technology in software defect prediction due to its predictive model and scalability. In this work, we utilize XGBoost model for training and prediction. Specifically, data preprocessing including missing value processing and data standardization, followed by feature selection through statistical analysis and algorithmic methods to extract the most representative features. During the model training phase, grid search is used to optimize XGBoost’s hyperparameters, such as the number of trees, depth, and learning rate. During training, XGBoost improves prediction performance by gradually building a decision tree and minimizing the loss function. Finally, cross-validation and confusion matrix are used to evaluate the performance of the model to ensure high prediction accuracy and stability. Experimental analysis shows that the XGBoost model has excellent performance in prediction accuracy and performance, which effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of software defect detection.

articleTitle: Research on Network Public Opinion Combination Prediction Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In response to the difficulty of accurately predicting the three-stage evolution process of complex network public opinion using traditional single prediction models, this paper conducts research on the combination prediction method of network public opinion. Firstly, based on the evolution process of network public opinion, a three-stage mathematical model of incubation diffusion regression was constructed; Secondly, taking into account the characteristics of the Logistic model, exponential smoothing model, and grey prediction, a combination prediction model judgment matrix is constructed based on the scheme layer, and a network public opinion combination prediction method based on the analytic hierarchy process is proposed; Finally, taking the Pelosi hot topic public opinion event as an example, the accuracy and effectiveness of the combined prediction algorithm in public opinion prediction were verified.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Decoupling Mechanism of Multi-bus Function in TCMS System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: For multi-bus application scenarios of train TCMS system, the principles and challenges of existing TCMS application software development platforms are analyzed. The platform drivers and the decoupling strategy of application software are researched, TCMS application software development platform architecture which is suitable for multi-bus scenarios is designed, and the multi-bus functionality of the platform is implemented. The actual application situation shows that the TCMS application software development platform designed in this article can significantly shorten the TCMS system development cycle, reduce system development costs, and improve system reliability. The platform designed in this article is suitable for widespread promotion in transportation fields such as railway and magnetically levitated train, and has good development prospects.

articleTitle: Efficient Detection of UAV Image Based on Self-Attention and Global Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) image object detection has gamered significant attention in fields such as intelligent transportation, urban management, and agricultural monitoring. However, it faces key challenges, including deficiencies in multi-scale feature extraction and inaccuracies when processing complex scenes and small-sized targets. To address these issues, we propose a novel UAV image object detection network, named SGF-Net, which is based on self-attention guidance and global feature fusion. First, to optimize feature extraction from a global perspective and enhance target localization precision, we introduce the global feature extraction module (GFEM). This module utilizes the self-attention mechanism to capture and integrate long-range dependencies within images. Second, we develop a normal distribution-based prior assigner (NDPA) that measures the resemblance between ground truth and priors, thereby improving the precision of target position matching and addressing the problem of inaccurate localization of small targets. Furthermore, we design an attention-guided ROI pooling module (ARPM) using a deep fusion strategy of multilevel features to optimize the integration of multi-scale features and improve the quality of feature representation. Finally, experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed SGF-Net approach.

articleTitle: A dual-view point cloud registration method based on graph neural network - reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In the process of aligning the point cloud acquired from swaying dual unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), to address the difficulty of synchronizing point cloud data with pose data which leads to insufficient labeled data for training deep learning model, we propose a dual-view point cloud registration method based on graph neural network - reinforcement learning (GNN-RL). In the forward propagation, we firstly employ GNN to extract high-dimensional semantic features separately from point clouds captured from two USVs. Subsequently, we utilize a multi-layer perceptions (MLP) combined with a sampling process using Gaussian distribution to estimate six real pose angles, and adjust the point cloud positions accordingly. In the backward propagation, we use the change in overlap between the pre- and post-rotated dual-view point clouds as feedback. The feedback, combined with RL, facilitates the unsupervised training of the registration model of the dual-view point clouds. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves high accuracy in point cloud registration and exhibits high practicality.

articleTitle: Queueing analysis of vehicle-driven signal control models at intersection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel vehicle-driven intelligent traffic control model is proposed, assuming that the time interval of vehicle arrivals at an intersection obeys Markov, aiming to effectively alleviate vehicular congestion at intersections. The model combines inter-vehicle communication technology and intelligent transportation system, and dynamically adjusts the switching time and phase length of signals by real-time monitoring of inbound and outbound traffic at the intersection, to maximize the capacity of the intersection. By establishing an intersection vehicle-driven intelligent control model and performing queuing analysis based on the model, key indicators such as vehicle queue leader and delay time are solved. Numerical experiments are conducted to simulate the queue lengths and delays under different traffic flow conditions as well as various performance indicators to evaluate the effectiveness of the vehicle-driven signal control model in reducing traffic congestion. And the results show that the vehicle-driven signal control model has significant advantages in reducing traffic congestion and improving traffic efficiency compared with the traditional signal control model.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Optimization Scheme Based Backdoor Attack DPBA in Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning approach that enables participants to federally train a global model without disclosing private information. However, FL’s dispersed nature and direct access to data introduce new security issues, especially backdoor attacks. In this case, the attacker injects the backdoor into the global model during training while maintaining the accuracy of the global model, to affect the classification results for only a small number of data points. Although some backdoor attack models are currently having some success, these successes are based on less realistic assumptions, such as the need for the attacker to be in control of a sufficient number of clients or to know the data distribution of otherwise honest clients. In addition, in many cases, injected backdoor triggers are often visually easy to detect. If backdoor triggers are removed from the training process, the backdoor effect is quickly diluted. How to address the stealthy and persistent nature of backdoor attacks is a long-standing and urgent problem. To solve these problems, we propose a new dynamic backdoor attack method DPBA in FL. DPBA approximates the prediction of future dynamic updates of the global model by a global model based on the forgotten backdoor, which first learns a backdoor generation trigger model, then optimizes that trigger with the predicted global model, and finally injects the generated backdoor into the global model to poison it. The dynamic prediction produced by this optimization method allows the generated model to be closer to the real one, i.e., it can reduce the distance between the poisonous and normal models, which allows for better stealth and extending the backdoor’s existence. Finally, we assess the proposed attack model on numerous benchmark datasets (which include MNIST, CIFAR-10, and Tiny ImageNet). The results show that we proposed the attack model can bypass existing mainstream backdoor defenses, obtain a high attack success rate, and achieve a more persistent backdoor effect than other backdoor attacks.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Learning-Based Differential Evolution for Mixed-Variable Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Mixed-variable optimization problems (MVOPs) involve both discrete and continuous decision variables which lead to a lot of difficulties solving these problems. In this paper, a hybrid differential evolution for MVOPs, termed HDEmv, is proposed. In HDEmv, K-means clustering is used for learning population structure so that promising mating parents for each individual can be selected. Moreover, an operator pool with adaptive parameters is constructed to produce offspring and a simple local search method is employed to fine tune the discrete variables. In experiments, HDEmv is compared with four promising algorithms on 28 MVOPs and the final results reflect that HDEmv is a competitive method for MVOPs.

articleTitle: VLDNet:Spinal Vertebrae Landmark Detection with Adjacent Point Iterative Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Scoliosis is a prevalent structural deformity of the spine, and accurately locating vertebral keypoints from X-ray images is a fundamental step in clinical spinal diagnosis and treatment. In recent years, deep learning-based methods for automatic detection of vertebral keypoints have made significant progress. However, effectively utilizing spinal structure information from X -ray images and addressing errors in landmark detection and whether keypoints pairing is performed correctly remain challenging. This paper proposes a novel deep learning architecture called Spinal Vertebrae Landmark Detection with Adjacent Point Iterative Correction (VLD-Net), along with a patching mechanism based on adjacent point offsets and employs a method that integrates offset maps and heatmaps to enhance landmark localization accuracy. Additionally, the spine symmetry offset distance loss designed in this paper aims to further improve the accuracy and robustness of keypoint detection. Experimental results demonstrate that this method exhibits superior performance on the AASCE challenge dataset compared to other methods, providing strong support for medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Develop a liquid level detection algorithm for infusion bottles based on Ghost-YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In view of the problems of weak anti-interference ability, low detection accuracy and high algorithm complexity that make it difficult to ensure real-time performance in current infusion bottle level detection methods, this paper proposes an infusion bottle level detection method based on the Ghost-YOLOv4 model. First, the collected infusion bottle level image sample data is enhanced to improve the versatility of the sample data, and the Labelimg tool is used to annotate the images and create data sets. Then, the lightweight Ghost main network structure is used to replace the CSPDarkenet53 main network structure of the original YOLOv4 model, thereby reducing the number of model parameters and improving the detection speed. Secondly, the regression box loss function of the Ghost-YOLOv4 model is optimized to reduce the impact of excessive linear calculations after replacing the main network, resulting in the loss of some feature information, on the detection accuracy, thereby improving the detection accuracy. Finally, the experimental results show that the improved Ghost-YOLOv4 model has about 85% fewer parameters than the original YOLOv4 model, and the detection speed is increased by about 115%. The Ghost-YOLOv4 model with optimized loss function has higher recognition frame positioning accuracy, which can provide better technical support for the automatic, high-quality and rapid detection of liquid level in infusion bottles.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Cooperative Scheduling of RMG, Quay Crane and AGV
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To solve the loading and unloading problems of RMG (Rail Mounted Gantry), quay crane and AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle), this paper proposes a hierarchical cooperative scheduling algorithm. Firstly, the operation task is converted into 2 parts: the vertical equipment and the horizontal one, which can be regarded as the passenger and the taxi, i.e., named as the ride-hailing problem. We introduce the Hungarian algorithm to accomplish the matching of the task and the AGV. Secondly, the overall tasks of the equipment are transformed into planning paths, and then each equipment can execute it respectively. Here the global optimization should be considered. Finally, after the planning paths are truncated, we design a novel Markov random field model for the global optimization, aiming at the efficiency and safety of all equipment. In experiments, the effectiveness of our algorithm is verified by the simulation and real tests. The performance of safety and efficiency has strong promotion significance in new terminals and old reconstructed ones.

articleTitle: Prediction of Cognitive Impairment in Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Using an Ensemble Model Based on Gait Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The aim of this study is to develop a predictive model for cognitive function in patients with cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) using gait parameters to provide an early, objective and accurate assessment of the risk of cognitive impairment in CSVD patients. By combining predictions from multiple base models, the ensemble model significantly improved predictive performance. These findings not only enrich research on the relationship between CSVD and cognitive impairment, but also provide a theoretical basis for further exploration of early intervention and treatment based on gait analysis.

articleTitle: Improvement of PRM algorithm based on lazy collision idea
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of PRM algorithm, such as the lack of orientation in the selection of sampling points, the excessive number of sampling points, and the long convergence time of the algorithm, an improved probabilistic map algorithm (Restricted sampling area and Lazy collision, RL_PRM) based on the restricted sampling area and Lazy collision is proposed. The algorithm generates random sampling points in an elliptical area near the main axis of the map endpoint, and adopts the lazy collision strategy to generate the initial path. After judging whether the initial path traverses the interior of the obstacle, if there is a traversal situation, additional nodes are generated on the outside of the convex edge of the obstacle and added to the roadmap G(V, E), the collision nodes and the connecting lines are deleted, and the path is queried again to obtain the final path. Simulation results show that compared with the PRM* algorithm and PRM_Astar algorithm, the RL_PRM algorithm has a faster convergence speed and a shorter convergence path, and can still find the effective optimal path quickly while reducing the number of sampling points to a large extent.

articleTitle: Patent Image Recognition and Classification System based on Object Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the rapid growth of patent applications, it is a time-consuming and cumbersome task to view and analyse large amounts of image data by hand. Therefore, an intelligent automatic classification system for attached images is particularly important. In this paper, we design a patent attachment recognition and classification system based on Yolov8 target detection algorithm. It can not only achieve real-time image classification, but also achieve automatic labelling of patent images. At the same time, a new backbone network combining AKconv and iRMB is proposed to improve the accuracy rate from 84.3% to 88.9% significantly. In addition, a UI interface is designed to facilitate the classification and detection of patents by making it easier to classify and detect patents while at the same time counting the number of various categories. This system is of great significance for improving the efficiency of patent examination and management, not only improving the overall patent classification, but also providing a new direction for structured image database conception and design.

articleTitle: A study of code search technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The expansion of open-source communities like Github and Stack Overflow has led to an abundance of high-quality code snippets and engineering projects, driving advancements in the domain of code search. This section specifically examines code search, which involves retrieving code that matches a given natural language query by effectively capturing semantic similarities between the query and the code. Deep learning, known for its ability to extract intricate semantic information, has emerged as a powerful tool in this domain. Recent advancements have seen the application of various deep learning techniques, such as graph neural networks and pre-trained models, to code search, resulting in significant progress. Deep learning has now become the predominant approach in code search. This paper thoroughly investigates code search techniques, akin to model search techniques, and provides a comprehensive overview of deep learning-based code search methodologies.

articleTitle: Dynamic Foreground Perception Correlation Filter with Spatiotemporal Regularization Term
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In response to the problem of poor tracking accuracy and susceptibility to temporal degradation in the presence of similar background interference in existing correlated filtering object tracking algorithms, a dynamic foreground perception correlation filter with spatiotemporal regularization term is proposed. Firstly, incorporating a temporal regularizer on the basis of DRCF to alleviate the problem of model temporal degradation; Secondly, a anomaly perception function is proposed, which uses a Kalman filter to correct the current frame tracking result when the correlation filter tracking result is unreliable. Finally, comparative experiments were conducted on the OTB-50 and OTB-100 datasets with various representative correlation filtering tracking algorithms. The experimental results showed that the algorithm proposed in this paper has good tracking performance, achieving a tracking speed of 49.18 fps.
