articleTitle: Semantic Constraint-Based Knowledge Representation Learning for Knowledge Graph Completion
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Knowledge graph completion aims to predict missing fact based on observed facts. Many studies on knowledge graph completion based on semantic constraints revolve around knowledge representation learning and have achieved good results. However, most classical models for graph completion based on representation learning only consider the network structural features of the graph, which means that the rich textual information of the knowledge graph is not effectively utilized. At the same time, there are also some studies that only use textual information for completion, but they lose the structural features of the graph while having high computational complexity. In response to this situation, a text-constrained representation learning model is proposed, which is based on the extraction of excellent structural features using graph convolutional neural networks. The textual representations of entity descriptions obtained by pre-trained language models are used for relevance calculation to constrain aggregation bias for knowledge graph completion. The experimental results also demonstrate the effectiveness of this model. Knowledge representation learning for knowledge graph completion.

articleTitle: Research on the advantages of legs and tracks collaborative path planning based on improved A* and obstacle avoidance
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To solve the problem of path planning and obstacle avoidance difficulties in complex and changing construction environments, this study proposes a legs and tracks collaborative path planning method. This method combines the improved $A^{*}$ algorithm and the hierarchical obstacle avoidance strategy realized by a new legs and tracks construction robot. The improved $A^{*}$ algorithm can fully consider the size and collision problems of the robot and improve the path finding efficiency compared to the traditional $A^{*}$ algorithm. The hierarchical obstacle avoidance strategy divides obstacles into crossable and non-crossable types in order to apply different obstacle avoidance strategies. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method applied to the legs and tracks construction robot are verified by constructing simple and complex construction scene simulations using Unity-3D. The simple scene simulation results show that the improved $A^{*}$ algorithm can identify impassable obstacles, and the efficiency of the hierarchical obstacle avoidance strategy is increased by 27.14%. The complex scene simulation results show that the efficiency of the hierarchical obstacle avoidance strategy is increased by 32.80%.

articleTitle: Parameter identification modeling study of particle size distribution model of UA disk crusher mill
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that it is difficult to theoretically derive the discharge size distribution model for the UA disk mill grinding system, and the model accuracy is not enough due to incomplete consideration of the influencing factors, this paper determines the optimal working condition of the UA disk mill on the basis of a large number of experiments in the grinding process of the UA disk mill, and researches to take the grain size distribution of the ore feed, the feeding speed and the feeding quantity as the inputs of the external factors, and the discharge size of the internal factors as the inputs, to establish the discharge size distribution model for the UA disk mill and to identify the corresponding parameters. The study is based on the identification test with the inputs of ore feed grade distribution, feed rate and feed volume as its external factors, the inputs of internal factors of UA disc mill discharge gap size and the outputs of discharge grade distribution, and the modeling and corresponding parameter identification are carried out to establish a model of discharge grade distribution of UA disc crusher mill. By comparing the model output with the actual output curve, the FPE value is: 1.44 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, the MSE value is: 1.011 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, and the best fitting accuracy value is 87.93%, which indicates that the model has high accuracy and provides a theoretical basis for the process control of the UA disk crusher mill.

articleTitle: Enhanced Network Model Based on Bidirectional Feature Pyramid and Dynamic Convolution: BiDC-YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper presents an improved YOLOv5s network model, BiDC-YOLO, to boost the precision and speed of identifying defects in printed circuit boards (PCB). Evaluation employing the PKU-Market-PCB dataset revealed that BiDCYOLO achieved a mAP50 of 93. 8% and a recall rate of 92. 4% while maintaining low computational demands (FLOPs at 15.8) and high detection speed (FPS at 33.8). The results indicate that the proposed model, BiDC-YOLO, meets the requirements for industrial-level PCB defect detection and exhibits better detection performance and practicality compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: A method for maize pest detection based on improved YOLO-v9 model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Maize plays a crucial role in the global agricultural industry and is vital for both the economic stability of the agricultural sector and the overall security of the world’s food supply. However, the frequent occurrence of diseases and pests in crops has led to significant reductions in agricultural productivity. To improve the identification of essential features, we propose a method for detecting maize pests. This method uses an advanced YOLOv9 model that incorporates the Programmable Gradient Information (PGI) and the Generalized Efficient Layer Aggregation Network (GELAN). At the same time, We introduced the multi-scale spatial pyramid attention mechanism (MSPA) module, which enhances the model’s ability to extract features by capturing hierarchical information of multi-scale spatial data at a more detailed level using hierarchical residual connections. The performance of this model is evaluated using the widely accepted IP102 dataset, which is a large-scale dataset specifically designed for pest detection. We utilized a total of 3,480 photographs and employed 11 distinct categories in order to train and assess the pest species that posed the greatest harm to maize crops. Based on empirical evidence, our proposed method surpasses the most sophisticated target identification algorithms, with a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 96.3%. This technology effectively reduces financial losses in maize crops by accurately and promptly detecting and identifying pests.

articleTitle: Research on energy consumption optimization of trains based on improved immune algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To address the further energy-saving optimization problem of high-speed trains, an energy-saving optimization method based on Levy flight immune genetic algorithm is proposed. This method optimizes the population locally through adaptive Levy flight strategy to improve the global optimization ability of immune genetic algorithm. Under the premise of considering the regenerative braking energy of the train, a train energy-saving operation optimization model is established with the minimum energy consumption as the optimization objective. Using the train homogenization bar model, for both general speed limits and temporary speed limits, the energy consumption of the train is optimized. Finally, based on the real line data from Hefei Station to Huainan East Station, the $\mathrm{CRH}_{3 C}$ high-speed train parameters are used for simulation. The results show that compared with the unoptimized running curve of the train, it can save 8.2% and 6.4% energy in two situations respectively. Comparing this method with sparrow search algorithm, dung beetle optimizer and immune genetic algorithm, the energy-saving effect is better, verifying the effectiveness and robustness of this optimization method. The research results provide reference for optimizing the energy consumption of high-speed train operation.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Computer Graphics and Image Processing Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the increasing application of solar energy, the quality of solar cells has become a focal point of attention. Traditional solar cell defect detection methods have relatively low accuracy, which seriously affects the effectiveness of defect detection. To address this issue, a defect detection method based on computer image processing and deep learning is proposed. This method enhances the collected solar cell images through global histogram equalization and trains a convolutional neural network model for defect prediction. The results show that the proposed method can achieve an average accuracy of 92.96%, a precision of 89.63%, a recall of 88.10%, and an F1 score of 88.71% for identifying damage, streaks, and normal types. The relatively high accuracy of defect recognition can provide a reference for the automated detection of solar cell defects.

articleTitle: A Novel Scheme Based on Optimization of Nodes Geometry for 5G Positioning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Nodes geometry can significantly influence the performance of 5 G positioning systems, it is hence crucial to optimize the nodes geometry to enhance the accuracy of positioning. This paper proposes a multi-level positioning scheme based on optimization of nodes geometry. Compared with conventional method, it improves the performance of locating obviously. In routine method, GDOP is used to evaluate the quality of nodes geometry. And this paper also provides a new scheme to judge the geometry. It reduces the system complexity distinctly, and only brings minor accuracy loss.

articleTitle: EMD-KPCA-BO-BILSTM: A Novel Hybrid Approach for Photovoltaic Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Predicting photovoltaic power is crucial for optimizing the efficient utilization of renewable energy and ensuring the stable operation of the power system. This paper proposes an innovative photovoltaic power prediction method, utilizing Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory networks (BILSTM) as the foundational model and integrating Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), enhanced Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA), and Bayesian Optimization (Bo) algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of FPGA-based Accelerator for Cattle Posture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Currently, deploying convolutional neural networks on mobile devices faces challenges such as high computational resource consumption, excessive energy usage, and large model sizes. In response to these issues, this paper proposes a reusable FPGA hardware accelerator architecture based on overlapped data streams for the YOLOv5 target recognition network. Firstly, adjustments and quantization are applied to the network structure and parameters. Secondly, dedicated acceleration units are designed for each operator in the network. In addition, various strategies such as parallel computing, loop tiling, loop restructuring, and hardware-software co-design are also utilized. The results of this experiment were validated on the self-made cattle posture dataset’s test set. The findings indicate that this approach achieves a computational performance of 12.24 GFLPS on the ZYNQ7Z030 platform, with a design power consumption of 3.35 W, an efficiency of $3.65 \mathrm{GOPS} / \mathrm{W}$, and an energy efficiency ratio 28 times that of the R7-6800H CPU and 3 times that of the RTX2060 GPU.

articleTitle: UNet-AFF: U-Net based on attention feature fusion for COVID-19 focus segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In response to the limitations of conventional U-Net in fusing high- and low-level features in automatic segmentation of neocoronal pneumonia foci, this paper proposes an attention feature fusion-based segmentation model for U-Net pneumonia foci. The model incorporates an attention feature fusion module in the decoding stage of the network for the purpose of integrating high- and low-level features. The attention feature fusion module is designed to focus on and emphasise the effective expression of features when they are fused through the attention mechanism. This helps the network to integrate the semantic information and spatial details of features at different layers, thereby improving the accuracy of the network’s decoding. Finally, this paper presents experimental results on the COVID19 CT lung infection segmentation dataset with new crown pneumonia foci. The results demonstrate that the improved segmentation model in this paper can effectively improve the segmentation performance for new crown pneumonia foci.

articleTitle: Video Compression Model: Compress the features
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Works such as MiniGPT-4 and BLIP-2 utilized large language models for multimodal vision-language domain, referred to as Large Vision-Language Models. Large Vision-Language Models excel not only in their generative ability but also in their capacity to comprehend content, thus broadening the scope of multimodal vision-language tasks. Recent works, such as One-Peace and BEiT-3, have employed Mixture-of-Experts to enhance the learning of modality features and improve Large VisionLanguage Models performance. The above approach is effective for the Video Question Answering task, but it has limitations. Specifically, video has an additional temporal dimension compared to pictures, and its input scale is much larger than that of other modalities. These factors can lead to challenges when using transformer architectures. Scaling down the video input will undoubtedly result in information loss and reduced accuracy. Currently, there is no widely accepted solution for reducing computation without sacrificing accuracy. Thus, the Large VisionLanguage Models’ accuracy for Video Question Answering task requires improvement, and the Video Question Answering models still face challenges when processing long videos. We propose a compressed-feature LVLM that includes a feature compression module based on Mamba. This module can limit video memory usage to an acceptable level while preserving information and minimizing the impact on accuracy. As a result, Our model achieves an accuracy of 78.4% in MSVD-Zero-Shot-QA and 69.8% in MSRVTT-Zero-Shot-QA.

articleTitle: Birdsong recognition method based on Mel spectrogram and YOLO-BEM
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Monitoring the state and trends of bird diversity in ecosystems is a major challenge that requires widely applicable machine learning-based bird song recognition algorithms. When dealing with the spectrum data set, some traditional classifiers have some limitations in overcoming noise interference and improving the stability of recognition algorithm because the spectrum data show various and peculiar features, the choice of kernel function is limited, and the feature scaling and noise are sensitive. Aiming at the problems of bird audio noise, high similarity of feature extraction maps, and irregular curvature of image features and low recognition accuracy, this paper adopts YOLOv8-BEM based on progress learning to detect and identify birds by using voiceprint. According to the characteristics of voiceprint, this paper proposes a bird voiceprint extraction adaptation module (BEM). Special convolution (DSC) and attention channel (MLLA) were added to the CF2 module in its backbone network, special convolution was performed on important channel data in the branch, and the extraction gradient flow of full-scale jump connection was added to rebuild the network feature extraction ability and improve the model detection accuracy. The proposed model is verified on five bird datasets, and the precision, recall and F1 score are 95.02%, 90.35% and 92.59% respectively, which are better than other comparison models.

articleTitle: Modeling analysis of passenger-taxi matching queueing at taxi stands in transportation hubs
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In today’s rapidly developing intelligent transportation system field, the operation efficiency of passenger transportation hubs, such as taxi stands at airports and railway stations, as key nodes of the urban transportation network, directly affects the travel experience of passengers and the overall smoothness of urban transportation. However, due to the strong correlation between passenger and taxi arrivals at transportation hubs and the high degree of randomness, the phenomenon of a large number of passenger arrivals but the supply of taxis failing to meet the passenger demand or the accumulation of taxis with less passenger demand may occur. In order to characterize the effects of multiple uncertainties on passenger-taxi matching queues at transportation hubs, this research develops a passenger-taxi queueing model based on the Markov arrival process. By analyzing the passenger and taxi queues under the conditions of adjusting the capacity of taxi stand and the arrival rate of passengers and taxis, this research describes the influence of different factors on the queueing performance of the system. The results of the numerical experiments show that even under the same passenger and taxi arrival rates, there are different levels of impacts on passenger and taxi queues due to taxi stand capacity constraints. In particular, different correlation arrivals also have a significant impact on passenger and taxi.

articleTitle: ODFKG-A: Object Detection Fused with Knowledge Graph Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In recent years, object detection technology has been widely applied in fields such as autonomous driving, underwater navigation, and security monitoring. Although modern object detectors can accurately represent the features of each region, recognizing occluded or small objects in large-scale multi-category scenarios remains challenging. This paper proposes Object Detection Fused with Knowledge Graph Based on Attention Mechanism (ODFKG-A). The method utilizes attention mechanism to emphasize important inter-channel relationships, enriching image feature information, and leverages knowledge graph for reasoning to further enhance features for each category. This model achieves detection accuracies of 80.8% on the VOC2007 test set and 56% on the COCO2017 validation set. These results demonstrate that combining a knowledge graph with an attention mechanism can effectively improve the performance of object detectors in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Sound classification method based on the novel direct convolutional neural network model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Automatic sound classification is widely used in engineering, especially with the development of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models. In this paper, a new direct-CNN model was proposed to utilize the self-learning of CNN to classify the artificial voice from recording conversations. The proposed model had the advantage of simple architecture and comparative classification accuracy compared with the state-of-art Two-Stream CNN model in common datasets. When applied to the real recording conversation dataset, performance of the proposed model was proved to be satisfactory.

articleTitle: Altitude control of UAV sea-skimming flight in ground effect area based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of wave and ground effect disturbance in the low-altitude sea-skimming flight of UAV, an altitude control method of Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC) was proposed. Based on the analysis of the UAV, wave, ground effect and sea surface wind models, the ADRC control of the inner pitch loop and the outer altitude loop of the UAV is constructed, and the extended state observer is introduced to estimate the interference in the flight process in real time and the input compensation of each channel. The simulation results show that, compared with the traditional PID control method, the ADRC control method can significantly improve the altitude control performance of UAV flying over the sea, and has strong robustness to uncertain interference.

articleTitle: MSGNN: Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network for Molecular Property Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In the field of quantum chemistry, predicting molecular properties (such as solubility) is an important research topic that plays a significant role in advancing various fields, including drug design and material discovery. However, traditional methods based on density functional theory (DFT) in physics are time-consuming and less accurate when predicting a large number of molecular properties. Recent studies have shown that Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) can effectively process molecular graphs, thus accomplishing this task more efficiently. However, traditional Graph Neural Networks have certain limitations in information aggregation, as they can only aggregate information from nodes within a specific neighborhood size, and the information obtained by nodes from neighboring nodes may be incomplete. To address this issue, we propose a multi-scale Graph Neural Network model (MSGNN). By setting distance thresholds to obtain neighbor node information at different scales, and then integrating information from different scales for updates, we can more accurately predict the properties of molecules. We have validated the effectiveness of the model on the QM9 dataset, and the experimental results show that compared with a series of previous benchmark models, our method has made significant improvements on multiple indicators.

articleTitle: A Multi-keyword Fuzzy Ciphertext Sorting Retrieval Scheme Based on Cloud Servers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud storage and cloud computing services, more and more individuals and enterprises choose to upload data to cloud servers for storage. To ensure data privacy and security, data is encrypted locally. Searchable encryption (SE) technology enables retrieval of encrypted data. This article uses the ASPE algorithm to design a multi-keyword fuzzy ciphertext sorting retrieval extension scheme based on cloud servers. Firstly, a document vector based on keyword partitioning was generated, and efficiency was improved through hierarchical retrieval on two cloud servers. Secondly, combined with the retrieval requirements of railway engineering data, a consistency check bit is designed using hash functions to compare the retrieved data, ensuring its correctness consistently. In the enhancement scheme, the concept of chaos and unilateral inverse matrixes are introduced to enhance the security of the key and make it suitable for multi-user scenarios. Finally, security analysis and time complexity comparison demonstrate that the ERFMS scheme is secure and efficient.

articleTitle: Web Malicious Request Identification Based on k-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Cybersecurity issues are becoming more and more serious in the Internet era, and malicious requests are the main threat. In order to effectively deal with this problem, this study uses the K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm to conduct an in-depth study of the KDD CUP dataset. By converting character features into numerical features and normalizing the data, we successfully simplify the complex data into a form that can be understood by the model. The dataset is divided into training and testing sets for model training and evaluation to ensure the accuracy of the results. Eventually, we built an efficient malicious request detection model, which brings new insights and solutions to the field of network security protection.

articleTitle: Ridulls: An RFID-based Unsteady Liquid Level Sensing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Liquid level sensing has proven to be invaluable in many fields and has garnered significant interest from both industries and academics. Nevertheless, when using this technology in real-world scenarios, it is unavoidable to come across liquid levels that are unsteady over time. This leads to significant variations in the data collected by the level sensing system, thereby impacting its accuracy. Thus, finding efficient methods to handle the dynamic liquid level condition and enhance the stability and dependability of liquid level sensing technology is a crucial issue. This paper proposes an RFID-based, non-invasive liquid level sensing algorithm named Ridulls. The algorithm uses MODWT to analyze consecutively acquired tag RSSI values and extract the trend term, followed by zero-frequency amplitude information using DFT. By detecting changes in the amplitude information, it enables rapid and non-destructive liquid level sensing. The experimental findings demonstrate that Ridulls has the capability to provide fast and efficient liquid level sensing at the millimeter scale, even in dynamic situations. This offers a novel alternative to further improve liquid level monitoring technology.

articleTitle: Improved Hand to Eye Calibration Scheme of Robot-Laser Scanning System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This article study an eye-to-hand calibration scheme for a robotic scanning system. In our study, we analysed the limitations and sources of error of the traditional eye-in-hand calibration method, then calibrated the scanner consisting of the slide and the laser camera, proposed a non-linear calibration algorithm based on Ceres to calibrate between the scanner and the robotic arm, and applied Ceres to the point cloud fitting. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the improved calibration scheme proposed in this paper reaches 0.0294 mm, and the splicing of the residual point cloud is completed using the calibrated system, which enables the robotic laser scanning system to plan and locate more accurately in complex environments, providing strong support for the autonomous navigation and operation of the robot.

articleTitle: A model for image super-resolution based on Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Biological evolution has deepened our understanding of nature. Since the advent of civilization, humans have continually explored ways to record what they see and hear, from cave sketches to camera photography, with clarity being a consistent goal. Image super-resolution technology has made significant progress, but early methods like interpolation and filtering couldn’t effectively restore details. Traditional convolution methods require high computational and storage resources, limiting their use in hardware-constrained scenarios. Therefore, finding a method that reduces computational resources while ensuring effectiveness is crucial. This paper proposes the Residual Swin Transformer Block based on the Swin Transformer and designs the SR-Swin deep learning model for super-resolution image processing. Experiments show it achieves an average PSNR value of 30.6 dB, indicating good performance.

articleTitle: Smulation optimisation of a seven-electrode conductivity cell
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to improve the measurement performance of the seven-electrode conductivity sensor, this study focuses on the influence of the electrode spacing on the electric field distribution, current density, and polarisation effect, and explores the operating characteristics of the conductivity cell under different voltage electrode spacings through simulation and experimental validation, aiming to find out the optimal electrode spacing, reduce the polarisation effect, and improve the measurement accuracy of the conductivity. In this study, the basic simulation model of a seven-electrode conductivity cell was constructed, and simulations were carried out in seawater with different conductivities by changing the electrode spacing to analyse the effects of electrode spacing on current density, electric field distribution, and polarisation intensity, and the results show that when the spacing is in the range of 2.8 mm to 4.0 mm, the value of the current density is small and basically stable and unchanged, and the value of the current density decreases, which is conducive to the reduction of the polarisation effect and the improve the measurement accuracy. Based on the simulation results, the voltage electrode spacing of 3.8 mm was selected as the optimised electrode spacing, and the effect of the structural optimisation was verified by experimental comparison. The experimental data showed that the optimised seven-electrode conductivity sensor (labelled D3.8mm) reduced its error in measuring conductivity by about 68.6% and 27.9% at 20°C and 5°C, respectively, compared to the unoptimised sevenelectrode conductivity sensor (D2.0mm). This confirms that a reasonable adjustment of the electrode spacing can significantly improve the measurement performance of the sensor. In summary, this study has identified the optimal electrode spacing through simulation optimisation design, which reduces the polarisation effect and improves the measurement accuracy of the conductivity sensor.

articleTitle: Design of a universal air-cooled heat dissipation system for rack-mounted servers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of world informatization and digitization, the demand for high-performance rack mounted servers in the market is constantly increasing. And the hardware design direction of servers is moving towards miniaturization and high-density to continuously improve the performance characteristics. This design direction has led to increasingly poor cooling performance of high-power hardware chips in increasingly compact spaces, which has directly affected the stability of server operation. To solve this hidden danger, this paper has designed a universal air-cooled cooling system applied to rack mounted servers, and has designed a server heat dissipation testing platform to verify the heat dissipation effect. The specific design: the baseboard management controller obtains the temperature situation of various parts in the working device and timely controls the fans’ speed based on the highest temperature to force the export of heat. The purpose of cooling the entire machine will be achieved. The high load operation test of servers under normal and high temperature conditions has been designed to verify the heat dissipation effect of the heat dissipation system designed in this paper. The experimental results indicate that the air-cooled heat dissipation system designed in this paper can effectively reduce the overall temperature of servers operating at high loads in high-temperature environments and ensure the stability of server operation.

articleTitle: SCMamba: A Space Correction State Space Model for Image Restoration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Recent advancements in image restoration (IR) have shown that CNNs and Transformers yield impressive results. However, existing IR methods often suffer from limited receptive fields, high computational complexity, leading to insufficient global representation of the restored images and unacceptable computational costs. Inspired by linear complexity and global receptive field of the State Space Model (SSM), we integrate Mamba to IR tasks for learning long-term dependencies with global receptive fields at a linear computational cost. We propose the Space Correction Mamba (SCMamba) framework, which leverages a global receptive field for long-term pixel context modeling to restore more image details. Experiments on the public datasets Set5, Set14 and Urban100 show that SCMamba achieves highly competitive results.

articleTitle: Exploration of an Intelligent Research Support Platform for Environmental Monitoring Big Data Based on Data Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: At present, China is comprehensively promoting the construction of environmental big data platform, but there are few to explore the construction of scientific research cloud platform from the perspective of supporting environmental scientific research. Based on the review of the research status of environmental big data platform at home and abroad and the investigation of environmental big data research support platform, it is concluded that the research platform should have the main functions of supporting multi-source heterogeneous data integration, interactive cooperation experiment and data visualization. Based on the concept of XaaS, the framework of Environmental monitoring is constructed. The key technologies needed for the platform include multi-source heterogeneous data integration technology, Web service technology and data visualization and human-computer interaction technology. Huanyuan big data scientific research cloud platform developed under this framework has shown certain results.

articleTitle: Facial-sketch Synthesis Based on Channel Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Traditional and existing face sketch synthesis methods have blurry details, low definition and poor effectiveness. To deal with these problems, a facial-sketch synthesis method based on channel attention mechanism is proposed. Firstly, an improved residual network structure based on the channel attention mechanism is introduced into the generator the enhance the performance of image features. Then, the generative network and the discriminative network are fully adversarial trained by introducing the coefficient factor of adversarial loss function, and the final sketch face images is synthesized. The comparison experiments on the CUHK and FS2K face sketch database prove that the proposed method can generate more detailed features and clearer sketch face images.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Multi-Source Radar Information Fusion Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-source radar information fusion technology grounded in digital twin technology, considering the future development trajectories of radar information fusion and the current status and advancements in digital twin technology. It systematically examines the specific applications of digital twin technology in multi-source radar information fusion, encompassing system architecture design, data acquisition and processing, real-time simulation and prediction, fault diagnosis, and health management. Additionally, the potential applications of digital twin technology in fault diagnosis and health management within the context of multi-source radar information fusion are explored, proposing data-driven preventive maintenance strategies to further enhance system reliability and maintainability. The paper also identifies challenges such as high-precision modeling, data transmission, and processing efficiency in the application of digital twin technology within multi-source radar information fusion, providing reference directions for future development.

articleTitle: A Domain Specific Formal Modeling and Analysis Method for Itemized Requirements in Avionics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the functional requirements becoming increasingly complex, the design and development of airborne software with high safety and reliability face severe challenges. This paper presents a domain-specific formal modeling and analysis method for itemized requirements in avionics. First of all, this paper proposes a formal model HVRM (Hierarchical Variables Relation Model). HVRM provides the semantics of conditions, events, mode transitions, modules, and ports. Then, in this paper, a framework is designed to model the requirements in natural language descriptions into a formal model. The framework includes pre-processing of requirements, construction of a domain concept library, normalization of requirements, and automatic generation. The HVRM model constructed aims to perform consistency and integrity analysis to identify model elements that do not meet consistency and integrity constraints and to trace back and modify the requirements. Finally, taking the automatic flight control system as an example, the requirements of the flight mode logic function are modeled and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Management Method of Assembled Construction Project Scheduling Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The traditional intelligent management module for construction scheduling lacks pertinence, impacting real-time scheduling. Hence, we propose an BIM-based intelligent management method for prefabricated construction scheduling. This adopts a multi-level approach to enhance pertinence and establishes an intelligent supervision module, enabling visualized management. Our BIM prefabricated construction scheduling model incorporates automatic calibration and verification, yielding higher real-time scheduling frequency than traditional AI or characteristic-based methods. It optimizes scheduling under various contexts, enhancing stability, security, and practical value.

articleTitle: Visual monitoring method of power grid data assets based on digital twinning technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to more effectively plan the power grid inspection route and improve the inspection efficiency of substations, and to address the challenges of significant virtual real time mapping delay and insufficient monitoring accuracy commonly found in current intelligent distribution network monitoring methods, we propose an innovative power grid data asset visualization monitoring scheme based on digital twin technology, thereby achieving more accurate and timely monitoring results. Constructing a visual monitoring model of power grid data assets based on digital twinning technology, analyzing the relationship between virtual entities and physical entities, and constructing a visual monitoring objective function of power grid data assets based on digital twinning data in the monitoring model; Calculate the standard measurement value of power grid data assets, lay out regional logical nodes, use digital twinning technology to virtually map power grid data, feed back the current power grid data assets, and set a constraint condition for each state attribute, that is, the standard range. If the current equipment attribute exceeds the standard range, the power grid data assets are abnormal, and if it is within the set standard range, the power grid data assets are normal, thus realizing the visual monitoring of power grid data assets. The experimental results show that the time delay of virtual-real mapping is the lowest, and the accuracy is above $95 \%$, so it has better real-time and stability.

articleTitle: Research on the Spatial Spillover Effect of Carbon Emissions in Chinese Provinces
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: —As carbon neutrality becomes a crucial goal for China’s development, research on carbon emissions has garnered widespread attention. This study estimates the carbon emissions of ten northern provinces in China from 2013 to 2019. Using a variance decomposition network topology model, we constructed a spatial spillover correlation network to analyze the spillover effects among these provinces. The results indicate significant spatial spillover relationships in carbon emissions among different provinces, with varying effect weights. Heilongjiang and Henan provinces are central in the spillover correlation network, showing the closest ties with other provinces. By dividing the ten northern provinces into two communities, we found significant spillover effects within communities, while the correlation weights between communities were lower. This research provides insights for the government to achieve carbon neutrality through regional environmental collaborative governance.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Obstacle Avoidance Based on Multi-angle Improved Gray Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the current problem of insufficient autonomous flight and obstacle avoidance ability of UAVs in complex environments and poor algorithm optimization effect. In this paper, a multi-angle improved Gray Wolf algorithm for UAV obstacle avoidance research is proposed, for the setup of customized maps and their obstacles, the GWO algorithm before and after the improvement are able to achieve the path finding optimization. And the shortest path optimized by the multi-angle improved Gray Wolf algorithm proposed in this paper for this map is improved by 11.83%, 11.59% and 43.59% respectively compared to the pre-improvement. At the same time, compared with the pre-improvement, the model proposed in this paper also only needs fewer iterations to find the shortest path, which proves the effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the “Healthy Wings” Recreational Life Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: “Wings of Health” Leisure Life Cloud is an intelligent integrated health management platform committed to providing users with personalized and scientific health services and management based on the core concept of “human-health-life”. Through intelligent algorithms, data analysis, artificial intelligence technology, etc., the system provides users with health programs that are more in line with their individual physique and health conditions, and offers personalized health advice and management. The “Wings of Health” Leisure Life Cloud Platform adopts front-end and back-end separation technology, which improves the molecularity and maintainability of the system, enhances development efficiency and system scalability, and contributes to the digital transformation and upgrading of medical services.

articleTitle: Research on Steel Surface Defect Identification based on YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The number of surface defects in steel has always been a key measure of the quality of steel production. Traditional detection methods, such as the strobe method, have the problems of slow detection reaction and low accuracy. The object detection technology based on deep learning can effectively improve the detection performance by virtue of its strong real-time performance and high accuracy. However, in the actual production process, complex production environments and other industrial factors may affect the efficiency of object detection technology. We used an improved You Only Look Once (YOLO) framework to identify defects on the steel surface. This improved version of the YOLO model optimizes the original architecture to enhance the detection of small size and low contrast defects. As a real-time object detection system, YOLO is able to predict the locations and category probability of defects directly from the input image by integrating convolutional neural networks. In addition, we have adjusted the loss function and anchor frame strategy of the model to improve the detection accuracy and response speed in complex environments. The performance of the model in different types of defect identification was analyzed, and the applicability and efficiency of the model in the actual steel defect dataset NEU-DET were discussed.

articleTitle: An Optimal Stopping Model for Elevator Group Control Network Based on Fuzzy Mathematics Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The Elevator Dispatch Problem (EDP), a classical conundrum in computer optimization, continues to evolve with algorithmic iterations. In this study, leveraging the fuzzy neural network (FNN) algorithm, we extend the EDP to encompass planning for M floor heights and N elevators. Our methodology involves initial parameterization to optimize real-world conditions, followed by the construction of a three-layer FNN system to integrate these parameters, culminating in optimal planning outcomes. Consequently, we derive a solution for optimal elevator stopping strategies tailored to scenarios with M levels and N cars, offering practical utility for optimization algorithms operating under multifaceted constraints.

articleTitle: Research on face expression recognition based on the ResNet network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Currently, face expression recognition suffers from the problem of significant differences in recognition accuracy of different expression categories and weak generalization ability; in order to improve the recognition accuracy, this paper proposes a face expression recognition method based on ResNet50-PMCA network, and at the same time completes the balanced processing of the dataset. Firstly, high-quality and balanced expression data samples are generated through the ADA-StyleGAN2 network to expand the training set effectively. Secondly, the Pyramidal Multidimensional Collaborative Attention Module (PMCA) is introduced into the ResNet50 network to improve the ability to recognize model expressions. Compared with the original ResNet50 network, the improved ResNet50-PMCA network improves the recognition rate on the equalized B-CK+ dataset by $\mathbf{4 . 4 1 \%}$. The experimental results show that this method significantly improves the recognition rate when background clutter, and unbalanced expression categories in the natural environment.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection Method for Lightning Protection Points Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent detection method based on the improved YOLOv8 algorithm for detecting lightning protection points on offshore wind turbine blades. Traditional methods rely on manual climbing and manual detection, posing high safety risks and low efficiency. We utilize drones equipped with high-definition cameras and advanced object detection algorithms to achieve automatic detection of lightning protection points, significantly improving detection efficiency and reducing safety risks for maintenance personnel. Additionally, the introduced C2F-DWR module and CARAFE upsampling technology further enhance the accuracy and computational efficiency of small target detection. Experimental validation on a custom dataset confirms significant improvements in key evaluation metrics such as mAP50 and mAP50-95.

articleTitle: Research on derailment coefficient prediction model based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Train derailment is a very complex dynamic process. Aiming at the problem that the current derailment evaluation factors are insufficient to fully study the wheel-rail contact mechanism, a derailment coefficient prediction model based on deep learning is proposed. Firstly, the transverse movement of the wheel relative to the rail is obtained by image segmentation algorithm, and then the derailment coefficient prediction model is constructed by Elman neural network optimized by genetic algorithm, and the input speed, acceleration, wheel load reduction rate and transverse movement are predicted. Field test results show that this model has high prediction accuracy and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese input prediction based on LSTM+Word2vec
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Now more and more smart devices have emerged in our lives. Entering software as one of the important windows for users to interact with the Internet, helping users complete a large amount of data output. Went to allow users to output the information they want more quickly and conveniently, the problems such as the existence of semantics in the traditional Chinese input predictive model and the short-term dependence distance of words, and propose a LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) + Word2vec deep learning Chinese input predictive model. Using the continuous phrase model in Word2vec, the context structure and semantic relationship of the context are used to map each character into a vector space to enhance the denseness between the vector; the neural network model is used for a long short time to achieve the linear of the text sequence of the text. Grab the results of the final output prediction. The accuracy, recall and F1 values of the experiment can reach $80.8 \%, 68.1 \%$, and 73.9%, respectively. The accuracy rates of LSTM, RNN (Recurrent Neural Network), and N-Gram are obtained by control experiments. $77.1 \%, 72.9 \%$ and 52.6%, respectively. Compared to find that deep learning Chinese input prediction models based on LSTM + Word2vec is higher, it has a certain degree of robustness and generalization, which is of great significance for user personalized research and user experience.

articleTitle: Research on Network Resource Data Correlation Analysis Method Based on NoSQL Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The network resource data is based on the traditional relational modeling methods, which leads to data analysis being implemented only through “hard modeling” “hard coding” “customization”, which cannot meet the flexible and fast data aggregation and analysis requirements in areas such as network planning, construction, and operation. This paper proposes a method for fast and general data aggregation and association analysis based on NoSQL data structure, and verifies it with actual production data, demonstrating that the association analysis method based on NoSQL data structure has advantages in terms of processing speed and implementation complexity.

articleTitle: Design of a Tourism Area Dining Recommendation System Based on Autoabstract Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This study aims to address the issue of tourists choosing suitable restaurants and food in tourist areas, and proposes a tourist area dining recommendation system based on automatic summarization technology. The system utilizes web content scraping robots, a topic-aware Transformer model, and automatic summarization technology to automatically obtain introductions and summary comments for various restaurants in tourist areas, and to provide automatic dining recommendations. The research also combines Hadoop platform technology to establish parallel processing for real-time provision of food reviews and recommendation services. The innovation of this study lies in the use of automatic summarization technology and parallel processing to achieve rapid acquisition and recommendation of food information in tourist areas, providing convenient and practical services for tourists. This system has certain application prospects and promotional value in the field of tourist area dining recommendations.

articleTitle: Research on Online Management of Energy Metering Standard Value Transfer Process
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: At present, the number and types of devices received by the energy metering technology organization for traceability are increasing, the difficulty of the value transfer process management continues to increase. With the continuous development of the ubiquitous power Internet of things, the value transfer management work needs to move toward informationization and instrumentation. Research and establish an online management system for energy measurement standard value transfer process, combined with RFID technology application, real-time online monitoring and management of the transfer process, and ensure the accuracy and reliability of relevant data information. Using LSTM neural network to analyze and predict the trend of error changes in electric energy metering equipment, and improve the level of precision management for equipment. The operational results show that the research can effectively solve the regulatory problems of the value transfer process and improve the business management level and work efficiency of the organization.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Key Technologies for the New Generation Enterprise Mobile Portal
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the advancement of the mobile and extranet construction of the company’s applications, the scale of extranet mobile applications, user scale and content scale show a geometric growth trend. The original mobile portal business service architecture has some problems, such as insufficient architecture flexibility, insufficient openness and weak scene adaptability. Through architecture optimization and upgrading, the new generation of mobile portal uses enterprise-level certification technology, internal and external network service integration technology, security protection technology and other key technologies to build a new mobile Internet ecosystem between the company and the outside, to achieve internal and external interconnection, exclusive workbench customization, multi-tenant autonomous operation, and promote the company’s mobile portal “better experience, more flexible architecture and more open ecology”. The new generation mobile portal has been popularized and applied in 27 provincial grid companies of the State Grid Corporation of China. The application results show that the new generation of mobile portal can flexibly and quickly meet business needs, improve business service capacity, realize all-round ecological connection of personnel, ecology and business, and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on SDN-based Load Balancing Routing Randomization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Routing randomization is a network dynamic defense method that routes traffic in a random, dynamic switching manner. Its purpose is to increase network uncertainty and thus defend against scanning and reconnaissance. However, routing dynamics and randomization result in additional space-time overhead and negatively impact network performance. We address the negative impact of routing changes on network performance by adopting a load-balancing-based weighted multi-routing strategy that improves the dynamism and randomness of the network without significantly elevating the delay and packet loss of traffic. Theoretical and experimental validations demonstrate that our proposed approach is more effective than existing solutions in mitigating the conflict between improving network dynamics and randomness and network performance degradation.

articleTitle: Visual Data Mining in Mental Health : Network Analysis of Mindfulness Processes and Anxiety Symptoms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Despite previous research exploring the relationship between mindfulness and anxiety, the constraints of analytical tools have resulted in few studies examining these relationships at a micro level. This study employs network analysis, a visual data mining technique, combined with psychopathological network theory to investigate the connections between specific mindfulness processes and anxiety symptoms. A total of 550 young adults (Mage $=19.27, \mathrm{SD}=1.60$) participated in the study. The results indicate that “future preoccupation” is the mindfulness process most closely related to anxiety symptoms, particularly “social anxiety.” Additionally, “focus on present” emerged as the most susceptible mindfulness process to external influences, likely due to participants’ lack of prior mindfulness practice. This study deepens our understanding of the relationships between mindfulness processes and anxiety symptoms and demonstrates the broad potential of visual data mining in psychology.

articleTitle: Research on comparative detection of two categories based on normal bolts and bolts with missing pins
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Pins are widely used in power transmission lines, and their main function is to fix bolts in connecting fittings. Bolts and pins are extremely small in size and have complex backgrounds, which makes detection very difficult. This paper compares multiple classic and latest target detection networks to explore the impact of single-category and dual-category annotations on the detection accuracy of bolt missing defects, thereby improving the detection accuracy of bolt and pin missing in complex transmission line scenarios. This method first uses the latest YOLOv8 target detection model to learn and train bolt pin missing to achieve bolt pin missing detection. Secondly, through multiple classic target detection networks, including Faster RCNN, SSD, and YOLOv5 classic target detection models, images containing single bolt defect targets and defect targets containing normal bolts and bolt pin missing are learned and trained respectively. Finally, the detection results of multiple models are compared to analyze the impact of single-category and dual-category on the accuracy of bolt pin missing detection. The experimental results show that the YOLOv8 network trained with two categories can more accurately detect bolt pin missing targets that were not detected by the original single-category training network, effectively improving the detection accuracy of bolt pin missing.

articleTitle: Accuracy Analysis of 125mm Fin-Stabilized Projectile with Trajectory Correction Device
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In the paper, the two-dimensional correction scheme of the cross rudder layout was used to study the two-dimensional trajectory correction algorithm based on the tank ammunition stabilized 125 mm of the tai. The actual trajectory to ideal calculation trajectory correction strategy without random interference factors was determined, by the angular deviation between the actual trajectory measured by GPS, Hall sensor and the calculated trajectory spatial location, same direction rudder angle was periodically adjusted to make the correction force point to the calculated trajectory direction.

articleTitle: An Enhanced UNet-based Framework for Robust Depth Completion of Transparent Objects from Single RGB-D Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Transparent objects are ubiquitous in various applications ranging from industrial environments to everyday life. However, their reliable detection and identification represent a significant challenge in many industries. Currently, the majority of depth cameras available on the market are ill-equipped to capture accurate depth information of transparent objects due to their unique material properties, such as refraction and reflection. To address this problem, we introduce a method for estimating the depth of transparent objects using a UNet architecture, based on a single RGB-D input. In addition, to overcome the performance and complexity trade-off, this paper employs an Efficient Channel Attention module, which utilizes only a minimal number of parameters while delivering a significant performance boost. Comprehensive experiments carried out on the widely recognized ClearGrasp dataset have demonstrated that the integration of ECA attention mechanisms into our network architecture notably enhances the performance of depth completion.

articleTitle: A Method for Determining the Consistency of Radar-Infrared Tracks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of determining the consistency of multi-source radar and infrared sensor tracks in dense target scenarios, a multi-source distributed radar-infrared track consistency determination method is proposed. This method converts radar track coordinates into a coordinate system with the infrared sensor as the origin. It calculates the statistical distance through the weighted norm of the redundant information difference between radar and infrared tracks and uses hypothesis testing to determine the consistency threshold. Multiple radar tracks judged to be the same as the infrared track are obtained. Radar tracks are abstracted as points in space, and infrared tracks are abstracted as lines in space. The distance between spatial points and lines is calculated, and the final judgment result of radar and infrared tracks is obtained based on spatial distance. Simulation experiments show that the multi-source distributed radar-infrared track consistency determination method maintains a high accuracy rate in dense target scenarios, significantly outperforming the nearest neighbor method and the weighted track association method.

articleTitle: Lightweight Road Vehicle Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper addresses the problems of large model size, many parameters, high equipment requirements, and low recall rate in traditional vehicle detection models, and proposes a lightweight road vehicle detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once). The improved detection algorithm reduces the number of parameters and the size of the model, which can effectively improve the detection speed and shorten the training time. This paper proposes a lightweight Shared Parameter detection head (SPDH), which can greatly reduce the number of model parameters while ensuring the detection accuracy. in the meantime SimAM attention mechanism, a lightweight and parameterless attention mechanism of convolutional neural networks, is added to the network to enhance the detection performance. Finally, the Star Block in StarNet proposed by Microsoft in 2024 is used to replace the Bottleneck in C2f for further lightening and guarantee performance. Experiments on BIT-Vehicle dataset demonstrate that the superior performance of the algorithm compared to the original model. Under the premise that The parameter count has been decreased by approximately 35% and the model’s size has been reduced by around 34%, resulting in a 1.2% increase in precision and a 1.8% increase in recall, and other evaluation indicators are roughly consistent with the benchmark model. The excellence of the improved algorithm is proved.

articleTitle: Research on the application of AR in the safety inspection of opening and closing stations
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the application and effect of augmented reality (AR) technology in the security inspection of opening and closing stations. In order to significantly enhance inspection efficiency, precision, and standardization, while digitizing the daily inspection process, this paper introduces a related technology based on the use of AR, combined with the application of AR glasses. And this setup facilitates the automatic identification of station equipment, such as meters and switch statuses, establishes a standardized inspection protocol, enables real-time interaction for remote assistance, and employs video capture for emergency response. The practical application of AR in these inspections has proven to be effective.

articleTitle: Design of Document Secret Level Consistency Check Software Based on OCR
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The secret level of secret documents should be correctly labeled, especially when they are printed or copied from the company’s internal network to mobile media. At this point, it is necessary to perform a consistency check on the file name of the document, the document cover, and the content of the document to ensure the consistency of the secret levels among the three. Traditional consistency checks require manual labor and can be time-consuming when there are many documents. This article uses Python language and OCR to design a document secret level consistency check software. The software determines the secret level of the document cover by extracting the cover image from a doc/docx or PDF file and recognizing text in the upper left corner. The content secret level of the document is also determined through character matching. The test shows that the software can replace manual verification of secret level consistency, and the processing speed meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Image segmentation method for pure iron grain combining multiscale feature aggregation and iterative refinement
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes a segmentation method that combines convolutional neural network feature aggregation with recurrent neural network iterative refinement to address challenges in segmenting polycrystalline pure iron grains, such as handling surface noise on grain boundaries and repairing missing boundaries. The method effectively addresses issues related to surface noise and missing boundaries, thereby improving the accurate localization of grains. Experimental results demonstrate that the method can effectively remove noise, accurately identify grain boundaries of pure iron grains, and exhibit high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research of Deep convolutional Fuzzy System Algorithm in Soft sensor Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Given the intricate nonlinear nature and complex underlying mechanisms of chemical processes, a soft sensor modeling method of deep convolutional fuzzy system (DCFS) based on extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm is proposed. DCFS model is constructed by connecting several FSs in a bottom-up block and hierarchical manner. The EKF algorithm is used to adjust the parameters of DCFS fuzzy rules to further improve the accuracy of DCFS modeling and realize the online training of the model. The proposed method is applied to a soft sensor modeling example for product quality (melt index) estimation of Sequential Reactor-multi-grade (SRMG). Under the same experimental conditions, compared with DCFS, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Long Short-Term Memory network (LSTM) and A1-C0, A1-C1, two interval type 1 fuzzy methods, the experimental results show that the modeling accuracy, training speed, and parameter Settings of the corresponding methods are better than the comparison methods.

articleTitle: Automatic Coloring of Anime Line Art Based on Improved CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks as a type of deep learning model, can automatically learn the color and content information in images by learning the distribution of real images, thereby generating realistic color images. In animation production, traditional manual coloring is labor-intensive and challenging to ensure consistency. GAN-based automatic coloring technology can significantly improve production efficiency and image quality. This paper proposes an improved CycleGAN for anime line art coloring, constructing a generator structure that includes an encoder, transformer, and decoder, and designing a corresponding discriminator structure. Experimental results show that the improved model significantly outperforms the Pix 2 Pix model in terms of color restoration, detail preservation, and overall visual effect. Both subjective scores and objective evaluation metrics indicate that the improved model demonstrates higher accuracy and consistency in the image coloring task.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv8n Algorithm for Object Detection with CARAFE, MultiSEAMHead, and TripleAttention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of the YOLOv8n algorithm for object detection, this paper proposes an enhanced YOLOv8n algorithm. This algorithm introduces the CARAFE module, TripleAttention mechanism, and MultiSEAMHead module into the YOLOv8n backbone network to enhance feature extraction capabilities. Extensive experiments were conducted on the NWPU dataset. Experimental results show that compared with the original YOLOv8n algorithm, the enhanced algorithm improves precision, recall, and mean average precision (mAP) by $2.4 \%, 3.0 \%$, and 4.0%, respectively. These results validate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Secure data transmission method of end-to-end communication network based on port isolation technology and encryption authentication algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Because the communication network data may be subjected to various malicious attacks in the process of transmission, there are serious risks such as leakage and tampering of communication network data. Therefore, a secure transmission method of end-to-end communication network data based on port isolation technology and encryption authentication algorithm is proposed. The importance degree is used to balance the correlation between heterogeneous data, calculate the amount of information in the transmission process, and describe the state of the data transmission channel through port isolation technology and encryption authentication algorithm, so as to obtain the data tuple density and extract the end-to-end communication network data; Under the standards of port isolation technology and encryption and authentication algorithm, the mixed standard of byte columns is deduced, the data key of end-to-end communication network is generated, and the secure data transmission process of end-to-end communication network is constructed. The experimental results show that this method has the best performance in data transmission security, can realize smooth data transmission, and has good communication quality, can receive end-to-end communication network data, and the network host can effectively authenticate the data transmission behavior.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Assessment of Vehicle Recovery Benefits Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: As an independent decision-making unit, its input, output decomposition, the establishment of the vehicle repair data envelopment analysis model, the use of validity analysis, scale benefit analysis, projection analysis of vehicle repair program assessment, the effectiveness of the program to get a comprehensive assessment of the benefits of each program, and optimization of resource inputs for vehicle repair provides a quantifiable assessment of the maintenance and protection system effectiveness ideas and methods to enhance the maintenance and protection capabilities. It provides ideas and methods to quantitatively assess the effectiveness of the maintenance system for vehicle repair, which is of great significance for improving the vehicle repair and protection capability.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Supervised Spatio-Channel Aggregation Network for Image Manipulation Detection and Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Recent advancements in image editing technology have made image content more susceptible to manipulation, designing a universal detection method for forged images is imperative. This study introduces the Multi-Scale Supervised Spatio-Channel Aggregation Network (MSSA-Net). This network not only assimilates the semantic information of the original image but also exploits manipulation artifacts at the edges of tampered image to learn agnostic semantic features. By supervising the network at multiple scales (pixel, edge, and image), it is trained to acquire more generalized features.

articleTitle: An improved YOLOv8-based safety helmet wearing detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Whether to wear a safety helmet is one of the key measures to ensure the safety of personnel in the construction process. This paper proposes a new detection algorithm for safety helmet wearing. Utilizing the YOLOv8n architecture, the algorithm incorporates a SENetV2-based channel-wise attention mechanism into the network’s backbone, thereby giving full consideration to global information, thereby allowing the network to allocate more attention to the safety helmet. To overcome the deficiencies of the initial backbone in combining features, we substitute the original network’s neck section with the CCFM module, thereby improving YOLOv8n’s capacity for feature integration following the extraction of features from the backbone network. A new detection head, DyHead3, is proposed to replace the detection head in the original network model. The empirical findings indicate that the algorithm enhances the mAP, P, and R metrics by 2.02%,3.41%,and 1.07%, respectively, when contrasted with the baseline YOLOv8n approach, respectively, which fully demonstrates the effectiveness and practicality of the improved algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Small Target Detection Algorithm based on GAMYOLOv8 for UAV Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aimed at the problems of high missed detection rate of small targets and low detection accuracy caused by complex background, low target pixels, and occlusion overlap in UAV aerial images, an improved lightweight UAV target detection algorithm called GAM-YOLOv8 (Global Attention Mechanism-YOLOv8) was proposed. Firstly, global attention module was integrated in the YOLOv8 backbone, the addition of GAM could significantly reduce the loss of information in the computation, enhanced the global interaction characterization ability, and effectively improved the backbone network’s feature extraction capability of small targets. At the same time, a small target detection head was added to the head layer for enhancing the detection efficiency of the algorithm for small targets. Experimental validation is conducted using the UAV aerial photography dataset VisDrone, and the results show that the GAM-YOLOv8 algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively improve the detection accuracy for small targets in the UAV aerial images, compared with the original YOLOv8n model, it improves 6.5% points on the $\mathrm{mAP}_{0.5}$ index, and improves 4.2% points on the $\mathrm{mAP}_{0.5: 0.95}$. The experiment results showed that the proposed algorithm could effectively accomplished the task of detecting small targets in UAV aerial images.

articleTitle: Intelligent medical system data encryption based on improved AES algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Improving the data encryption of AES algorithm in the smart medical system is a key technology designed to protect the security and privacy of medical data. The new scheme of AES generation.
