After analyzing the problems of the existing S box, Based on the construction principle of the S box and the cryptographic properties, By adjusting the number of affine transformations and increasing the complexity of the affine transformation matrix, Further confusion ounding the generated S box, A new S-box is constructed; besides, In the round-key-plus phase, Generate random sequence columns using the squared residual algorithm, Replace the round key in the generation by using the generated random sequence columns, Thus generating a new round-key, The comparison of the generated new S box with AES S box and other improvements in nonlinear properties, extenability of the key, confused rows of the key, etc., result display, Improved AES algorithm has better nonlinear properties, extensibility and confounding, Can effectively resist algebraic attacks.

articleTitle: Research on Scene Text Image Super-Resolution Based on Improved TATT Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Scene text image super-resolution (STISR) is a super-resolution task for specific image data, with the objective of enhancing the clarity of low-resolution scene text images, thereby improving the performance of downstream text recognition tasks. In contrast to regular image data, scene text images comprise solely of text and background, and the background is of no use for downstream text recognition tasks and may also affect the reconstruction effect. The majority of current research on scene text image super-resolution employs straightforward methods, such as thresholding and edge detection, to distinguish text from background. However, these methods are unable to achieve satisfactory precision. In light of the aforementioned circumstances, this paper proposes a mask generation subnet to differentiate between the text and background parts of the image in order to eliminate the interference of complex backgrounds. Additionally, to make the network pay more attention to the text, this paper proposes a channel dilated neighborhood attention block (CDiNAB), which assigns weights to features at both the channel and spatial levels. Experimental results on the TextZoom benchmark dataset demonstrate that the proposed method effectively improves the accuracy of text recognition in comparison to the current mainstream STISR methods.

articleTitle: Application of the TLM-FLM method with Optimized Relaxation in electromagnetic field analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of the transmission line model finite element method (TLM-FEM), this paper optimizes the solution process of the incident stage and the reflection stage of the method. The optimized relaxation method is used to accelerate solution of the nonlinear process voltage, the calculation of the element coefficient matrix and the decomposition of the global matrix are implemented on the GPU in parallel to further improve the computational efficiency. The optimized transmission line finite element method is applied to the calculation of electromagnetic field of single-phase transformer. The accuracy of the algorithm is verified by comparing the results of self-programming analysis with the results of ANSYS. The calculation time of the same model with different grid numbers is compared, which proves that the proposed method can be applied to calculate the electromagnetic field of large-scale.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Resource Allocation Strategy Assisted by Idle Resources in Complex Urban Channel Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Traditional vehicle networking resource allocation strategies are difficult to meet diverse high-quality communication needs in high dynamic vehicle scenarios, especially in congested areas such as intersections, which suffer from low scheduling efficiency, network congestion, and high latency. In response to these challenges, this article proposes a vehicle resource allocation strategy based on idle resources assistance. This strategy targets the highly dynamic and frequently changing channel environment in urban environments, utilizing idle roadside resources to assist vehicle communication in optimizing resource allocation and improving network performance. This article constructs a resource allocation algorithm for this strategy. Firstly, the vehicle communication capability maximization algorithm utilizes the Bernstein approximation method to transform constraint conditions into computable forms, and combines binary optimization to achieve the maximization of vehicle communication capability. Simulation experiments show that resource allocation strategies and algorithms significantly improve the total channel capacity in the vehicular network. Compared with existing resource allocation algorithms, it has obvious advantages and has been proven to have good performance.

articleTitle: Application of Multimodal Sensing and Adaptive Decision Making for Clinical Supply Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the booming development of modernized logistics system, smart logistics is supported by new generation of electronic information technology to create a new mode of logistics business development. In this context, this thesis proposes a medical logistics terminal based on multimodal sensing and adaptive decision-making. Combining the intelligent logistics terminal with the background of the medical industry has practical research value. The terminal system utilizes multi-sensor technology fusion and real-time sensing of environmental changes and logistics and transportation needs, and makes adaptive decision-making based on the collected data in order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of distribution at the supply side of medical materials. The results of the study show that the system has significant advantages in improving medical efficiency, reducing distribution costs, and optimizing medical processes.

articleTitle: Exploiting the Degeneracy of Euclidean Distance Matrix Completion Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The Euclidean distance matrix (EDM) completion problem has been widely used in molecular conformation, protein structure determination and localization. This problem can be troublesome for many off-the-shelf algorithms since it is often intended to be highly degenerate. Therefore, in this paper, we develop the facial reduction technique by exploiting this degeneracy. We characterize the minimal face of EDM cone that contains the feasible region of EDM completion problem. The strict feasibility can be ensured by restricting the problem on the minimal face. We verify our result by some toy examples.

articleTitle: Design of a multi-channel electroencephalogram acquisition system for transcranial direct current stimulation regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In response to the inherent characteristics of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and the requirements of EEG acquisition systems, this paper investigates a portable multichannel EEG signal acquisition device. The acquisition system is capable of recording high-quality EEG signals from 16 channels, achieving the functions of EEG signal acquisition, analog-todigital conversion, and data transmission. By collecting EEG signals before and after transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) therapy, and adjusting the parameters of electrical stimulation based on the EEG signal status, the accuracy of tDCS therapy can be improved and personalized treatment can be realized.

articleTitle: Logistics Sorting and Transportation System based on McNamum Wheel -- Intelligent Manufacturing Professional Training Research
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the arrival of Industry 4.0, under the influence of the international financial crisis, the state proposed to revitalize the equipment manufacturing industry to achieve the transformation of the national economic growth mode. In this paper, an innovative logistics automatic sorting system is developed to improve the degree of automation and efficiency of logistics sorting. The system adopts machine vision technology and McNamum wheel conveyor belt structure to realize high-precision cargo identification and flexible space adaptability. The omnidirectional wheel and OpenMV technology are expected to further enhance the level of logistics automation, expand application scenarios, and achieve a comprehensive upgrade and transformation of the logistics industry through industrial cooperation and technological innovation. This paper analyzes and compares the growth process of students and technicians, constructs the “three with three integration and three stages” professional group talent training model, and provides a reference training model for related majors and professional groups of equipment manufacturing.

articleTitle: An acoustic model using mixture of experts for environmental sound classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Environmental sound classification (ESC) is of great significance in smart home, security monitoring and other fields. Since environmental sounds have the characteristics of low signal-to-noise ratio and diverse types, it increases the difficulty of environmental sound recognition. This paper proposes a hybrid expert model (SEMoE) that adds an attention mechanism. This model uses the FBank method for feature extraction, and introduces multiple expert layers to replace the fully connected layers in the residual neural network. Different expert layers are dynamically selected for output through the routing layer, thereby improving the accuracy of the model. At the same time, the addition of the attention mechanism can make the model capture and process important information more effectively. Experimental results show that on the UrbanSound8K public data set, the accuracy, precision, recall, and f1 score of this model reached 0.960, 0.961,0.961, and 0.961 respectively, providing a more effective method for environmental sound recognition in practical applications. solution.

articleTitle: Research on the Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm Fall Monitoring System for Home Care for the Elderly
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In view of the risk of fall for the elderly in the home care environment, a surveillance video display fall detection method of the improved YOLOv5 algorithm is improved, and the Transformer module that increases the human attention mechanism is combined with the CSPDarknet structure of the backbone part of the YOLOv5 algorithm. The system collects video data through the camera, trains and verifies the video data, and then judges the action and posture of the target person. It connects the WIFI module of Orange School to send the action and posture information to the guardian’s mobile phone to remind the guardian to timely treat the person who fell down, so as to improve the rescue efficiency. On the basis of improving the algorithm structure, the loss function was improved and conducted repeated training. The experimental results showed that the improved algorithm mAP improved by 2.8%, the $F 1$ score by 2.2%, the number of processing frames per second by 10% during inference, and achieved the fall detection accuracy of 98.6%.

articleTitle: OpenCV-based Defect Detection Method for the Key Part of A Bronchoscope Apex
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The bronchoscope apex is small and easy to have dimensional defects. To ensure the quality of bronchoscope products, this paper carries out dimensional defect detection on the key parts of the bronchoscope apex. OpenCV-python machine vision algorithm is used to preprocess the apex image. The apex’s inner and outer contours are extracted by Canny operator screening. The template rotation matching technology and average hash algorithm are then used to detect the dimensional defects. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can carry out efficient and accurate defect detection for the key parts of the bronchoscope apex head.

articleTitle: SGReg: Swift and Robust Graph Matching based Point Cloud Registration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Existing point cloud registration methods are computationally intensive in complex scenarios, making it difficult to achieve an ideal balance between accuracy and efficiency. To address this issue, we propose SGReg, a lightweight point cloud registration network. The core innovations of SGReg include the redesigned feature extraction network ReDGCNN, which employs multi-branch convolution and re-parameterization techniques; the introduction of a Simple Transformer (ST) as an edge generator, using a Linear SelfAttention mechanism (LSA) instead of traditional multi-head attention; and the innovative parallelization of the attention mechanism and MLP layers in the transformer structure. These optimizations significantly reduce computational complexity and inference speed while maintaining strong feature expression capabilities. Experiments show that SGReg outperforms existing methods in various benchmark tests.

articleTitle: CISF-BEV: A Complementary Interaction Sparse Fusion Network in BEV for 3D Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Fusing LiDAR and camera information for 3D object detection is of increasing interest in autonomous driving. However, the point cloud still lacks much geometric position information, due to the sparsity of point clouds, which is not conducive to the fusion of LiDAR and camera. In this paper, we propose a complementary interaction sparse fusion method in BEV (CISF-BEV), to solve the above problem. First, we design the Point Cloud Complementary Interaction (PCI) module, which adopts dense pseudo point cloud BEV features to complement the empty areas of point cloud BEV features generated due to the occlusion of the objects or too far away to be scanned by LiDAR, to achieve the feature complementation and interaction. Second, we propose the Sparse Sampling Fusion (SSF) module that fuses the complementary features with pseudo point cloud features in a sparse sampling manner to quickly and efficiently assign semantic features to the point cloud, which is more conducive to generating accurate detection results. Experiments on the KITTI dataset show that CISF-BEV achieves very superior 3D object detection performance, particularly in the accuracy of occluded objects and distant objects.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Control Strategy of Dual-Propeller Speed for Unmanned Surface Vessel
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Dual-propeller unmanned surface vessels (USVs) that often require double motors to operate at distinct rotational speeds. Conventional coupling strategies are unable to achieve precise cooperative control of different commands. To overcome these limitations, we propose an improved relative coupling control (RCC) strategy, which incorporates a virtual motor concept. Each motor tracks the virtual motor’s speed trajectory, mitigating the issues of large synchronization errors and a complex model for rotational speed synchronization. The improved design eliminates the direct coupling between the motors. Furthermore, by integrating a fuzzy PID controller in the virtual motor’s speed loop control module, the system’s enhanced stability ensures lower tracking errors during steady operation.

articleTitle: TL-ResNet Load Classification Model Based on Time Series Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The process of load classification is similar to that of image classification. The load current is transformed into image through time series imaging for load feature analysis. The image data set used in this paper is constructed based on different time series imaging methods using public data sets. Deep residual neural networks are trained and tested using publicly available data sets. The results show that the trained deep residual neural network can effectively complete the load classification and has a certain generalization ability.

articleTitle: R-Wave Detection Algorithm Based on Central Difference and Adaptive Multi-Threshold
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: As a non-invasive method for diagnosing heart diseases, electrocardiography (ECG) relies on R-wave detection as a foundational step for other ECG waveform analysis. To further meet the demands for accuracy and real-time detection of R-waves in automatic ECG analysis, this paper proposes a low-complexity, fast, and reliable real-time R-wave detection algorithm. An R-wave detection method based on central difference and adaptive multi-threshold is designed. First, this paper proposes the use of central difference for R-wave enhancement, effectively improving the detection capability for low amplitude and low slope R-waves. Secondly, an adaptive multi-threshold strategy is proposed, which adaptively adjusts the current detection threshold based on the detected R-wave amplitude and RR interval, making it suitable for R-wave detection in cases of sudden changes in RR interval and R-wave amplitude. The proposed algorithm’s performance was evaluated using ECG signals from the MIT-BIH database, achieving an overall sensitivity, positive predictive value, and detection error rate of 99.73%, 99.82%, and 0.46%, respectively. The processing time for a 30-minute ECG recording is approximately 0.52 seconds. The results indicate that the algorithm is accurate, efficient, and suitable for real-time automatic ECG analysis.

articleTitle: Decision Tree-Based Resource Recommendation System for Aerospace Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper presents a decision tree-based resource recommendation system for aerospace manufacturing. During the resource selection stage of the aerospace manufacturing process design, the recommendation system first acquires the parts and their current features. The decision tree model is then used to determine the type of equipment required for these features, forming an initial set of equipment. Subsequently, the process rule base screens this set, matching the equipment that meets the requirements of the parts and the current process, forming a set of equipment to be recommended. Finally, the suitable equipment is recommended to the process personnel. By constructing and training the decision tree model, the system achieves rapid and accurate manufacturing resource recommendations, thereby enhancing the efficiency of process design for aerospace parts.

articleTitle: Research on high-precision evaluation standard of electron microscope images based on weighting algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In this paper, the standard electron microscope images are taken as the experimental object, and the focusing degree of the electron microscope images is judged for the shooting of different samples in the electron microscope environment, so that it can identify the focusing state of different images and determine whether the electron microscope has reached the best focusing mode, so as to realize the photographic process of automatic identification of focus by the electron microscope. Due to the lack of objectivity of electron microscope focusing in traditional manual focusing, resulting in inaccurate image focusing, this paper proposes a high-precision focusing method for electron microscope images based on improved weighting.

articleTitle: A multi-fault diagnosis method based on the fusion of time-space information
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In industrial processes, equipment data are often characterized by dynamics, strong nonlinearity and strong coupling, which makes it difficult to achieve multi-fault diagnosis when multiple faults occur simultaneously. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a multi-fault diagnosis method based on time-space information fusion. The method is realized by designing a time-space information fusion model and combining it with the contribution graph method. Firstly, the Euclidean distance is used to mine the information of the samples in the time direction; then, the spatial features are extracted from the mined temporal information to achieve the time-space information fusion; and finally, the fault variables are identified by combining with the contribution graph method to achieve the multi-fault diagnosis. Verified by numerical cases and actual data from the equipment of an inlet lift pump room of a wastewater treatment plant in Shanghai, the time-space information fusion model can effectively extract and use time-space information to separate fault samples, and the subsequent diagnostic results can accurately locate the fault variables.

articleTitle: Research on Overseas Warehouse Inventory Control Based on Gray Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Inventory control is a critical aspect of operating an e-commerce offshore warehouse model. With the growing instability of customer demand and the significant increase in the number of product returns, companies are faced with the increasingly complex and pressing challenge of determining inventory levels. In this uncertain environment, how to accurately forecast customer demand and flexibly adjust inventory levels has become a key issue for companies. In this paper, we firstly use the gray forecasting method to predict the customer demand and get the commodity demand distribution function. Then, the classic newsboy model is improved, and the inventory cost model is constructed to minimize the expected cost by considering the influence of the return factor. Finally, the empirical analysis verifies the influence of return rate and unit return cost on the optimal order quantity, so as to help enterprises develop more scientific and reasonable inventory control strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Automated IT Asset Data Updating Methods for Multi-Operating Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Due to the differences in the interfaces and data formats of different platforms as well as the non-uniform management mechanism. In order to ensure the automated update of IT asset data on multiple operation platforms, a research on the automated update method of IT asset data on multiple operation platforms is proposed. Through data synchronization technology, real-time or timed updating of data between different platforms is realized; the process of converting data from different platforms to a standard format is unified to facilitate data parsing and transmission; through the cloud computing platform, centralized management and unified scheduling of IT asset data can be realized to improve the management efficiency and automation of data. Experimental data show that this method can significantly improve the speed and accuracy of data updating, reduce manual intervention and operation, and improve work efficiency. Among other things, the automated update method can realize automatic data transmission and synchronization between different platforms, which is convenient for enterprises to carry out cross-platform management and maintenance.

articleTitle: Authorized subsets oriented ring signature with designated verification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Authorized subsets oriented ring signature scheme (ASORS) is an extension to common ring signature scheme and threshold ring signature scheme for general cases. In reality, however, the signers may want to be convinced that only certain desired verifier can verity their signature, in this paper we will propose a scheme that satisfies the property, in our scheme a subset from the ring can sign a message directed to a designated verifier. We present a formal model of such scheme and proceed with a construction based on bilinear pairings, and finally its security and performance were also analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Water Hazards Case Recommendation System in Coal Mines
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Mine water damage is a malignant disaster in coal mine production, severely threatening miners’ safety and the normal operation of coal mines. Addressing coal mine water hazards has become a key research focus in coal mine safety management. Case recommendation is currently a commonly used method for assisting decision-making in dealing with water hazards. However, existing research lacks systematic analysis of cases, resulting in deficiencies in the accuracy of case representation and matching. This paper proposes a method to divide the calculation of case similarity into attribute similarity and structural similarity, relevant historical cases and countermeasures with higher recommendation accuracy can be quickly provided. The results of this study not only improve the efficiency and effectiveness of addressing coal mine water hazards but also provide an intelligent solution for coal mine safety management.

articleTitle: Explosion smoke and dust detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In response to the low accuracy, slow detection speed, and missed detections of the blasting smoke and dust detection algorithm, this paper proposes the YOLOv8-AIES algorithm. By introducing C2f-AgileBlock to reduce parameters and computational complexity, using iRMB-EMA hybrid attention model to enhance feature extraction, and optimizing feature fusion with SlimNeck, the detection speed of the model is improved, missed detections are reduced, while maintaining lightweight and fast response. The experimental results show that YOLOv8-AIES performs well in mAP@0.5 On the Recall, it reached 94.9% and 93.9%, respectively, with a significant decrease in parameter and computational complexity, making it suitable for blast smoke and dust detection in practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Fast Image Encryption Based on Two-Stage Chunking Under XOR-Scrambling Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: High resolution images containing personal information are often stored in semi trusted cloud platforms such as Baidu Cloud Drive. Encrypting them first and then uploading to the cloud can prevent privacy leaks. However, if such images need to be encrypted frequently or in bulk, the issue of time consumption will become apparent. To achieve fast encryption of high-definition images, a fast image encryption algorithm based on two-stage chunking using XOR-scrambling frame is proposed. Firstly, the image is divided into big blocks, and the pixel-level XOR-scrambling encryption is performed on them; on this basis, the image is further divided into small blocks and the positions of the small blocks are randomly shuffled. Since the encryption of each large block of the image follows the same principle as traditional XOR-scrambling encryption algorithm, the security of encryption is ensured. At the same time, Dividing the image into large blocks for encryption can greatly save overall encryption time. Randomly shuffling small blocks of the image can further increase the degree of pixels scrambling and improve the ability to resist the cropping attack of the encrypted image. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the proposed fast image encryption algorithms significantly reduce the encryption time, and the higher the image resolution, the more significant the reduction in the encryption time.

articleTitle: Memory security vulnerability detection based on fusion of fuzzy testing and contextual features
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to address the high false positive and false negative rates in current code vulnerability detection methods, this study proposes a comprehensive code vulnerability detection scheme, which is mainly aimed at addressing conventional code vulnerabilities and memory security issues, especially in the C language environment. This method integrates the context feature fusion technique of fuzzy testing, aiming to enhance the accuracy of vulnerability detection in the code. By decomposing the characteristics of the code into local and global parts, we conducted a more in-depth semantic and dependency analysis of the keywords in the code block, and combined fuzzy testing and global context to successfully identify potential vulnerabilities in the code. The joint learning strategy utilizing global and contextual information significantly enhances the model’s ability to recognize and analyze complex code structures, especially when dealing with security issues, demonstrating higher efficiency and accuracy. After experimental verification, this method not only enhances the ability to detect vulnerabilities, but also successfully reduces false positives and false negatives, providing a solid technical support for the code quality of system software and embedded software.

articleTitle: Vehicle queueing model at signalized intersections in a random environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This study addresses the limitations of traditional vehicle queueing models in real-world traffic environments, in particular the lack of consideration for stochastic fluctuations in vehicle arrivals, by leveraging smart transportation and big data models. We have developed and presented a novel computational traffic queueing model that can dynamically simulate and quantitatively analyze the uncertainty and variability of vehicle arrivals, truly reflecting the complex situation in traffic flow. Detailed numerical experiments have shown that our model significantly outperforms traditional models when dealing with scenarios with rapidly changing traffic demands. It can capture and quantify various dynamic features of the queueing process in real-time, providing a more detailed and accurate interpretation of the queueing problem at high-traffic junctions. Moreover, this model provides more scientific decision support for traffic management, which can optimize signal control strategies at intersections and effectively respond to the challenges posed by demand fluctuations.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-Speaker Tibetan Speaker Diarization Based on EDA-EEND
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Speaker diarization research is the process of segmenting the audio of different speakers and clustering the audio of the same speaker in an audio or video task, which is commonly referred to as accomplishing the task of “who is talking when”, the current researches on speaker diarization mainly consist of multi-module systems relying on traditional clustering and end-to-end clustering. Due to the limitations of model structure and linear transformation, the above two methods can only be limited to deal with a fixed number of speakers, this paper combines attractor computing based on LSTM coding and decoding and EDA-EEND based on the self-attention mechanism of SA-EEND, in order to avoid the problem of mismatch between the simulation of the end-to-end speaker diarization and the real dataset, it also introduces of the PIT loss function creates a unique Tibetan language dataset. Tibetan dataset, the experimental results show that speaker diarization can not only be applied in small languages but also flexibly expand the number of two speakers to multiple speakers, and the effect of 45.3% in multiple speakers can be comparable to that of two speakers.

articleTitle: A method for forecasting grain storage temperature based on spatial-temporal blocks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: During the process of grain storage, aberrant temperatures in the grain can give rise to mold and pest infestation, posing a severe threat to food security. Therefore, accurately monitoring the trend of grain temperature changes is of great importance. We introduce a novel temperature forecasting approach for grain storage. It can accurately predict the temperature at different locations in the grain pile. By building spatial-temporal blocks utilizing the Graph Attention Network(GAT), attention model and the Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU), we culminate the entire procedure into a network as the Attention-based GNN Combine GRU Network, or A-GCRN for short. To fortify the practicality and validity of our model, we collected temperature data from more than 10 grain depots, and a total of 10,950 temperature data for model training and validation. Through the ablation experiments and comparison experiments conducted on this dataset, we have been able to convincingly validate the efficacy and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: DD-SSUN: A Dual-domain Self-supervised Unrolled Network for MRI Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning algorithms have been widely used in magnetic resonance image (MRI) reconstruction. However, existing algorithms have limitations such as difficulty in extracting effective features from undersampled data, serious loss of phase encoding information in K-domain data, and insufficient utilization of dual-domain features. This paper proposes a new MRI reconstruction network, namely the dual-domain self-supervised unrolling network (DD-SSUN). This approach performs feature learning and reconstruction simultaneously in both the image domain and k-space, leveraging the unique features of each domain. Additionally, self-supervised learning extracts valuable information from large amounts of unlabeled data, eliminating the need for fully sampled images and enhancing the reconstruction model’s generalization ability and robustness. The effectiveness of the proposed method is evaluated using the IXI brain dataset. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves high-speed reconstructions at acceleration ratios of 4 and 8. Furthermore, the proposed model surpasses other dual-domain self-supervised models and significantly outperforms traditional supervised learning methods in terms of reconstruction quality.

articleTitle: Grape Leaf Variety Identification Based on Improved Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The morphology and physiological characteristics of grapes reflect the genetic traits of different varieties. Effectively distinguishing between different grape varieties not only promotes breeding efforts and the conservation of genetic resources but also has significant implications for agricultural development. As an integral component, leaves are often used for variety identification and classification. However, accurately distinguishing between different grape varieties based on leaf characteristics is challenging due to the subtle differences among them. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved Swin Transformer network. Firstly, it integrates shallow and deep features through a multi-stage feature fusion module to enhance the network’s sensitivity to leaf details, and optimizes these features using a convolutional attention module. Finally, it combines inter-class similarity with one-hot labels to generate soft labels that contain semantic information from different classes, providing more effective supervision for the deep learning model and addressing the small sample size problem. Experimental results show that the proposed method effectively improves the model’s recognition performance, achieving fine-grained identification of different grape leaf varieties.

articleTitle: Research on Emotion Recognition Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Emotions express human’s attitude towards external things and play an important role in social life. Automatic emotion recognition technology plays an important role in the field of human-computer interaction. Facial expression analysis is the most intuitive, convenient and effective method for human to perceive emotions. However, fuzzy facial information in large scenes may lead to decreased recognition accuracy, and gait information containing emotional features is less limited by distance to a certain extent<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. In view of the above situation, this paper integrates the gait and facial information and conducts in-depth research on the emotion recognition method based on advanced deep learning algorithm to furtherly improve the recognition accuracy. Aiming at the issue of the relatively limited sample quantity in the gait dataset, from the perspective of spatial graph convolution in the field of graph signal processing, a Shift spatio-temporal graph convolution gait emotion recognition network based on the self-attention mechanism is put forward. This effectively mitigates the drawback that the lightweight Shift spatio-temporal graph convolution network disregards the inherent connections among joints and significantly enhances the accuracy of gait emotion recognition.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge graph construction method for mine hoist fault field
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Mine hoists are integral to mining hoisting systems, with their safe and reliable operation being critical for ensuring the safety of mining operations. The consequences of hoist failure are severe, particularly when the root cause of the malfunction is not promptly identified and addressed, potentially compromising the overall safety of mining activities. The complexity of mine hoist systems stems from the interdependent and restrictive relationships among their components, each of which generates unique operational state information. This information, when aggregated and processed, can be distilled into various fault characteristic parameters. This paper introduces a novel approach to fault diagnosis within mine hoist systems by constructing a fault knowledge graph based on ontological principles. The proposed method harnesses the power of knowledge graphs to systematically represent and analyze the complex interplay of components within the hoist system. By doing so, it enhances the diagnostic capabilities and the preemptive identification of potential faults. The research focuses on the mine hoist as the subject of study and proposes the development of an ontologically-based fault knowledge graph. This approach is not only of significant importance to the coal mining industry but also offers innovative insights for knowledge graph construction across various domains. The implications of this study extend beyond the mining sector, providing a foundation for more robust and intelligent fault diagnosis systems in complex mechanical systems.

articleTitle: Design of Full-Bridge LLC Resonant Converter with Frequency-Shift and Phase-Shift Hybrid Control
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes a design method for a full bridge LLC resonant converter based on hybrid control of frequency conversion and phase shifting to address the issue of unstable power supply of renewable energy. The principles and characteristics of variable-frequency control and phase-shift control of the full-bridge LLC resonant converter are provided, and the switch modes of the two control methods are analyzed. The circuit parameters of the converter are designed accordingly. Finally, the design method is verified through simulation, which shows that the converter can flexibly switch between variable-frequency and phase-shift control modes within a wide input voltage range of 250 V to 500 V, accurately adjust the switching frequency or phase shift angle, and achieve a stable 360 V output voltage.

articleTitle: An Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm for Ocean Wireless Sensor Network Coverage Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSN) is widely used in fields such as marine environmental protection, and their nodes are usually deployed randomly, which can easily lead to low coverage in the monitoring area. On the basis of Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA), a new improved algorithm (IWOA) is proposed to solve the optimization deployment of WSN nodes and improve the communication performance of marine wireless sensor networks. The IWOA algorithm improves the coverage performance of network signals by adjusting the probability values of contraction and spiral update behaviors, as well as dynamically adjusting the step size of whale position updates. Using MATLAB to simulate the signal coverage of wireless sensor networks in a limited area, with 40 sensor nodes, IWOA improves the coverage of WSN by 2.99% compared to WOA. The experimental results show that IWOA algorithm can effectively improve the coverage performance of nodes and enhance the coverage of WSN.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study on the queues at the U-turn signalized intersections
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In recent years, in order to improve traffic efficiency, intelligent transportation has developed rapidly, but with the continuous increase of motor vehicle ownership, the traffic congestion phenomenon on urban roads is still becoming more and more serious. As an important hub connecting urban roads, signalized intersections often face great traffic pressure, and improving the service capacity of signalized intersections is the key to improving the service level of the entire urban road network. Vehicle U-turn is one of the important traffic behaviors at signalized intersections, and due to the special trajectory of vehicles when making U-turns, it is easier to conflict with traffic in other directions and cause congestion and accidents, so it is the key to improve the service level of signalized intersections. In this study, the queueing situation of U-turn vehicles at the signalized intersection with a special U-turn lane is mathematically modeled, and the queueing length and queueing delay under different scenarios are solved, and the influence of related factors is studied by numerical experiments, and the effectiveness of the mathematical model is verified by the simulation model, and the performance evaluation of the signalized intersection with a special U-turn lane is realized.

articleTitle: An annotation and indexing model based on automotive cybersecurity test cases
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes an annotation and indexing model based on automotive cybersecurity test cases, which includes: firstly, annotating the test cases and establishing a label list; then, counting the frequency of occurrence and weight of high-frequency words in the label list, and constructing a retrieval model; finally, inputting the contents of the test cases entered by the user into the retrieval model, get the preliminary retrieval results, and determine the final retrieval results according to the operation of the test cases. The model proposed in this paper can effectively improve the retrieval speed of cybersecurity test cases for intelligent connected vehicles. In addition, this paper develops a whole-vehicle software test bed system to realize the digital management of automotive cybersecurity test cases.

articleTitle: Skinning Based 3D Character Model Auto Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: 3D character model is the carrier of human in the virtual world. Games, film, industry, and other application areas need a large number of practical and creative character models, but it needs a long time and excellent technicians to create an animated model from the design to the full. To simplify this process, oriented to instance-based modeling, this paper proposes an automatic 3D character model segmentation algorithm. The algorithm is based on existing character models with binding skeleton. Based on the skinning information, the mesh and skeleton of models are segmented into five preconfigured human segmentation parts from a semantic library, and the boundaries of each part are optimized. Finally, an average plane is created for each boundary as its average representation. Experiments on models from the web confirm the effectiveness and reliability of this algorithm, laying a solid foundation for improving the efficiency of 3D character modeling.

articleTitle: Multi-focus image fusion method based on deep residual shrinkage network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Through the use of multi-focus image fusion techniques, several images taken of the same scene at various focuses can be focused into a fully focused image. Previously, multi-focus image fusion methods commonly existed with problems such as image distortion, block artifacts, contrast degradation and loss of edge contour details. The paper proposed a method using a feature enhancement module and a deep residual shrinkage network to address these problems. The feature enhancement block is used to obtain more features of source images. The ability of the method to extract features is enhanced by the combination of multi-branch convolution and an attention mechanism. Distinguishing from previous fusion rules, the paper used the basic blocks of a deep residual shrinkage network to implement feature fusion. In addition to having a good ability to extract features, the suggested method also results in final fused images that retain more information. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better fusion performance in terms of both objective metrics and subjective visual effects compared with other existing multi-focus image fusion methods.

articleTitle: Semi-end-to-end Based ECG abnormality detection method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To solve the problem of information redundancy or loss caused by ECG abnormality detection in fixed-length samples, our team proposed a feature extraction and classification method based on 3R samples and TSL. Although this method solves the above problems, it also has two defects: the current algorithm is based on the results obtained for each $3 R$ sample, and it does not regression to the complete sample, which will lead to multiple classification results for a complete sample in some cases. In addition, the original algorithm needs to screen high-quality signals, in which the double-threshold threshold method can not adapt to the signals from different devices. we proposes a semi-end-to-end ECG abnormality detection and quadratic modelling regression algorithm in this paper. In the pre-processing part, the high-quality screening process is omitted, and the noise samples are classified and recognized as a class of ECG samples. Meanwhile, for the problem that the original 3R classification results are not reduced to the complete samples, this study proposes a secondary modelling approach based on the 3R classification probability matrix and the complete sample labels to regress the classification results. twelve-category classification and three-category classification experiments are carried out on Cardiol Set dataset, and the results show that the method in the paper has significant improvement over the original method.

articleTitle: Construction and Design of an Academic Ability Evaluation System for Vocational College Students Fused K-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The existing academic ability evaluation standards for vocational college students overly focus on commonalities while neglecting individual differences among students, and place too much emphasis on teaching outcomes while ignoring the teaching process. To effectively evaluate the individual differences and academic abilities exhibited by vocational college students during online learning, this paper constructs an academic ability evaluation index system, uses exploratory factor analysis to condense the indicator items, and further divides and labels learners through the k-means algorithm, creating learner portraits. Taking the learning situation of practical training platform courses for students majoring in big data and accounting at a certain college as the experimental subject, the simulation results show that the constructed academic ability evaluation system includes 5 dimensions and 16 specific measurement indicators, demonstrating good reliability and validity. After clustering, students of different categories show significant differences in evaluations across the 5 dimensions, and groups with lower multidimensional evaluations can be effectively identified. Subsequently, precise teaching intervention strategies can be designed for the target groups to improve teaching quality.

articleTitle: MM-UNeXt: Multi-Module Medical Image Segmentation Network Based on Subregions and Spatial Shifts
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: UNet and its extended models have achieved great success in the field of medical image segmentation, including hybrid models such as CNN combined with Transformer and CNN combined with multilayer perceptron. However, these existing hybrid models cannot balance model complexity and segmentation performance well. They cannot achieve accurate segmentation under limited hardware resources. To solve this problem, we propose MM-UNeXt, a multi-module lightweight network for medical image segmentation. Among them, we propose a feature extraction module. MM-UNeXt first performs a dimension transformer to divide the original image into multiple sub-regions. This module extracts local information in each sub-region to enhance the perception of local features. We also propose a Shift-MLP-DSC module, which effectively shifts in both horizontal and vertical directions, combines multilayer perceptron and depthwise separable convolution to enhance the spatial relationship of features and extract more advanced abstract features in medical images. To further improve performance, we design a global auxiliary module to capture feature information of different ranges under different receptive fields and improve the model’s ability to extract global information. We verified the effectiveness of MM-UNeXt on the BUSI dataset. The number of parameters and computational complexity of this method are 2.46 M and 17.58 G respectively. On the BUSI dataset, the IoU and DSC indicators of this method reached 71.98 % and 83.26% respectively. Considering the complexity of the model and the segmentation performance, MM-UNeXt is superior to the currently widely used advanced methods.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Normal Probability Density Function in Modelling Safety Score Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The normal distribution model has strong application in mathematical and statistical research. In communication system, each electron component has a safety score, aiming to measure the its stability and reliability in use. This essay examines the effectiveness of normal distribution in modelling electron components’ safety score distribution, and also seeks for the optimized probability density function in modelling our sample data. Throughout the model fitting process, the effect of different parameters of model on the graph is discussed. Result of research shows that normal distribution model can fit the safety score distribution well.

articleTitle: Research on test case generation method of interlocking software based on UPPAAL
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low efficiency of interlocking software testing, incomplete testing and inconsistent with practical application, an automatic generation method of test cases of interlocking software in railway station was proposed. Combined with the specific station, the interlocking table was compiled, and the UPPAAL software was used to model, simulate, verify and simplify the approach control module according to the interlocking logic process. For the simplified model, the search algorithm is used to generate the test case set, and then the optimization algorithm is used to generate the test sequence set. Finally, the AutoItX library is used to write test scripts corresponding to the test cases to verify the correctness and comprehensiveness of the generated test sequence set. The test cases generated by this method can cover all the test functions of the railway station interlocking test, which is close to the actual site requirements, makes up for the shortcomings of the traditional test method, realizes the automation of the test, and improves the test efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Agent-Based Data Acquisition Techniques for IT Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: IT infrastructure contains many different systems and devices, in which the uncertainty and non-uniformity of data sources is an urgent problem to be solved. Therefore, this paper proposes the research of Agent-based IT infrastructure data collection technology. In the architectural design of the system for IT infrastructure data acquisition, the coordination and collaboration mechanism of multiple systems is analyzed, and heterogeneous data is converted into homogeneous data through data mapping. Communication between Agents is used to coordinate the work between them, so as to efficiently achieve the tasks of acquiring, converting and storing heterogeneous data. In addition, Agents are able to monitor the status of the IT infrastructure in real time, and detect and respond to system performance problems or security threats in time, so as to take actions quickly. The experimental results show that by deploying intelligent Agents, data can be collected, processed and transmitted in an automated manner, reducing manual intervention and improving the efficiency and accuracy of data acquisition.

articleTitle: A Diffusion Data Enhancement Retentive Model for Sequential Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: When using deep learning techniques to process sequential recommendation content, neural network models are typically trained relying on a wealth of historical interaction feedback. However, this feedback data often contains natural or artificial noise, which can impact the extraction of interaction feature data by the model. Diffusion models, known for their powerful denoising capabilities, gain broad usage across image and natural language processing domains. Due to this powerful advantage, diffusion models theoretically have great potential for sequence-based recommendation tasks. In this article, we propose a diffusion data enhancement retentive model called DIDER for sequential recommendation. By applying a diffusion model during the denoising phase of neural networks, the model effectively enhances data features. Subsequently, a retentive model is introduced into sequential recommendation to leverage its powerful data processing capabilities for learning data features. Finally, the integration of acquired features is achieved through the application of a Multi-Layer Perception. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model, in-depth experiments involving two authentic datasets are carried out, revealing that the DIDER model excels in comparison to various baseline methods.

articleTitle: Total coloring of 4-regular circulant graphs and Abelian graphs
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In this paper, we study the total chromatic numbers of three families of Cayley graphs. We proved that the 4-regular circulant graph $C_{4 n}(1,4)$ for any integer $n\gt2$ and $C_{4 \lambda n}(1, n)$ for integers $\lambda$ and n, when $\lambda \geq 1$ and n is even are Type 1, which verifies the conjecture proposed by Khennoufa and Togni. In addition, we proved that the 4-regular Cayley graph $\Gamma\left(\mathbb{Z}_{2 n} \times\right.$ $\left.\mathbb{Z}_{3 m}, S\right)$ is Type 1, where $S=\left\{a^{-1}, a, a b, a^{-1} b\right\}$

articleTitle: A study of point clouds based on geometric disentanglement and feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The point cloud can be de-entangled into sharply varying frame components and slowly varying plane components, which complement each other to construct complete point cloud geometric information. Geometric de-entanglement attention network (GDAnet) dynamically de-entangles the point cloud into the contour and plane portions of a 3D object, which are represented by sharply varying and slowly varying components, respectively, and supplements the localized information by capturing and refining the overall and complementary 3D geometric semantic meanings. In this paper, the geometric disentanglement part and the feature fusion part of GDAnet are improved, and the metric formula is improved in the disentanglement part to make the disentanglement better, while the attention calculation and fusion and splicing operation of the components reduces some of the redundancy information, fully explores the relationship between the points, and incorporates the remote context into the local information, which makes the improved network faster and more accurate in the ModelNet40 and SharpNet datasets are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Granularity Detection and Recognition of Vehicle Faces
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: As the vehicle ownership rates rise, rapid and accurate vehicle detection is essential for trafffc regulations and law enforcement. This paper proposes the EC-YOLO algorithm based on YOLOv8 to address challenges in current methods. It uses EfffcientNetv2 to redesign the backbone network, reducing parameters and maintaining high speed and accuracy. With the Focal loss function, it improves detection accuracy, reduces parameters by 71.4% and computation by 31.3%, and increases speed by 77.1%. The algorithm preserves high accuracy and shows superior real-time performance, making it a promising solution.

articleTitle: Improved steel surface defect detection algorithm based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To enhance the efficiency of detecting steel surface defects, a novel detection algorithm for steel surface defects leveraging YOLOv8 was devised. This algorithm integrates a Generalized Attention Mechanism (GAM), amalgamating channel and spatial attention for superior image feature augmentation, which improves performance in image processing tasks. Moreover, to significantly enhance the accuracy of small target detection and multi-scale information fusion, the algorithm introduces a P2 small target detection layer. Extensive ablation and comparison experiments were performed on the NEU-DET dataset, revealing that the novel algorithm demonstrated a precision improvement of 2.5 percentage points, a recall increment of 3.3 percentage points, a 2.1 percentage point boost in mAP@0.5, and a 3.5 percentage point enhancement in mAP@0.5:0.95 over the original algorithm. Additionally, the precision of the newly introduced algorithm exceeded the original YOLOv8 algorithm by 1.5 percentage points, with recall rising by 2.2 percentage points, mAP@0.5 increasing by 2.6 percentage points, and a notable 7 percentage point rise in mAP@0.5:0.95.

articleTitle: Discussion on the construction about urban-scale 3D real scene
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The development of new fundamental surveying and mapping, coupled with 3D real scene technology, has sparked a new trend in China. Urban-scale 3D real scene technology marks a crucial step in advancing the country’s comprehensive 3D infrastructure. Xi’an, a pilot city in this initiative, aims to strengthen the digital economy and bolster smart city construction. To achieve this, the city implemented a comprehensive approach encompassing product, production, policy, technical, and application systems. The entire project lifecycle, from design to data production, storage, and platform applications, was thoroughly executed. The resulting innovations serve as a benchmark for similar endeavors, paving the way for future advancements in this field.

articleTitle: A study of department matching based on online medical patient data
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Based on the patient consultation data of 36 departments obtained from online medical websites, this paper uses TFIDF and word vector algorithms to represent the patient consultation data in Chinese text, and then constructs three kinds of classification models, namely, random forest, convolutional neural network, and long and short-term memory network, to classify the departments, and the experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the random forest model reaches up to 91.69%, and the accuracy rates of convolutional neural network and long and short-term memory network are 91.06% and 89.15%, respectively. Neural Network and Long Short-term Memory Network were 91.06% and 89.15% respectively, and finally, the stability of Random Forest model was found to be the best by integrating the recall rate and other evaluation indexes, so the Random Forest model was finally selected for the experiment.

articleTitle: Infrared Camera Array Image Super-Resolution based on Zero-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The infrared camera array is capable of capturing infrared features in a single scene from multiple views, thereby supplying rich angular information for a range of post-capture tasks, one of which is the image super-resolution (SR). Since the spatial resolution of each sub-image is limited by the diffraction effects, prevalent SR methodologies endeavor to improve image quality by acquiring prior knowledge from extensive datasets. However, the scarcity of the publicly available infrared array image dataset makes it difficult to rely on conventional model training strategies. To address this, inspired by the recent advance in zero-shot learning and light field image SR, this paper proposes a zero-shot infrared array image SR method. Specifically, we design an array feature extraction module (AFEM) to incorporate latent correlations within views and employ a zero-shot training strategy to enable model learning with one input low-resolution scene. Experiments show that the proposed method can achieve reliable performance in both objective metrics and visual effects.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Construction Path of Smart Campuses Integrated with Artificial IntelliGence-Generated Content
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the advancement of the global digital wave, vocational education, as an important field of training for technical and skilled talent, is facing the urgent need for digital transformation. This paper discusses the construction path of smart campuses in vocational colleges based on the integration of artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC), analyses the current situation and existing problems in the construction of smart campuses, proposes the architectural design of smart campuses based on AIGC, and expounds its realization path in detail, emphasizing learner-centred and coc onstruction. It aims to improve the quality and efficiency of vocational education and train high-skilled talent to meet market demand through the construction of digital campuses. Finally, it looks forward to the future direction of smart campus construction, which provides a reference for the implementation of digital transformation in vocational colleges and promotes the digital application of vocational education.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Emergency Plan for Maritime Search and Rescue Based on Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Evaluation of emergency plan is beneficial to achieving dynamic optimization and standardized management of emergency plan. In order to scientifically evaluate emergency plan for maritime search and rescue, evaluation indicator system of emergency plan for maritime search and rescue consisting of 4 one-level indicators and 16 two-level indicators is constructed combined with the regulations on emergency plan management and the actual maritime search and rescue work. Evaluation model of emergency plans for maritime search and rescue is established based on back propagation neural network. The evaluation model has been trained and the training result is good. The case study shows that the result of emergency plan evaluation in the city is general and consistent with actual situation. The city’s emergency plan for maritime search and rescue needs to be revised according to the result. The evaluation model can scientifically and effectively evaluate emergency plan and provide support for revision of emergency plans for maritime search and rescue.

articleTitle: Dual stream mask attention network to predict the LN metastasis for gastric cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Gastric cancer has been one of the leading causes of death among oncological patients. Lymph node (LN) metastasis classification is an important task for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) using abdominal CT images. Due to the size and shape variation of gastric tumor, it is challenging to propose a reliable solution. In this paper, we develop an improved classification model called double stream mask guided attention network (DSMANet), which can fuse features from tumor region and gastric region. Meanwhile, we innovatively devise iterative softpool attentional feature fusion (iSAFF) block instead of the simple feature concatenate. We evaluate our DSMANet on a self-collected CT images dataset containing 649 cases. Our comparison experiment and ablation experiment demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable classification performance compared with the SOTA classification model.

articleTitle: A Novel CNN-Transformer Framework for COVID-19 Diagnosis from ECG Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Research has demonstrated that COVID-19 impacts both the respiratory and cardiovascular systems. Timely and accurate detection of COVID-19 infection using electrocardiogram (ECG) images holds significant research importance. Most researchers have implemented convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to develop COVID-19 diagnostic models based on electrocardiograms (ECGs). However, such models primarily focus on local feature extraction and often lack understanding of inter-lead relationships. This study proposes a novel CNN-transformer framework that enhances the understanding and utilization of inter-lead features by leveraging CNN with CBAM for effective local feature extraction and Transformer encoders for generating rich, stable, and globally representative features. Finally, a classifier based on pre-trained DenseNet161 is employed for diagnosis. The proposed model achieves excellent performance across various evaluation metrics on the COVID-19 dataset, notably achieving an F1 score of 0.98, precision and specificity of 1.0, demonstrating robust diagnostic capabilities.

articleTitle: Human mesh model extraction strategy based on NeRF
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper introduces a human body three-dimensional mesh extraction strategy based on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), aiming to address the limitations of existing technologies in acquiring high-quality 3D human body models. Traditional techniques require expensive equipment and specialized setups, while our system is more lightweight and can quickly generate new viewpoint images and editable 3D mesh models with limited computational resources. By combining SMPL-parameterized human body models with NeRF rendering, our system can accurately capture both the shape and appearance of human bodies while allowing for control over the reconstruction process. The paper discusses the key stages of the reconstruction process, such as model training, image rendering, mesh model extraction, and the formulation of loss functions. Experimental results show that our reconstruction system surpasses existing approaches on the People-Snapshot benchmark dataset, particularly in preserving intricate clothing textures.

articleTitle: A dynamic envelope extraction method of spacecraft parameters based on improved curve matching search
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The dynamic envelope of spacecraft telemetry parameters is used to evaluate whether the spacecraft design and performance meet the requirements, and is also used for abnormal detection and health assessment of spacecraft. Traditional envelope extraction methods based on manual annotation or expert knowledge are difficult to adapt to the current design status of spacecraft with numerous parameters and massive data. Moreover, the adaptive envelope estimation methods based on deep neural network are hard to extract the real envelope of telemetry parameters. A dynamic envelope extraction method based on improved curve matching search (ICMS) is proposed. The ICMS method combines the curve matching method with traversal search, which first traverse the parameter sequence curve to be matched on the historical parameter sequence curve to calculate the matching score, and then locate and extract the fitting point based on matching threshold. To solve the problem of poor envelope accuracy caused by many interference points in extracted points, an optimization method for spacecraft parameter interference reduction based on range boundary is designed, using for screen out interference points. Finally, the upper and lower lines of the envelope are calculated. To verify the effectiveness and universality of the anti-interference performance of the ICMS method, two sets of experiments were designed to extract envelope of parameters from navigation & control sub-system and thermal control sub-system of 3 different spacecraft. The results show that compared with curve matching search method, the ICMS method can significantly reduce the influence of interference points, and can be applied to different spacecraft, the accuracy of dynamic envelope extraction in the two different spacecraft is 100%, which proves that it can extract dynamic envelope efficiently.

articleTitle: Privacy Quantification Model Based on Markov Chain and Bayesian Theorem
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper introduces a privacy quantification model based on Markov Chain and Bayesian Theorem, aimed at establishing a pricing model for private information. The study is structured across three levels: individual, group, and national. For individuals, the model utilizes a combination of AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) and EEM (Entropy Evaluation Method) to determine the value of personal data, followed by a TOPSIS (Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution) evaluation for pricing. At the group level, a multiway tree is used to classify subgroups, and risk perception is quantified based on privacy type, generational differences, social network effects, and data breaches. The model dynamically adjusts values using a Markov Chain and Bayesian probability formula, providing a robust framework for private information pricing.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Routing Protocol for TDMA Mobile Ad hoc Networks Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs) possess several unique qualities, including multiple nodes, dynamic topology changes, decentralized operation, and adaptability. However, conventional routing protocols employed in MANETs often suffer from various drawbacks, such as imbalanced network load, limited network throughput, inadequate resilience, and subpar transmission reliability. This article designs a TDMA mobile ad hoc network routing decision protocol based on deep neural networks (DNNs), which can provide different routing strategies under the superposition of multiple business type requirements and complex link conditions. And the routing process includes neighbor relationship establishment, topology flooding, intelligent routing strategy decision-making, and routing establishment. After learning topology information and service demand, nodes can calculate the routing table and find the most suitable path. Finally, the routing protocol is developed on the OMNeT++ simulation platform, and its effectiveness and excellent network performance are tested through experiments.

articleTitle: IFSWOA: Integrated Biomarker Selection Method Based on Incremental Feature Selection and Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In biological omics research, a notable characteristic of datasets is the overwhelming number of features compared to samples, posing significant challenges for data mining and model development. Feature selection algorithms serve as an effective approach to tackle this issue, aiming to identify the most representative biomarkers and consequently build predictive models with superior performance. However, the complexity and latent patterns within the feature selection solution space render the search for optimal feature subsets a daunting task. The Incremental Feature Selection (IFS) algorithm stands out in the field of feature selection due to its statistical underpinnings and excellent machine learning performance. Notably, different IFS algorithms exhibit complementary search capabilities when exploring feature subsets. This suggests that integrating multiple IFS algorithms can enable a more efficient exploration of the feature space, leading to the discovery of superior feature combinations. Drawing upon this insight, we introduce a novel feature selection method called IFSWOA. This method integrates three IFS-based feature selection algorithms and introduces an enhanced Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) to further refine the selected features. Through this approach, we significantly enhance the quality of the selected feature subsets and the predictive performance of the models. Experimental results demonstrate that the IFSWOA algorithm outperforms existing feature selection algorithms on a majority of omics datasets. This achievement not only validates the efficacy of IFS algorithms in biological omics feature selection, but also provides a novel and efficient feature selection strategy, opening new avenues for the analysis and mining of biological omics data.

articleTitle: Rainfall Process Similarity Algorithm Research Based on Deep Learning by Using Precipitation Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Rainfall is the main cause of flood disasters, and analyzing its features plays a crucial role in preventing flood disasters. How to extract rainfall process features and conduct rainfall similarity analysis is a challenging work.
