Based on the similarity search method for daily precipitation images, this paper proposes a rainfall process similarity search method, which extracts rainfall duration, cumulative precipitation, temporal distribution, spatial distribution and center movement trajectory as the features of rainfall process, and defines a set-weighting method based on the Grey Wolf Optimization algorithm (IGWO) to weight and fuse the five extracted features as the similarity measure of rainfall process. The similarity search results of rainfall process images on the Jialing Basin illustrate that the method proposed in this paper can efficiently and accurately identify similar rainfall processes in historical scenes, thereby providing a new technical support for intelligent rainfall-flood forecasting.

articleTitle: A Weighted Extended Isolation Forest Method Based on Hierarchical Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Isolation Forest (IF) is one of the classical outlier detection methods, which quickly and efficiently identifies outliers in a dataset based on tree structure. However, IF treats each tree as equally important, resulting in inaccuracies in calculating anomaly scores. Besides, using the irrelevant attributes lead to invalid segmentation and make inaccurate outliers detection. To address the above mentioned issues, a new weighted extended isolation forest method based on hierarchical feature selection (HWEIF) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the number of feature is iteratively reduced by the hierarchical feature selection step, and the anomaly scores are grouped under the optimal feature number. Secondly, the pseudo-marked data are obtained from the grouped anomaly scores, and the isolation forest using pseudo-marked data is trained by the proposed adaptive crossover and mutation operator. Based on the step of adaptive and crossover mutation, the weight for each tree is given. Finally, the proposed weighted path is used to compute the anomaly score of the data. The experimental results show HWEIF outperforms other comparative algorithms in terms of ROC curve, ROC-AUC, Average Precision and Rank Power evaluation metrics on UCI and LAMOST spectral datasets.

articleTitle: CBBFT - A Byzantine Fault Tolerance Mechanism for Education Credit Banks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In the education sector, an increasing amount of research is beginning to explore the application of blockchain technology to credit banks. This paper proposes a consortium blockchain consensus mechanism tailored for credit bank applications, aiming to address issues such as single point of failure, large message volumes, and slowest node limitations inherent in existing BFT-like consensus protocols. This includes algorithms for secret random selection of block proposer nodes based on reputation scores and block selection, as well as introducing a reputation model. Subsequently, a detailed analysis of the security of this consensus protocol is conducted. Finally, the paper evaluates the performance of the proposed consensus protocol through experimentation.

articleTitle: A lightweight object detection algorithm for aircraft skin defects based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To solve the problem of redundancy in aircraft skin defect detection algorithms, this paper proposes a lightweight algorithm for target detection aircraft skin defects. We propose a new ELAN module, the ELAN-GDW module is used as the backbone module of the main network. A PCBL module is used to further reduce the computational cost and make the convolution more efficient and the memory utilization more sufficient. In addition, the SimAM attention module is introduced into the concat module to enhance the network’s multi-dimensional perception and multi-scale feature extraction capabilities. Experimental results on self-labeled dataset show that: compared with YOLOv7-tiny, GDWP-YOLO reduces the number of parameters by 69% with almost no loss of accuracy with only 4.0 MB of model size, illustrating it has better performance in environments with limited computing resources.

articleTitle: Information network analysis method based on two-layer complex network model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper proposes an information network analysis method based on a two-layer complex network model. The study establishes a double-layer complex network consisting of a global information network and a point-to-point information network to reflect information flow more accurately. By introducing node and edge feature vectors and applying the Bayesian logistic function, the propagation probability and delay are calculated to describe the information dissemination process. Additionally, the reaction-diffusio‘n model is utilized to investigate information flow between regions, determining the propagation probability and delay between different nodes. The paper conducts sensitivity analysis to verify the stability and applicability of the model, and coefficients are determined through computer-trained data. Finally, experiments demonstrate the model’s effectiveness in various media propagation scenarios and predict the information dissemination situation and development trends in different countries by 2050.

articleTitle: An Aircraft Structural Component Process Route Recommendation Engine Based on ANN-LCS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: A process route recommendation engine for aviation structural components based on ANN-LCS algorithm is introduced. By processing the machining process knowledge of aviation structural components, defining their basic information and process route data, and then constructing and training an ANN (Artificial Neural Network) to classify parts. Based on part classification, the LCS (Longest Common Substring) algorithm based on dynamic programming is used to generate process routes. Through the testing of process route recommendation examples, the results show that this method can effectively obtain and select feasible process routes in the process design stage.

articleTitle: DETG: Dual encoding document level relation extraction based on tree graph
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In recent years, graph-based and sequence-based document-level relation extraction models have attracted much attention. However, when performing document-level relation extraction tasks, traditional graph-based models struggle to address the overfitting issue of graph convolutional networks when analyzing document information, and sequence-based models may not effectively capture all document features. To address the above problems, we propose a document level relation extraction model based on dendrogram with dual encoders. The model uses dual encoders to extract document features of various granularities to construct a dendrogram structure. Experimental results on the public dataset DocRED show that the performance of the proposed model is significantly improved compared to other models that solely rely on graph structure or sequence structure.

articleTitle: A Retail Product Prediction Model Incorporating Machine Learning and Propensity Score Matching Method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Existing machine learning methods for retail product sales forecasting often rely on their own time series data and tend to ignore the correlation between the target retail product and other products. In this paper, we take cigarette product retail sales prediction as an example, and use the neighboring related alcohol sales data to predict cigarette product sales through the propensity score matching (PSM) method, KMeans++ clustering algorithm and XGBoost algorithm. Specifically, we use cigarette and alcohol sales data from Guangzhou, China for the years 2021-2022 as the study sample, and the results show 1) Compared with using only tobacco data and machine learning algorithms, the modeling accuracy improves from 82.79% to 91.34% by introducing neighboring alcohol sales data and combining PSM and machine learning XGBoost algorithms. 2) The machine learning XGBoost algorithm identifies successive important features of cigarette sales data: category, specification, price range, and revenue from neighboring alcohol sales (new features generated by the PSM and KMeans++ algorithms). The conclusions show that the PSM algorithm and the machine learning XGBoost algorithm can incorporate other retail products to predict target products and provide an empirical application for predicting retail sales based on associations with neighboring related products

articleTitle: Evaluation Model-Based Hybrid Consensus Algorithm for Blockchain in Automated Natural Gas Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In natural gas automated trading, transaction efficiency of the whole trading system will inevitably be affected with the expansion of network size and the increase of transaction volume. In order to improve the timeliness of the consensus algorithm, a hybrid consensus algorithm PoE (Proof of Evaluation) which combines proof-of-work and proof-of-stake based on evaluation model is proposed. Firstly, the nodes are randomly and uniformly grouped, and each group performs the selection of candidate nodes in a PoW manner, which divides the nodes into candidate nodes and normal nodes, and reduces the difficulty of hash computation, thus reducing the arithmetic resources consumed in finding random numbers. Secondly, the upper limit of the entitlement value is set, which solves the problem of infinite growth of the entitlement. The credit mechanism is introduced to obtain the credit evaluation of the nodes. And lastly, the candidate nodes are evaluated by the evaluation model with a weight val-ue evaluation, and the candidate node with the largest weight value obtains the block bookkeeping right. Theoretical studies and simulation experiments show that our algorithm can reduce the waste of arithmetic resources, balance the competition for bookkeeping rights, and improve the security while reducing the delay and increasing the throughput. It provides new ideas to enhance the function of blockchain system, and also meets the basic technical standards of natural gas automated transactions, effectively solving the problems of transaction processing inefficiency in natural gas automated transactions.

articleTitle: A degree of freedom extension-based sparse Bayesian learning algorithm for improving the resolution of the coprime array
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Array signal processing is one of the core technologies in radar field. With the advantages of low cost and low complexity, coprime arrays are expected to be a prominent feature of direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation in array signal processing. However, the existed holes in different coarrays render the virtual array discontiguous. High speed and small long-range targets will cause limited snapshots and low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), which is hard to achieve super-resolution. To solve this problem, we propose a degree of freedom (DoF) extension-based Sparse Bayesian Learning algorithm with coprime arrays. To distinguish group targets, the proposed algorithm completes the holes and adopts subspace fitting based off-grid sparse Bayesian learning to achieve DoA estimation. Simulation results prove that the proposed algorithm can distinguish 4 targets with 2 degrees interval, and the root mean square error (RMSE) of DoA estimation is less than 0.01. The proposed algorithm can obtain higher performance gain with low SNR and limited snapshots.

articleTitle: Face expression generation method based on interactive evolutionary algorithm and expression fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The generation of facial expressions has long been a challenging problem. In order to generate user-satisfactory facial expressions, this paper proposes an expression generation method based on an interactive evolutionary algorithm. The method employs an interactive evolutionary algorithm to optimize expression parameters in order to obtain satisfactory face expression parameters. Different face parameters express the fusion of predefined expressions in different parts of the face. By designing the face expression coding, it is possible to achieve a diversity of fusion effects in time and space, thus enabling the realization of a rich animation process of face expressions.

articleTitle: Sequence-to-Sequence Multi-Hop Knowledge Reasoning Based on Retentive Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Multi-hop Knowledge Reasoning is a task that involves generating an answer given a query and a knowledge graph. Existing sequence-to-sequence reasoning models use the Transformer to encode and decode sequences, but these models have some flaws, such as the inability to effectively handle long-sequence reasoning and susceptibility to exposure bias. To address these issues, we provides a sequence-to-sequence reasoning model named STSR, which is based on Retentive Network. Aiming at improving training efficiency through parallel training, this model leverages the advantages in Retentive Network, reduce time overhead, and enhance reasoning efficiency through iterative reasoning. It effectively mitigates the problems of high spatial overhead and low efficiency in long-sequence reasoning faced by the Transformer. Moreover, it retains and updates historical information during the encoding and decoding process, enhancing the model’s memory and generalization capabilities. Additionally, the Scheduled Sampling method is adopted to alleviate the exposure bias introduced during reasoning, which involves using the model’s own output as the input for the next moment with a certain probability during training, instead of using the true label. We conduct the experiment on six public datasets, with the results showing that the proposed model outperforms existing baseline models in terms of precision and generation quality. This paper provides a new solution for the task of sequence-to-sequence multihop knowledge reasoning and also demonstrates the potential application of the Retentive Network in natural language processing.

articleTitle: Pump-BSKZ: A Novel Sieve Algorithm to Solve Shortest Vector Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: To solve hard problems in lattices is a crucial topic in lattice-based cryptanalysis, where the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP) is one of the most famous lattice problems. Recently, there are two kinds of approaches to solve approximate SVP. The one is Block Korkine-Zolotarev (BKZ)-type lattice reduction algorithms combined with enumeration, which suffers from high time complexity. The other is sieving algorithms such as the General Sieve Kernel (G6K) algorithm, which requires exponential space cost. In order to solve the above problems, in this paper, we propose a novel sieve algorithm, named Pump-BSKZ, to solve the approximate SVP with low time complexity and limited space cost. Firstly, our Pump-BSKZ algorithm can reduce a random lattice basis to a basis with better quality. We design a Block wise Sieving Korbine-Zolotarev (BSKZ) algorithm and apply sieving as a subroutine for solving SVP in local blocks. Secondly, our Pump-BSKZ algorithm can solve SVP in lattice with higher dimension. Based on the reduced basis, we design an improved Pump-sieve algorithm to find a shortest vector in arbitrary n-dimensional lattices. Thirdly, we give the formal proof of correctness for our Pump-BSKZ algorithm, then analyze time and space complexity. Finally, experiments done on TU Darmstadt SVP challenge in dimensions 90-130 reveal that our algorithm outperforms both BKZ 2.0 algorithm and G6K algorithm on time and space cost.

articleTitle: Research on the Correlation between Temporal Noise and Spatial Noise of Infrared Image after Two-point Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper conducts an in-depth study on the two-point correction technology widely used in infrared imaging systems, focusing on the main influencing factors of temporal noise and spatial noise in infrared images, the correlation between them after correction and their causes. Through theoretical analysis and experimental verification, this study reveals that the two-point correction algorithm has a certain potential impact on temporal noise while improving spatial non-uniformity. A complete test process for temporal noise and spatial noise is proposed. Optimization directions for improving the quality of infrared images after correction are proposed, and theoretical basis and technical guidance are provided for improving the comprehensive performance of infrared image processing.

articleTitle: STKG-STTN: Enhanced Traffic Flow Prediction Driven by Collaborative Spatio Temporal Knowledge Graph and Spatio-Temporal Transformer Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: However, by employing knowledge graphs to organize external factors, including the spatial structure and time series characteristics of the traffic section network, their collective influence on traffic flow prediction can be comprehended with confidence. We have developed an adaptive fusion mechanism to combine information from different networks. In addition, we introduced a new spatial-temporal Transformer to extract spatial knowledge and temporal features, incorporating stacking to improve the performance of the spatial-temporal extraction module. Our experiments with real datasets confirm that our proposed model significantly improves traffic flow prediction in various scenarios. The effectiveness of each module within the model is confirmed through ablation experiments, while parameter sensitivity experiments reveal the significant impact of key hyperparameters on the model’s performance. Our paper investigates additional relationship models that influence traffic flow prediction beyond spatial-temporal characteristics using knowledge graphs and introduces a mechanism for integrating heterogeneous network information to enhance traffic flow prediction.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Hardware-in-the-Loop System for On-Board Data Handling Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: During the development of On-Board Data Handling (OBDH) systems, it is essential to manufacture Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) system for testing OBDH systems. As OBDH systems become increasingly complex, the time and cost involved in manufacturing HIL system have escalated, gradually becoming a major factor affecting the development. In order to expedite the development of OBDH systems, we conducted an analysis of OBDH systems development tasks. Based on this analysis, we propose a reconfigurable HIL system that can be applied to OBDH system currently in development or those about to be initiated. The proposed system can be easily configured for various OBDH systems, eliminating the need to develop dedicated HIL system for each OBDH system development task. The proposed system is based on the concept of reconfigurable design which ensures its generality and reusability at the program, hardware, and FPGA levels and features a straightforward, cost-effective architecture, comprising solely a host computer and a highly integrated hardware board. This innovative system provides a cost-effective and efficient solution for development.

articleTitle: Homomorphic Encryption Based Full Flow Privacy Protection Scheme for Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the development of machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI) technology has reshaped our life in many aspects. Federated learning is a typical machine learning training architecture, which aims to train the model without sharing the sensitive privacy data. However, many researches show that there is still a privacy leakage possibility for federated learning. Network attackers can eavesdrop on the communication between clients and server and infer the privacy information from transmitted parameters. In addition, an honest-but-curious server which orchestrates the whole training process is able to access the privacy data. In order to deal with these problems, in this paper, we propose a homomorphic encryption based full flow privacy protection (FFPP) scheme for federated learning. Firstly, our FFPP scheme can protect the parameters transmitted between the clients and server from being leaked. We apply the additional homomorphic encryption algorithm to protect the data in federated learning. Secondly, with the additional homomorphic property, our FFPP scheme enables the honest-but-curious server to aggregate the global model parameters for all clients. We design a key management center to assist the server to aggregate the global parameters without accessing them directly. Finally, we formally prove the correctness and security of our FFPP scheme and do the experiment. The experiment performance shows that our FFPP scheme is more efficient than other related works.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Vision Technology for Light Industry Production
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the rise of artificial intelligence, the process of social informatization is accelerating, leading to numerous new industries. How to use information technology to assist the upgrading of traditional industries has become a hot topic in recent years. The liquor industry is one of the traditional production industries in urgent need of transformation. Unlike other brewed beverages, the semi-open production of Chinese liquor relies more on generationally passed-down experience than technology. The traditional training model lacks scientific evaluation standards, making it difficult to ensure trainees master correct techniques and scientific exertion methods. To improve the quality and efficiency of brewing action training while maintaining high-quality liquor, and to help brewing workers exert force scientifically, reduce labor intensity, and enhance labor protection, this project designed an intelligent and user-friendly brewing action training platform. Experimental results indicate that the improved model can accurately estimate human poses and effectively complete 3D human reconstruction, improving overall average accuracy by 0.74%. This validates the effectiveness of the proposed method and realizes the three-dimensional visualization of human actions. The project has preliminarily designed a simple brewing action training platform, which has practical value for the inheritance of brewing techniques and the protection of employee health.

articleTitle: Research on HTML5 Responsive Web Front-end Development Based on Bootstrap Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet technology, mobile products such as smart phones and ipads are popular, and mobile devices with different screen sizes have become the mainstream of users’ Internet access. For the traditional PC web page, different sizes of mobile devices are not compatible with the display, while responsive page design technology is to solve the above problems. In this paper, taking the development of the course website of “Construction and Maintenance of Prison Website” as an opportunity, it studies the characteristics and design concept of responsive web design and HTML5+CSS3.0 construction technology, analyzes the Bootstrap responsive framework, and designs and constructs a responsive website based on Bootstrap, to make the website pages respond to the different browsing devices, provide users with a more comfortable interface and good browsing experience, and facilitate students to learn anytime and anywhere.

articleTitle: Optimizing Elevator Energy Use with Machine Learning-Based Real-Time Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern buildings and the increasing demand for energy management, elevator energy consumption has gradually become a focus of attention. This study constructs a real-time prediction system for elevator energy consumption based on machine learning. The aim is to optimize elevator energy management strategies by analyzing historical operational data and environmental data. A random forest model is employed for energy consumption prediction. Through feature importance analysis, SHAP value interpretation, and partial dependence plot analysis, key factors influencing energy consumption, such as hourly operation frequency, elevator door openings, floor usage, building energy consumption, and load, are identified. Model evaluation results show that the random forest model performs excellently in terms of prediction accuracy. By establishing a performance monitoring system, the prediction performance of the model is continuously tracked and optimized, achieving real-time prediction and dynamic management of elevator energy consumption. After adjustments and optimizations, the final model’s prediction error is significantly reduced, accurately capturing the energy consumption trends. This study not only enhances the energy efficiency management of elevators but also provides a reference for energy optimization of other complex systems.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition in the Diabetes Field Based on Improved LEBERT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The complexity of medical terminologies, variations in professional terms, and the presence of nested entities in the diabetes domain pose challenges for named entity recognition, which has been a focal point of research in intelligent medicine. To address these issues, this study proposes the Lexicon and Syntax Information Enhanced BERT (SLEBERT) model for named entity recognition in the diabetes domain. Building upon the LEBERT model, the SLEBERT model introduces contextual features and syntactic information instances. The SLEBERT model matches the sentence with external medical dictionaries to construct character-word pairs and analyzes syntactic information based on characters. The lexicon-syntax adapter then integrates character information vectors, word information vectors, and syntactic information vectors for feature fusion, which is subsequently incorporated between the initial layers of BERT. Additionally, a diabetes domain corpus dataset is constructed and annotated using the BIOE sequence labeling method. On the self-built DiaNer dataset and the CCKS2019 Chinese electronic medical record dataset, SLEBERT outperforms other comparative models in this study, demonstrating superior entity recognition performance and validating the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: RexGANet based classification method for microcalcifications in mammograms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Breast microcalcifications are one of the important indicators of early breast cancer. Radiologists discriminate benign and malignant microcalcifications mainly based on their morphology and distribution. Convolutional neural network (CNN) excels at extracting morphological features of objects, while cannot accurately describe the spatial structural relationships among microcalcifications. To address this issue, a novel microcalcification classification model (RexGANet) that integrates CNN and graph attention network is proposed. In this model, the improved ResNeXt101 network is used to extract morphological features of microcalcifications, while the multihead graph attention network is utilized to extract their spatial distribution features. These two types of features are extracted by a dual branch parallel network and fused through the improved attentional feature fusion module to achieve microcalcification classification based on morphological and distribution features. In addition, to address the issue of class imbalance between benign and malignant microcalcifications, large margin-aware focal loss (LMFLOSS) is used to replace the cross-entropy loss function. The experimental results demonstrate that RexGANet achieves classification accuracies of 94.46% and 92.53% for DDSM and BCDR datasets, respectively, outperforming the state-of-the-art methods in the same field.

articleTitle: Insider Threat Detection Based on Personalized User Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In the information age, internal threats have become a major security challenge for enterprises and organizations. Traditional methods of detecting internal threats, due to their limitations, struggle to address the complex and variable scenarios of internal threats. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an internal threat detection model based on personalized modeling, ITDPUB. First, user behavior sequences are constructed by integrating user information to represent user activities. Then, a language model is used to perform feature learning on these behavior sequences to capture the underlying patterns in user behavior. Finally, a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) network is employed to detect internal threats based on the extracted user features. Experimental results on the CERT insider threat dataset indicate that ITDPUB achieves a high AUC score, effectively improving the accuracy of internal threat detection.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of SICDR rumor propagation model with time delay and psychological factors
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The proliferation of rumors across social media platforms impedes economic growth and disrupts social norms and stability. Considering the psychological changes caused by the environment and the time delay in the process of spreading rumors, this paper proposes a new susceptible-infective-countering-deliberating-recovered (SICDR) rumor propagation model by combining rumor countering and deliberating mechanisms. The dynamical equations of rumor propagation in a homogeneous network are given, the existence of equilibrium points is analyzed, and the basic reproduction number of the model is calculated by the next-generation matrix method. Routh-Hurwitz criterion and LaSalle’s Invariance Principle are used to analyze the local and global asymptotic stability of the equilibrium points. The theoretical outcomes are authenticated through the utilization of numerical simulations. The simulation results shows that psychological factors, time delay, rumor countering, and deliberating mechanisms have important effects on rumor propagation. Finally, based on the real Twitter data set, the least squares method is used to fit the model parameters, and the R-squared value of the SICDR model is 0.9933.

articleTitle: Integrated optimization based on HSV color mode and frequency domain processing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an ophthalmic image processing algorithm that integrates the use of HSV color mode, Fourier transform, Butterworth filter and histogram equalization, aiming to improve the quality of ophthalmic images and enhance the vascular structure and details, so as to improve the diagnostic accuracy and reliability of doctors’ diagnosis of ophthalmic diseases. First, by converting the original image to HSV color mode, we are able to separate the luminance channel of the image so that the luminance information of the image can be processed more efficiently without affecting its color and details. Next, a Fourier transform is performed on the luminance channel signals to convert the image from the spatial domain to the frequency domain in order to better understand the frequency characteristics and texture information of the image. Then, a Butterworth filter is applied to the V channel in the frequency domain to separate the high and low frequency signals of the image in order to highlight the vessel structure and details. On this basis, the high-frequency signal is superimposed on the original luminance signal, and the local contrast of the image is enhanced by Fourier inverse transform and histogram equalization to make the blood vessel structure more visible. Finally, the processed V-channel signal replaces the V-channel signal of the original image to output the enhanced image. With this algorithm, the enhancement of texture and structure of ophthalmic images is effectively realized, avoiding the loss of information due to overexposure and distortion, and providing ophthalmologists with a more accurate and reliable diagnostic tool.

articleTitle: Using a Hybrid-Domain Attention Mechanism with YOLOv8 for Victim Detection in Disasters
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The disaster response and management domain constitute a formidable challenge to resilience and technological innovation. Prompt identification and localization of victims are paramount for search and rescue teams during emergencies. However, the intricacy of disaster scenes, often obscured by haze and cluttered backgrounds, exacerbates the difficulty in distinguishing victims. This paper introduces an algorithm to detect and locate victims within affected areas. Leveraging the acclaimed YOLOv8 model, renowned for its exceptional speed and accuracy, this study advances the one-stage detector, subsequently termed DSP-YOLOv8, through enhancements tailored to bolster detection precision. By integrating DCNv2, SE, and SPDConv modules into YOLOv8, optimizing feature capture for complex shapes and establishing adaptive spatial and channel dependencies, thus enhancing detection across various scales and occlusion levels. The model was trained and tested on a dataset comprising 5100 images of victims. The efficacy of the developed model was assessed by comparative evaluations Faster R-CNN, SSD, YOLOv5, YOLOv6 and YOLOv8. The resultant model achieved a high accuracy rate of 95.11 percent. Performance evaluation during training and testing phases was conducted based on established metrics, including mean Average Precision (mAP), precision (P), recall (R), and Precision-Recall (PR) curves. The findings from our testing regimen underscore the proposed catastrophe victim identification technique’s efficacy, particularly in highly cluttered scenarios.

articleTitle: An Automated Machine Learning Workflow to Classify Soil Texture for Crop Yield
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Soil classification is used for crop selection to determine the type of activity that can be done on a particular piece of land. This is especially important for plantation purposes and crop selection. The current method of assessing soil type is time-consuming which relies on the expertise of agricultural professionals. The implementation of machine learning is expected to improve soil classification and provide better crop recommendations. The use of machine learning to classify soil could lead to more effective farming methods and improved crop suggestions. In this study, three algorithms were tested: Random Forest, Naїve Bayes, and k-Nearest Neighbor. Classification techniques were chosen as a data mining task to create a classification model. Random Forest had the best accuracy (99.81%), followed by K-nearest Neighbors (97.47%) and Naїve Bayes (89.11%). This means that Random F orest outperformed the other methods. The findings suggest that Random Forest could be effective in the agricultural domain for accurate soil classification. The results of the study will focus on the differences, capabilities, accuracy, and performance of the classifiers for the selected machine learning algorithms. The findings of the study are also beneficial to the plantation industry, as the classified soil data can be used to determine which crop is best suited to a certain soil type.

articleTitle: An Optimization Framework for Suggestive Contours
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Contours are a fundamental and powerful tool in computer vision, playing an indispensable role in understanding scene content and achieving advanced visual tasks. Suggestive contours exemplify high-fidelity graphical elements that intricately convey information with nuanced implications. They are widely used in visual tasks such as target recognition and detection, shape analysis and description, image segmentation, object tracking, and feature extraction. Extracting suggestive contours from the original model often faces various obstacles, making it easy to lose the surface detail information of complex models and resulting in significant differences in shape description from real objects. The content of this article is to design a framework for optimizing model structure to improve the generation of suggestive contours, thereby achieving the extraction of suggestive contours on any model. By optimizing model structure, more expressive and informative suggestive contours are generated under high-quality grid models.

articleTitle: A Multi-scale Cattle Individual Identification Method Based on CMT Module and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: With the development of precision animal husbandry technology, the automatic identification of individual cows has become essential. Traditional methods face limitations such as low efficiency, high cost, and vulnerability to environmental factors. This paper proposes a deep learning-based method for individual cow identification, integrating a CMT module and a multi-scale feature fusion branch atop the ResNet architecture. The CMT module captures long-range dependencies, enhancing the understanding of contextual information, while the multi-scale feature fusion branch improves feature expressiveness and robustness through hierarchical feature fusion. Additionally, an attention mechanism helps the model focus on critical features, boosting generalization, and a joint loss function combining circle loss and cross-entropy loss enhances identification accuracy. Experimental results show that this method achieves superior performance in cow identification, with a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 96.84%.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Model Based on Multi-Angle Attention Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is widely used in traffic control, resource scheduling platforms, and intelligent transportation systems (ITS) due to the complexity and dramatic increase in the size of the urban traffic network structure, the continuous growth in the travel demand of the residents, and the increasing traffic congestion problem. Existing traffic flow prediction models divide the city into many equal-sized grids, each representing a region, and use historical traffic data to predict future traffic conditions. However, this approach faces a crucial challenge in extracting complex spatio-temporal correlations within the city, and existing methods often fail to capture the complete spatio-temporal dependencies. To enhance the existing traffic flow prediction model, a new traffic flow prediction model called Multi-Angle Attention Convolutional Neural Network (MACACNN) is proposed. The model extracts spatio-temporal correlations from multiple angles to capture richer information. Specifically, MACACNN consists of three slice-view CNNs: Front Slice CACNN, Side Slice CACNN, and Top Slice CACNN. These slice-view CNNs can extract spatiotemporal correlations between different traffic patterns and establish the spatiotemporal relationship of traffic flow effectively by incorporating a Coordinate Attention mechanism (CA-Net) within the residual units of the branch networks. Furthermore, there is a fusion layer that fuses the results of the three slice view CNNs. In addition, MACACNN its external factors are added to the fusion layer to improve the prediction performance. Experimental studies are conducted on the TaxiBJ public dataset, and the results demonstrate that this approach can improve prediction performance with certain performance gains over other baseline models.

articleTitle: A Study on the Design of Bidirectional Emotion Translator for the Hearing Impaired Based on SAPAD- AHP
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to enhance the quality of life of the hearing impaired, this study aims to construct a two-way translator for the hearing impaired to realize design innovation. The study employs non-participatory observation and in-depth interviews to analyze the user’s behavioral patterns of using the translator. By introducing the SAPAD framework, the study mined the mapping relationship of “Behavior-Object-Meaning” and clustered it to derive general meaning clusters. Then, the weights of these general meaning clusters are calculated by using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and the multilevel core meaning clusters are obtained through filtering and clustering to identify the core needs of users. Based on the mapping analysis of “multi-level core meaning clusters - product”, the study reconstructed the component system. The conclusion shows that when using the translator, the needs of the hearing impaired include understanding the emotions of others and expressing their own emotions, which confirms the necessity of introducing affective computing in the translator function. In this study, we carried out the practice of designing a bi-directional emotional translator for the hearing impaired based on affective computing based on the SAPAD-AHP fusion framework. Finally, this study provides a practical reference case for the SAPAD-AHP fusion framework, which helps to continuously improve the theoretical system of product construction under the semiotic path.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv8 Algorithm for Aerial Image Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of UAV technology has promoted the widespread application of UAV aerial imagery in urban planning, environmental monitoring, disaster assessment and other fields. However, the complexity and diversity of UAV aerial photography data pose challenges to traditional target detection methods, which are usually difficult to handle such data effectively. To address these challenges and improve the accuracy and robustness of target detection, this study proposes a method to improve the YOLOv8 model on the VisDrone dataset. Based on the YOLOv8 fast single-stage detection method, this study replaces the CIoU loss function with the WIoU loss function. This change improves the regression accuracy of the bounding box, resulting in more accurate target detection. The study also introduces the global attention mechanism GAM and integrates the bi-directional feature pyramid network BiFPN module into the YOLOv8 model. GAM helps the model better understand the semantic information of the whole image, thus improving the target recognition and localization ability, while BiFPN further strengthens the model’s ability to perceive targets at different scales through multi-level feature fusion, feature optimization capability and detection performance. sensing ability of the model for targets at different scales through multi-level feature fusion, feature optimization capability and detection performance. These improvements further enhance the detection accuracy of the model and realize a better feature fusion and attention mechanism. The experimental results show that the improvements proposed in this study significantly improve the performance of the YOLOv8 model, resulting in a significant increase in the detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Multiple-Plays Multi-armed Bandit with Accelerated Thompson Sampling
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The stochastic multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem has received extensive attention in various fields. However, related research studies mainly focus on single-play scenarios, because if there are multiple-play, the problem is far more complex. This paper focuses on the multiple-play context in which for each round in the decision process, it involves a simultaneous selection of L arms from existing K arms $(L\lt K)$. The multiple-play Thompson sampling (MP-TS) algorithm proposed by Komiyama et al. (2015) offers a solution for the MAB problem with multiple play. However, the major weakness of their method is its inability to yield a consistent solution in choosing the optimal group of arms during later stages of the selection procedure. To remedy this problem, we introduce the multiple-play accelerated Thompson sampling (MP-ATS) algorithm, which incorporates an acceleration effect. An in-depth simulation study was conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed MP-ATS algorithm, which is shown to have a superb empirical performance. Furthermore, we examine a widely discussed application scenario: edge task offloading in cloud computing, in order to illustrate the significance of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Prediction Method and Research Based on Building Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Carbon emissions have become a vital issue as the greenhouse effect intensifies. As the world’s largest carbon emitter, China has put forward a dual-carbon target, and carbon emission forecasting is crucial to achieving this target. Carbon emission prediction faces many challenges, such as complex influencing factors, huge data demand, high uncertainty and the need to combine with climate and environmental factors. In this paper, the DBN-BP(Deep Belief Network-Back Propagation) model is used for carbon emission prediction. Firstly, DBN is used for feature learning. Then, the BP neural network optimised by the genetic algorithm is used for supervised learning to improve the prediction accuracy. The final prediction results are analysed to prove the validity and reliability of the prediction model through the calculation of the error results—this method. Through deep learning algorithms, it can deeply understand and predict carbon emissions, promote low-carbon transformation, and achieve a virtuous cycle of economy and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Research and application of gated recursive graph convolutional network in meteorological evapotranspiration data fusion processing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Hydrological resource management relies on reliable estimation of evapotranspiration (ET). Aiming at the problems of large errors and insufficient spatial feature extraction in the data generated by the existing ET fusion algorithm in Qinghai Province, The study takes Qinghai Province as the research area and proposes a gated recursive graph convolution network (GCN_GRU) model that combines gated recursive unit (GRU) and graph convolution network (GCN) to simulate daily ET estimates. and evaluate the accuracy of the model fusion. The GCN_GRU deep learning model is trained and optimized based on the site ET ERA5_Land and GLEAM reanalysis data, MOD16A2, MOD11A1 multi-source data generated by Penman formula from 50 national stations in the study area, The paper aims to develop a set of multi-source ET data fusion models suitable for the regional characteristics of Qinghai Province, and evaluate the accuracy of the model fusion to derive a regional ET data set with higher spatiotemporal accuracy and longer time series. In the study, random forest (RF), support vector machine (SVM), convolutional neural network (CNN), long short-term memory network (LSTM), graph convolution network (GCN), gated recursive unit (GRU), spatiotemporal Network (CNN_LSTM) and other methods as control experiments, The fusion model was evaluated and analyzed through three evaluation indicators: RMSE, MAE, CC, and RB, the results show: ①Among the three types of original ET data: ERA5_Land, GLEAM, and MOD16A2, ERA5_Land has the lowest root mean square error (RMSE $=1.82$) and mean absolute error (MAE=1.39) between station evaporation. ②The root mean square errors of the three machine learning control experiments are all at $0.61 \sim 1.13 \mathrm{~mm} \cdot \mathrm{~d}^{-1}$, the root mean square error between the GCN_GRU fusion model simulation results and the national site data(RMSE $=0.60$), mean absolute error(MAE=0.43), correlation coefficient $(\mathrm{CC}=0.90$), relative error ($\mathrm{RB}=0.053$)are better than the original data and the test results of the control experiment. In summary, the GCN_GRU fusion model proposed in the article is more suitable for evaporation estimation from different data sources in Qinghai Province, has strong applicability, Based on the model, a multi-source ET fusion data set with a daily scale spatial resolution of 1 km in Qinghai Province in the past 30 years was developed. It provides high-quality ET data support for ecological protection and environmental change effect analysis in Qinghai Province.

articleTitle: Time Series Forecasting with Multi-scale Decomposition and Fourier Neural Operators
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Time series forecasting has a wide range of applications in weather forecasting, energy price prediction, and many other fields. However, real-world time series data are often inherently non-stationary, which makes modeling time series data challenging. Existing research methods typically use seasonal-trend decomposition to disentangle time series data, and then leverage Transformer and other model structures to learn complex, evolving temporal variations.However, we observe that single seasonal-trend decomposition is often insufficient, and time series data exhibit different pattern regularities at different sampling scales. To address this, we propose a novel method that performs multi-scale seasonal-trend decomposition and aggregates features from fine to coarse scales to fully exploit semantic information. Furthermore, we draw inspiration from ensemble learning and employ Fourier neural operator-based backbone networks at different scales, with the predictions from multiple scales aggregated as the final output prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed model achieves superior prediction performance than state-of-the-art models on multiple public datasets.

articleTitle: A Study on Corn Pest Detection Based on Improved YOLOv 7
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of small pests, blurred image, low resolution and large species difference in different growth periods of corn crops. In this paper, an accurate and efficient method for the detection of maize crop pests, SPD-YOLOv7, was proposed. In this paper, target background analysis, data enhancement, Gaussian noise and brightness processing are used to improve the generalization and robustness of the model. In target detection, the deepening of the depth of neural network will lead to the loss of small target information. In this paper, SPD-Conv module is introduced into the framework of SPD-YOLOv7 to replace part of the step convolutional layer in the traditional system backbone and head network, so as to realize the prominent feature and location information of small target. In addition, the ELAN-W module is combined with the CBAM attention mechanism to extract more efficient features. The accuracy of the improved YOLOv7 network model reaches $98.38 \%$, and the average accuracy reaches $99.4 \%$. Compared with the original YOLOv7 model, the accuracy and average accuracy are improved by $2.46 \%$ and $3.19 \%$ respectively. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv7 network model is more efficient and real-time, and has certain reference value in maize pest control.

articleTitle: FEGRA: Defending Membership Inference Attacks via Feature Extraction and Gradient Ascent
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) can deduce whether unknown data is present in the model’s training data, leading to privacy leaks. Therefore, the research on defense strategies is of great significance to the security of artificial intelligence. The purpose of its defense methods is to trade off privacy and utility. Specifically, it is to maintain the original classification accuracy and then reduce the attack accuracy to about 0.5 as much as possible. Although scholars have proposed various defense methods, it is still difficult to solve the balance problem between model privacy and utility caused by model overfitting. In this paper, we propose a defense method to achieve the best balance between membership privacy and model utility by reducing model overfitting. Inspired by pre-trained models, we combined the feature extraction strategy and gradient ascent algorithm to obtain a new defense method for MIA, which we call FEGRA. Specifically, the pre-trained model is used to extract features to achieve an attack accuracy of about 0.52. Through the gradient ascent algorithm, the attack accuracy is further reduced to about 0.5 while maintaining the effectiveness of the model. We evaluated the FEGRA algorithm on five datasets with five models and compared it with six state-of-the-art denfence methods. Our method not only achieves excellent defense effects, but also achieves the best balance between attack accuracy and classification accuracy. Taking the CIFAR-10 dataset with ResNet34 model as an example, the experimental results show that we reduced the attack accuracy from 0.838 to 0.5 and also improved the classification accuracy from 60.3% to 64%.

articleTitle: Construction Of Smart Water Conservancy System Based On Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In response to the problems of complex terrain environment, variable water flow characteristics, large amount of data, scattered data, uneven data quality, low information processing efficiency, low information sharing and scalability, and high cost in water conservancy engineering, a BIM+GIS digital twin smart water conservancy system based on multiple data is established based on the actual geographic information coordinates and water resource information management system. A complete model of water diversion, storage, and usage units is established in the water conservancy system, and the monitoring, processing, and analysis data is timely fed back to the system to guide the operation, maintenance, water volume scheduling, water use supervision, and other work in physical space. By establishing models, algorithms, and application services for various requirements, indicators, and regulations of water resource planning and management, and utilizing simulation analysis in virtual space, a smart water conservancy system is established, Realize the digitization and modeling of water resource information within the region, as well as the intelligence and advancement of decision-making. Achieve multi-level and multi-dimensional information fusion that combines micro and macro, virtual and reality, achieve dynamic supervision and feedback of water resource information, improve work efficiency, and assist in the implementation and development of intelligent water conservancy.

articleTitle: Robust Keyword Spotting Based on Long-Term Feature Fusion and Band-Weighted Normalization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Currently, convolution-based models for keyword spotting focus predominantly on research conducted in clean speech environments. However, their recognition accuracy is lower in low signal-to-noise ratio conditions. To enhance model robustness, we propose the long-term feature fusion module. By extracting and fusing long-term features in both the time and frequency domains, the model’s perception of long-term features is strengthened, improving its recognition performance in noisy environments. At the same time, we propose a band-weighted normalization method, allowing the model to adjust the importance of different frequency bands during the normalization process, further enhancing the robustness of the model. Experimental results indicate that, on the Google Speech Command V2 dataset, the proposed model achieves higher recognition accuracy under various signal-to-noise ratios compared to the comparative models, with a lower parameter count. Moreover, the proposed model exhibits superior generalization to signal-to-noise ratios not covered during the training phase.

articleTitle: Construction of a ceramic culture knowledge graph dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This paper aims to construct a knowledge graph of ceramics culture. It integrates and displays the history, craftsmanship, and artistic styles of ceramics culture. By analyzing various aspects of ceramics culture, the paper uses knowledge graph technology to systematically classify and associate the collected data. It also explores the application of intelligent technologies (such as 3D printing, digital symbol systems, AI recognition) in the ceramics field. The core process involves data collection, processing, and ontology construction, combined with natural language processing techniques for entity recognition and relationship extraction, and uses the graph database Neo4j for data storage and management. A rich knowledge graph of ceramics culture is successfully constructed, providing a powerful tool for research and dissemination of ceramics culture. Through experimental evaluation, the effectiveness and practicality of the graph are verified, and the scale and quality of the dataset are discussed, pointing the way for future research.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneous Federated Learning Method Based on Global Classifier and Mean Regularization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Federated learning is an emerging distributed machine learning paradigm that can protect data privacy security in collaborative training of shared models by multiple parties. However, the shared global model cannot satisfy the individualized needs of multiple parties under system heterogeneity, and data heterogeneity among clients also leads to the global model failing to fit the distribution of each client’s dataset. The performance of the model degrades in extreme data heterogeneity and is difficult to converge. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a heterogeneous federated learning method based on Global Classifier and Mean Regularization, FedGCMR, for clients to design personalized models with different model structures to satisfy various demands. The method trains a shared global classifier on the server and uses it to replace the client classifier, transferring the learned global knowledge to the client. In addition, using the global feature mean normalizes the heterogeneous feature extractor and helps it to understand the data distribution in global view for higher quality generic representation. This helps the model converge quickly and improves its adaptability over different data distributions. In this paper, we perform comparative experiments on four image datasets in two data heterogeneous scenarios. The results show that the accuracy of FedGCMR is maximally 4.22% higher than other proposed methods in the model homogeneous setting and maximally 2.12% higher in the model heterogeneous setting.

articleTitle: Bearing fault diagnosis based on three-path parallel multi-scale convolution networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aiming at the complicated calculation and low time efficiency, a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on three-path parallel multi-scale convolution network is proposed. Firstly, continuous wavelet transform is adopted, CWT converts the original bearing vibration signal into a time-frequency characteristic map; Then, from the perspective of reducing the number of parameters, a network model is constructed, and the G-bneck structure is introduced in parallel convolution to reduce the number of parameters while improving the network’s ability to extract effective fault features; Finally, by introducing the CBAM attention mechanism and integrating the channel attention module and spatial attention module, the network model can better capture key information in the time-frequency map, thereby effectively improving diagnostic accuracy. This article adopts Case Western Reserve University(CWRU)and Southeast University Bearing data set(SUFD)was used for experimental verification and compared with other methods. The results showed that this method still performs well even in noisy and variable load states, verifying that the proposed model has higher recognition accuracy, noise resistance, and universality while ensuring high time efficiency.

Author Keywords: Additional and Phrases: Bearing fault diagnosis

articleTitle: Research on Few-shot Soil Classification Algorithm Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Traditional deep learning models often face the problem of insufficient training samples when performing soil classification tasks, resulting in overfitting of the model. In addition, the appearance similarity of soil samples is high, and traditional classification methods are difficult to effectively distinguish different types of soil. To cope with these challenges, this paper is about proposing a few-shot soil classification algorithm which is based on the attention mechanism, in which firstly the feature maps of different scales are extracted, and multi-scale fusion features are obtained through an adaptive feature pyramid module, thereby improving the performance of the subsequent positioning module and enriching feature information; then, the problem of image changes is solved through a feature alignment module based on cross attention; At the end, cosine similarity with respect to the query samples and the support samples is used to calculate the similarity between the query samples and the support samples to implement the classification. In the 1 -shot as well as 5 -shot classification tasks on the public datasets CUB-200-2011 and Stanford Dogs, the accuracy of this algorithm reached 81.87%, 87.24% and 67.31%, 79.48% respectively; On the homemade soil dataset Soil, the accuracy for the 1 -shot and 5 -shot assignment was 70.99% and 79.86%, respectively. The experimental results have shown that the algorithm exhibits the higher accuracy in the soil classification task.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Rayleigh-Bénard Thermal Convection Based on PINN
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitations of traditional numerical methods in the numerical simulation of two-dimensional Rayleigh-Bénard heat convection, a novel approach based on physical information neural networks (PINNs) is proposed. This method addresses the challenges of high mesh cost, low computational efficiency, and complex boundary condition processing. The thermal convection field is computed for four Rayleigh numbers $1.1 \times 10^{6} \leq \mathrm{Ra} \leq 1.1 \times 10^{9}$) at $\mathrm{Pr}=0.72$. In this work, the thermal convection field data solved by COMSOL® software is used to construct the data set for the PINNs model with the size of 8040000, and the data set is divided into a training set ([0, 8000000]) and a test set ([8000000, 8040000]), and the predictions were made for the test dataset using the trained model and validated by comparing the predictions with the thermal convection field computed with COMSOL ${ }^{\circledR}$ for the same operating conditions. As an illustrative example, consider the case where $1.1 \times 10^{6}$ is used. The results demonstrate that the maximum relative errors of the temperature and flow fields solved by the model are $1.28 \times 10^{-3}$ and $3.16 \times 10^{-3}$, respectively. The accuracy of the model prediction of the PINNs can be maintained at around $10^{-2}$, although it is found that the accuracy of the model prediction of the PINNs slightly decreases with the larger Ra number. Moreover, the model prediction requires approximately 5 seconds, whereas the COMSOL® computation time is 73 seconds. In comparison, the computational efficiency of the PINNs model is improved by a factor of 14. The results demonstrate that PINNs can not only effectively simulate the 2D Rayleigh-Bénard thermal convection problem, but also significantly reduce its numerical simulation time.

articleTitle: A Secure and Efficient Federated Learning Scheme Based on Homomorphic Encryption and Secret Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a decentralized machine learning framework that enables collaborative model building without exposing client data. However, FL faces the risk of client data leakage. Homomorphic Encryption (HE) is a solution, providing ciphertext computability to safeguard client data in FL. Existing HE-based FL research primarily focuses on achieving secure training under semi-honest models. Nevertheless, there are two problems in combining the practical application of secret sharing: Client provides wrong subkey, which may cause decryption error and training failure. The computational overhead of HE is high, leading to inefficient training. To address these, we propose a secure and efficient FL scheme (SEAFL). Firstly, we propose a Fingerprint-based Subkey Verification Algorithm (FKM) to generate unique fingerprints for each subkey. This allows clients to authenticate subkeys, preventing decryption errors and training failures caused by malicious client attacks. Secondly, we design a Gradient Protection Scheme that combines an elliptic curve encryption algorithm with preprocessing (SM2-GPM). In the preprocessing phase, a mapping table is constructed by mapping plaintext space values to points on an elliptic curve. When encrypting gradients, the complexity of point operations on elliptic curves is used to achieve higher security levels with shorter keys and reduce encryption overhead. Decryption of gradients is expedited through a comparison of ciphertext with the mapping table. The experimental demonstrates a significant 45 times reduction in training time compared to existing schemes.

articleTitle: Visual Analytic Study on Vehicle Target Detection Driven by CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: As a critical issue in computer vision and image processing, vehicle target detection plays a vital role in boosting vehicle recognition accuracy and information extraction efficiency, directly influencing applications such as autonomous driving, traffic monitoring, and safety management. This study employs CiteSpace tool to conduct an extensive visualization analysis of 2,641 scientific publications on vehicle target detection from the Web of Science Core Collection between 2019 and 2024, aiming to uncover research dynamics, core topics, collaboration networks, and future trends in this field. By designing a meticulous search strategy, we focus on the most authoritative SCI and SSCI literature and utilize CiteSpace version 6.3.1 for in-depth data mining and analysis. The findings reveal that deep learning, feature extraction, autonomous driving, and intelligent sensing technologies hold central positions in vehicle target detection, with significant contributions from authors like Li, Wei. A prolific research team, led by Yang, Jian, Zhang, Yu, and He, You, has emerged. Keyword analysis discloses that “object detection,” “deep learning,” and “feature extraction” are the most recurrent research foci, while “aerial vehicle” constitutes a persistent research hotspot, indicating the growing importance of drone technology and novel deep learning models, such as “Swin Transformer,” in enhancing detection efficiency and intelligence. Furthermore, the study identifies auto-target recognition and detection techniques in low-observable environments as key areas of interest, with a technological development trend leaning towards more intelligent and efficient solutions. Integration of drone systems and interdisciplinary technology fusion are expected to significantly advance vehicle target detection technology. This research not only quantifies the growth of research activities but also predicts potential future directions through keyword burst analysis, providing valuable insights for the field of vehicle target detection and holding significant theoretical and practical value for the development of intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: CTAN: Class-optimized Tracking Attention Network for Aspect-Level Sentiment Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Aspect-Level Sentiment Classification (ALSC) aims to determine the sentiment polarity of a specific aspect within a sentence. Despite significant advancements in various attention mechanisms in ALSC, many often lack dynamic contribution enhancement and noise filtering strategies. Some methods mask or assign decreasing weights to words distant from the Aspect, but this distance-based approach to measuring semantic relevance can result in semantic misinterpretation. We introduce a novel Tracking Attention Mechanism (TAM) that addresses these issues by incorporating contribution enhancement and noise filtering strategies independent of distance-based semantic relevance measurement, enabling efficient dynamic attention allocation. Furthermore, to account for associations among category sample features simultaneously, we propose the comprehensive Classoptimized Tracking Attention Network (CTAN) framework for ALSC. First, CTAN integrates the BERT model for word encoding. Second, building on TAM and the multi-head attention mechanism, we integrate the Multi-head Tracking Attention Mechanism (MTAM) and design MTAM-C and MTAM-A to track interactive information between context and Aspect dynamically. Finally, we introduce a new class loss function to capture associations among sample features. Experimental results on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that introducing TAM technology and class loss functions significantly enhances model performance, with CTAN achieving superior results compared to baseline models.

articleTitle: Ship target fusion algorithm based on improved YOLOv5 and ICP
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the video target in the maritime scene cannot be effectively fused with AIS data, and the specific ship cannot be locked on the video image, this paper proposes a ship target fusion algorithm based on improved YOLOv5 and ICP algorithm, aiming to improve the accuracy and efficiency of ship target detection in the inland waterway monitoring system. Aiming at the challenges of ship small target detection and target occlusion, we optimize the YOLOv5 model, which significantly improves the performance of the model in ship detection tasks. At the same time, in view of the limitations of the traditional ICP algorithm in matching ship video and AIS data point sets, we propose an improved ICP-2D algorithm to improve the speed and accuracy of matching. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by constructing a large-scale aquatic ship target data set and conducting extensive experiments. The results of this study not only improve the detection and matching accuracy of ship targets, but also enhance the adaptability and stability of the algorithm for different scenarios, which provides strong technical support for ship target recognition and tracking in Marine surveillance.

articleTitle: A Recommendation System for Aircraft Parts Processing Methods Based on a Hybrid of Rules and Instances
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Addressing the business logic and relevant requirements of process personnel during the selection stage of processing methods for aerospace structural parts, this paper introduces a recommendation system for aircraft parts processing methods based on a hybrid of rules and instances. Firstly, the typical features and processing methods of aircraft parts are defined, vectorized, and their feature similarity is calculated using the Euclidean distance method. Based on industry standards, a rule library for selecting processing methods is established to filter recommendation results. For the characteristics of the parts, the recommendation system retrieves the most similar features and their processing methods from the feature instance library for recommendation. Validation tests demonstrate that this recommendation system can effectively recommend suitable processing methods based on the features of aircraft parts.

articleTitle: Calendar-year effects modeling for claims reserving using Gaussian process regression with compound kernel
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: In insurance practice, the operational changes in the claims management and business practice, reserving practice and legislative changes often take place and can potentially introduce calendar-year effects. Modeling the dependence among multiple claims from the same calendar is critical to loss reserving, risk management and capital allocation for property-casualty insurers. In this paper, we extend the work of Lally and Hartman (2018) and take into the interactions over the same calender year by applying the combinations of additive squared exponential kernels. We perform empirical analyses over three bussiness lines from the NAIC loss development database, comparing and demonstrating the strong performance of our models. It is shown that the compound kernel provides additional structure for GP model, which improved the extrapolation ability of the GP model without input warping. Meanwhile, our model can generate reasonable predictions and predictive intervals while avoiding over-smoothing problem.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Knowledge graph reasoning is a key task in the field of natural language processing, aiming to infer missing entities or relations through existing information in the graph. Multi-hop knowledge graph reasoning has been one of the hot topics in knowledge graph research in recent years. However, due to the inherent incompleteness of knowledge graphs, effectively completing knowledge graphs has become a challenge. Multi-hop knowledge graph reasoning provides an interpretable solution by predicting missing links through exploring paths between entities. Most previous works have used reinforcement learning (RL) based methods to learn paths towards target entities. However, these methods may lack the ability to capture long-distance dependencies between entities, and they may fail to infer a path when there are missing edges along the path. To address these issues, we propose a multi-hop reasoning model based on sequence-to-sequence Transformer model named MHKGR. We introduce two modeling improvements to address the above problems: (1) we introduce a position-aware attention mechanism, which allows the model to flexibly focus on entities on different paths during the reasoning process, thereby improving the accuracy of multi-hop reasoning paths; (2) we optimize the output distribution of the model when generating reasoning paths by introducing a global response normalization module, which reduces noise and interference from irrelevant paths, enhancing the model’s ability to identify correct reasoning paths. We conducted extensive experiments on multiple standard and sparse knowledge graph datasets, and the results show that our method outperforms previous methods significantly.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Frosting Image Recognition for Cold Storage Evaporators Based on Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix and Multi-layer Extreme Learning Machine
