publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: Currently timed defrost and on-demand defrost are the two main defrosting methods in the refrigeration industry. As one of the on-demand defrosting methods, the use of image recognition technology for on-demand defrosting of cold storage heat exchangers is considered to be an efficient and easy-to-operate control method. However, for different operating environments in cold storage refrigeration systems, the recognition accuracy of the heat exchanger defrosting state is greatly reduced by the existing digital image processing techniques. For this reason, a method for recognizing the evaporator frost state using a gray scale covariance matrix combined with a multilayer limit learning machine (GLCM-ML-EML) is proposed. Using the laboratory environment, a large number of pictures of cold storage evaporator frosting under different operating environments were taken. And the frost pictures were categorized into three categories (no frost, light frost, and heavy frost). The experimental results show that in ternary classification, the recognition accuracy is up to 98.84% based on the gray-scale covariance matrix with multilayer limit learning machine. The recognition accuracy is improved by 6.77% compared to the traditional CNN model. It shows that this technique has high recognition accuracy and has good application prospects in the field of cold storage defrost control.

articleTitle: Using the Bit Interleaving Shift Method to Counteract the Dynamic Degradation of Digital Chaotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The operation of digital chaotic systems on devices with finite precision can lead to dynamical degradation, thereby posing a potential treat to system security. This study proposes a method called Bit Interleaving Shift (BIS) to counteract the dynamical degradation issue arising in the iterative process of digital chaotic maps. This method performs BIS on chaotic maps represented in fixed-point numbers using the generated interleaving block matrix. Simulation analysis shows that chaotic maps improved by this method have longer periods compared to traditional methods, making them more effective in combating dynamical degradation. Moreover, a novel pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) has been designed, and its exceptional randomness has been confirmed. Therefore, this method can be applied to fields such as cryptography and spread spectrum communication.

articleTitle: SegExtension:A Lightweight Segmentation Extension Based on 3D Slicer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The role of medical image detection and segmentation in medical treatment is increasingly prominent. It provides users with timely and accurate diagnostic and therapeutic information, thereby improving the efficiency of medical care. However, the current clinical practice often relies on medical image segmentation methods that require significant human-machine interaction, falling under the category of semi-automatic segmentation. These methods are limited by their dependence on users and face challenges regarding efficiency, accuracy, and precision.To address these issues, we propose an automated medical image segmentation method using advanced deep learning models. We have developed a plugin that integrates this method into open-source medical image processing software, facilitating its use by industry professionals. The results obtained from testing on medical images of different organs demonstrate the high accuracy of our automated segmentation tool, highlighting its efficiency and precision advantages.

articleTitle: Research on predicting legal judgments by incorporating key information
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The prediction of legal judgments is based on the description of case facts to predict the final charges. Through judgment prediction technology, the judicial system can handle a large number of cases more efficiently and provide more accurate judgment results. However, in reality, the types of charges are numerous and complex. To address the issues of severe data imbalance and easily confusable charges, this paper proposes a legal judgment model that incorporates key information. Firstly, it combines the ALBERT (A Lite BERT) pre-trained model and the bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) model to encode cases, efficiently capturing the contextual semantic information in case descriptions. Then, the concept of key information is introduced, using attention mechanisms and statistical methods to extract two distinguishable parts of key information from the cases, which are then concatenated with the case encoding for the final prediction. Additionally, category classification weights are employed to enhance the model’s ability to predict low-frequency samples. The proposed method has achieved good results on real legal judgment datasets.

articleTitle: Top-level design of AI monitoring system architecture based on multi-interactive metaverse strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: The metaverse represents a groundbreaking concept for the next generation of the Internet and social forms. It maps both the real world and the virtual world into a unified digital space, creating a parallel universe that seamlessly blends virtual and physical realities. In this paper, we explores the technological foundations and applications of the metaverse across various scenarios. First, based on the multi-interaction of the metaverse strategy, the top-level design of Artificial Intelligence(AI) monitoring system is carried out. Then, the practical application cases of artificial intelligence(AI) monitoring system architecture design are presented. This architecture is an open system that requires continuous improvement and supplementation. With the development of advanced AI technologies and hardware supplements, the metaverse will become increasingly refined and comprehensive.

articleTitle: Optimization of Broiler Behavior Recognition Technology Based on Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT)
abstract: This study aims to enhance agricultural productivity and animal welfare through the optimization of broiler behavior recognition technology based on accelerometer. By evaluating five machine learning algorithms-K-Nearest Neighbor, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Back Propagation Neural Network-to classify standing, walking, pecking, and drinking behaviors. It analyzes sliding window lengths and dataset segmentation impacts, employing sensors on broilers to collect and preprocess data. An 8-second window optimally balances detail and responsiveness, with Random Forest achieving 93.9 % accuracy, outshining others despite lower recall for drinking due to limited samples. The research sets a foundation for integrating advanced monitoring technologies in livestock farming, promoting productivity and welfare.
